title: II Kings 2:14
text: And he took the mantle of Elijah that had fallen from him, and struck the waters, and said, Where [is] the LORD God of Elijah, even He? And he also hit the waters, and they parted here and there. And Elisha went over.

title: II Kings 2:15
text: And when the sons of the prophets across in Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah rests upon Elisha! And they came to meet him and bowed to the ground before him.

title: II Kings 2:16
text: And [they] said to him, Behold now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master, lest the Spirit of the LORD has taken him up and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, You shall not send.

title: II Kings 2:17
text: And they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, Send. And they sent fifty men. And they looked for three days, but did not find him.

title: II Kings 2:18
text: And they returned to him, And he was staying in Jericho. And he said to them, Did I not say to you, Do not go?

title: II Kings 2:19
text: And the men of the city said to Elisha, Behold, please, the location of this city [is] pleasant, as my lord sees. But the waters [are] bad, and the ground [is] barren.

title: II Kings 2:20
text: And he said, Bring me a new jar and put salt in it. And they brought to him.

title: II Kings 2:21
text: And he went forth to the spring of the waters and threw the salt in there, and said, So says the LORD, I have healed these waters. There shall not be any more death or barrenness from there.

title: II Kings 2:22
text: And the waters were healed to this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spoke.

title: II Kings 2:23
text: And he went up from there to Bethel. And he was going up in the highway. And little boys came out from the city and mocked him, and said to him, Go up, bald head! Go up, bald head!

title: II Kings 2:24
text: And he turned behind him and saw them, and declared them vile in the name of the LORD. And two she-bears came out of the woods and tore forty-two boys of them.

title: II Kings 2:25
text: And he went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.

title: II Kings 3:1
text: And Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

title: II Kings 3:2
text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, but not like his father and his mother; for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.

title: II Kings 3:3
text: But he clung to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin. He did not depart from them.

title: II Kings 3:4
text: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and paid to the king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs, and a hundred thousand rams with the wool.

title: II Kings 3:5
text: And it happened when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

title: II Kings 3:6
text: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria at the same time and numbered all Israel.

title: II Kings 3:7
text: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up. I [am] as you [are], my people as your people, my horses as your horses.

title: II Kings 3:8
text: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

title: II Kings 3:9
text: And the king of Israel and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom went. And they went around behind for seven days' journey. And there was no water for the army, and for the cattle that followed them.

title: II Kings 3:10
text: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

title: II Kings 3:11
text: And Jehoshaphat said, [Is there] not here a prophet of the LORD, that we may ask of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah.

title: II Kings 3:12
text: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. And the king of Israel, and Jehoshaphat, and the king of Edom went down to him.

title: II Kings 3:13
text: And Elisha said to the king of Israel, What do I have to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father and to the prophets of your mother. And the king of Israel said to him, No, for the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.

title: II Kings 3:14
text: And Elisha said, [As] the LORD of hosts lives, before whom I stand, surely if it were not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you nor see you.

title: II Kings 3:15
text: And now bring me a minstrel. And it happened when the minstrel played, the hand of the LORD came on him.

title: II Kings 3:16
text: And he said, So says the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.

title: II Kings 3:17
text: For so says the LORD, You shall not see wind, nor shall you see rain. Still that valley shall be filled [with] water, so that you may drink, both you and your cattle, and your animals.

title: II Kings 3:18
text: And this is a light thing in the sight of the LORD. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.

title: II Kings 3:19
text: And you shall strike every fortified city, and every choice city. And you shall cut down every good tree and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece [of land] with stones.

title: II Kings 3:20
text: And it happened in the morning when the food offering was offered, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

title: II Kings 3:21
text: And all Moab had heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on [armor], and upward, and stood in the border.

title: II Kings 3:22
text: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side red [like] blood.

title: II Kings 3:23
text: And they said, This [is] blood. The kings are surely slain, and they have stricken one another. And now, Moab, to the spoil!

title: II Kings 3:24
text: And they came to the camp of Israel, and the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them. But they [entered it and] struck Moab.

title: II Kings 3:25
text: And they beat down the cities, and each man cast his stone on every good piece [of land], and filled it. And they stopped all the wells of water, and cut down all the good trees. Only in Kir-haraseth did they leave the stones of it. But the slingers surrounded it and struck it.

title: II Kings 3:26
text: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too strong for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew swords, in order to break through to the king of Edom. And they could not.

title: II Kings 3:27
text: And he took his oldest son, who would have reigned in his place, and offered him [for] a burnt offering on the wall. And there was great anger against Israel. And they left him, and returned to the land.

title: II Kings 4:1
text: And a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried to Elisha, saying, Your servant my husband is dead. And you know that your servant feared the LORD. And the lender has come to take my two children to himself for slaves.

title: II Kings 4:2
text: And Elisha said to her, What shall I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house? And she said, Your handmaid has not a thing in the house except a pot of oil.

title: II Kings 4:3
text: And he said, Go, borrow vessels for yourself from outside, from your neighbors, empty vessels. Do not let [them] be few.

title: II Kings 4:4
text: And you shall go in and shut the door on you and your sons. And you shall pour out into all those vessels. And you shall set aside the full ones.

title: II Kings 4:5
text: And she went from him and shut the door on her and on her sons. They brought to her, and she poured out.

title: II Kings 4:6
text: And it happened when the vessels were full, she said to her son, Bring me another vessel. And he said to her, [There is] not a vessel left. And the oil stopped.

title: II Kings 4:7
text: And she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil and pay your debt, and you and your sons shall live from the rest.

title: II Kings 4:8
text: And the day came when Elisha passed over to Shunem. And a great woman [was] there. And she laid hold on him to eat bread. And it happened, as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.

title: II Kings 4:9
text: And she said to her husband, Behold now, I see that this [is] a holy man of God who passes by us continually.

title: II Kings 4:10
text: Please, let us make a little room on the wall. And let us set a bed for him there, and a table, and a stool, and a lampstand. And when he comes to us, he shall turn in there.

title: II Kings 4:11
text: And the day came when he came in there, and he turned into the room and lay there.

title: II Kings 4:12
text: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And he called her, and she stood before him.

title: II Kings 4:13
text: And he said to him, Say now to her, Behold, you have been thoughtful for us with all this care. What [is] to be done for you? Would you be spoken for to the king or to the commander of the army? And she answered, I dwell among my own people.

title: II Kings 4:14
text: And he said, What then [is] to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Truly, she has no child, and her husband is old.

title: II Kings 4:15
text: And he said, Call her! And he called her, and she stood in the door.

title: II Kings 4:16
text: And he said, At this time, according to the time of life, you shall embrace a son. And she said, No, my lord, O man of God, do not lie to your handmaid.

title: II Kings 4:17
text: And the woman conceived and bore a son at that time that Elisha had said to her, according to the time of life.

title: II Kings 4:18
text: And the boy grew, and the day came that he went out to his father to the reapers.

title: II Kings 4:19
text: And he said to his father, My head, my head! And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

title: II Kings 4:20
text: And he carried him and brought him to his mother And he sat on her knees until noon and died.

title: II Kings 4:21
text: And she went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut [the door] on him and went out.

title: II Kings 4:22
text: And [she] called to her husband and said, Please send me one of the young men and one of the asses so that I may run to the man of God and come again.

title: II Kings 4:23
text: And he said, Why will you go to him today? [It is] neither new moon nor sabbath. And she said, [It is] well.

title: II Kings 4:24
text: And she saddled an ass and said to her servant, Drive and go forward! Do not hold back [your] riding for me unless I tell you.

title: II Kings 4:25
text: And she went and came to the man of God, to Mount Carmel. And it happened when the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, the Shunammite.

title: II Kings 4:26
text: Please run now to meet her, and say to her, [Is it] well with you? [Is it] well with your husband? [Is it] well with the boy? And she answered, Well!

title: II Kings 4:27
text: And she came to the man of God to the hill, and she caught him by the feet. And Gehazi came near to push her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone, for her soul [is] troubled within her. And the LORD has hidden [it] from me and has not told me.

title: II Kings 4:28
text: And she said, Did I desire a son from my lord? Did I not say, Do not deceive me?

title: II Kings 4:29
text: Then he said to Gehazi, Bind up your loins and take my staff in your hand, and go. If you meet any man, do not greet him. And if any greet you, do not answer him again. And lay my staff on the face of the child.

title: II Kings 4:30
text: And the mother of the child said, [As] the LORD lives, and [as] your soul lives, I will not leave you. And he arose and followed her.

title: II Kings 4:31
text: And Gehazi passed on before them and laid the staff on the face of the child. But there [was] no voice nor hearing. And he turned back to meet him and told him, saying, The boy has not awakened.

title: II Kings 4:32
text: And Elisha had come to the house. And behold, the boy was dead, and laid out on his bed.

title: II Kings 4:33
text: And he went in and shut the door on the two of them, and prayed to the LORD.

title: II Kings 4:34
text: And he went up and lay on the boy, and put his mouth on his mouth and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. And he stretched himself on the boy. And the flesh of the boy became warm.

title: II Kings 4:35
text: And he returned and walked in the house to and fro. And [he] went up and stretched himself on him. And the boy sneezed seven times, and the boy opened his eyes.

title: II Kings 4:36
text: And he called Gehazi and said, Call this Shunammite. And he called her, and she came in to him. And he said, Take up your son!

title: II Kings 4:37
text: And she went in and fell at his feet and bowed to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.

title: II Kings 4:38
text: And Elisha came again to Gilgal. And [there was] a famine in the land. And the sons of the prophets [were] sitting before him. And he said to his servant, Set on the great pot and boil pottage for the sons of the prophets.

title: II Kings 4:39
text: And one went out into the field to gather herbs. And he found a vine of the field, and gathered gourds from it in the field. And with the lap of his garment full, he came in and shredded [them] into the pot of pottage. For they did not know them.

title: II Kings 4:40
text: And they poured out for the men to eat. And it happened as they were eating of the pottage, they cried out and said, O man of God, death [is] in the pot! And they could not eat.

title: II Kings 4:41
text: And he said, Then bring meal. And he cast [it] into the pot. And he said, Pour out for the people, and they may eat. And there was no evil thing in the pot.

title: II Kings 4:42
text: And a man came from Baal-shalisha and brought the man of God bread from the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley and full ears of grain in his sack. And he said, Give to the people that they may eat.

title: II Kings 4:43
text: And his servant said, What? Should I set this before a hundred men? He said again, Give to the people so that they may eat, for so says the LORD, They shall eat and shall leave [some].

title: II Kings 4:44
text: And he set before them, and they ate, and left [some] of it, according to the word of the LORD.

title: II Kings 5:1
text: And Naaman, commander of the army of the king of Syria, was a great and exalted man with his master, because the LORD had given deliverance to Syria by him. He was also a mighty man, [but] a leper.

title: II Kings 5:2
text: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and captured a little girl out of the land of Israel. And she waited on Naaman's wife.

title: II Kings 5:3
text: And she said to her mistress, I wish my lord [were] with the prophet in Samaria! For he would recover him from his leprosy.

title: II Kings 5:4
text: And [one] went in and told his lord, saying, This and this said the girl from the land of Israel.

title: II Kings 5:5
text: And the king of Syria said, Go, go in and I will send a letter to the king of Israel. And he departed and took with him ten talents of silver and six thousand of gold, and ten changes of clothing.

title: II Kings 5:6
text: And he came in [with] the letter to the king of Israel, saying, And now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you. And you shall recover him of his leprosy.

title: II Kings 5:7
text: And it happened when the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, [Am] I God, to kill and to make alive, that this [man] sends to me to recover a man from his leprosy? For consider now, and see, for he is coiling himself toward me.

title: II Kings 5:8
text: And it happened when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, he sent to the king, saying, Why have you torn your clothes? Let him now come to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.

title: II Kings 5:9
text: And Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

title: II Kings 5:10
text: And Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come to you, and you shall be clean.

title: II Kings 5:11
text: But Naaman was angry, and went away. And he said, Behold, I said within myself, He will surely come out to me and stand and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place and recover the leper.

title: II Kings 5:12
text: [Are] not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? May I not wash in them, and be clean? And he turned and went away in a rage.

title: II Kings 5:13
text: And his servants came near and spoke to him and said, My father, [if] the prophet had told you [to do] a great thing, would you not have done [it]? How much rather then, when he says to you, Wash and be clean?

title: II Kings 5:14
text: And he went down and dipped seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God. And his flesh came again like the flesh of a little boy, and he was clean.

title: II Kings 5:15
text: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company. And he came and stood before him. And he said, Behold, now I know that [there is] no God in all the earth, but in Israel. And now please take a blessing from your servant.

title: II Kings 5:16
text: But he said, [As] the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it, but he refused.

title: II Kings 5:17
text: And Naaman said, Please shall there not then be given to your servant two mules' burden of earth? For your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to Jehovah.

title: II Kings 5:18
text: In this thing may Jehovah pardon your servant, that when my master goes to the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he is supported by my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon; when I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may Jehovah pardon your servant in this thing.

title: II Kings 5:19
text: And he said to him, Go in peace. And he went away from him a little way.

title: II Kings 5:20
text: And Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master has spared Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hand that which he brought. But, [as] the LORD lives, I will run after him and take something from him.

title: II Kings 5:21
text: And Gehazi followed after Naaman. And Naaman saw [him] running after him, and descended down from the chariot to meet him. And he said, [Is] all well?

title: II Kings 5:22
text: And he said, All [is] well. My master has sent me, saying, Behold, this now, two young men from mount Ephraim of the sons of the prophets have come to me. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.

title: II Kings 5:23
text: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing. And he laid [them] on two of his servants. And they carried them before him.

title: II Kings 5:24
text: And he came to the hill, and he took from their hand and stowed them in the house. And he let the men go, and they departed.

title: II Kings 5:25
text: And he went in and stood before his master. And Elisha said to him, Where [from], Gehazi? And he said, Your servant did not go here or there.

title: II Kings 5:26
text: And he said to him, Did not my heart go [with you] when the man turned again from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive silver and to receive clothing and olive-yards and vineyards and sheep and oxen and menservants and maidservants?

title: II Kings 5:27
text: And the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your seed forever. And he went out from his presence as leprous as snow.

title: II Kings 6:1
text: And the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, Behold now, the place where we live with you [is] too small for us.

title: II Kings 6:2
text: Please let us go to Jordan. And let each man take a beam from there. And let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go.

title: II Kings 6:3
text: And one said, Be content, please, and go with your servants. And he answered them, I will go.

title: II Kings 6:4
text: And he went with them. And they came to Jordan, and they cut down trees.

title: II Kings 6:5
text: And it happened as one was felling a log, the axe-head fell into the water. And he cried and said, Alas, master! For it was borrowed.

title: II Kings 6:6
text: And the man of God said, Where did it fall? And he showed him the place. And he cut down a stick and threw [it] in there. And the iron swam.

title: II Kings 6:7
text: And he said, take [it] up to you. And he put out his hand and took it.

title: II Kings 6:8
text: And the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place [shall be] my camp.

title: II Kings 6:9
text: And the man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, Beware that you do not pass such a place, for the Syrians have come down there.

title: II Kings 6:10
text: And the king of Israel sent to the place of which the man of God told him and warned him, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

title: II Kings 6:11
text: And the heart of the king of Syria was enraged for this thing. And he called his servants and said to them, Will you not show me which of us [is] for the king of Israel?

title: II Kings 6:12
text: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king, but Elisha the prophet, who [is] in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.

title: II Kings 6:13
text: And he said, Go and spy where he [is], so that I may send and bring him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, [he is] in Dothan.

title: II Kings 6:14
text: And he sent there horses and chariots and a great army. And they came by night and surrounded the city.

title: II Kings 6:15
text: And the servant of the man of God arose early and went out. And, behold, an army surrounded the city, and horses and chariots. And his servant said to him, Alas, my master! What shall we do?

title: II Kings 6:16
text: And he answered, Do not fear, for those with us [are] more than those with them.

title: II Kings 6:17
text: And Elisha prayed and said, I pray You, LORD, open his eyes so that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw. And behold, the mountain [was] full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

title: II Kings 6:18
text: And they came down to it, and Elisha prayed to the LORD and said, I pray You, strike this people with blindness. And He struck them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.

title: II Kings 6:19
text: And Elisha said to them, This [is] not the way, nor [is] this the city. Follow me and I will bring you to the man whom you seek. But he led them to Samaria.

title: II Kings 6:20
text: And it happened when they came into Samaria, Elisha said, LORD, open the eyes of these [men] so that they may see. And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw. And behold, [they were] in the middle of Samaria.

title: II Kings 6:21
text: And when he saw them, the king of Israel said to Elisha, My father, shall I strike [them]? Shall I strike [them]?

title: II Kings 6:22
text: And he answered, You shall not strike [them]. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them so that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.

title: II Kings 6:23
text: And he prepared a great feast for them. And when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. And the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

title: II Kings 6:24
text: And it happened after this Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his army and went up and lay siege to Samaria.

title: II Kings 6:25
text: And there was a great famine in Samaria. And, behold, they besieged it until an ass's head was [sold] for eighty [pieces] of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five silver pieces.

title: II Kings 6:26
text: And as the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, Help, my lord, O king!

title: II Kings 6:27
text: And he said, if the LORD does not help you, from where shall I help you? Out of the barn-floor, or out of the winepress?

title: II Kings 6:28
text: And the king said to her, What [ails] you? And she said, This woman said to me, Give your son so that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.

title: II Kings 6:29
text: And we boiled my son and ate him. And I said to her on the other day, Give your son so that we may eat him. And she has hidden her son.

title: II Kings 6:30
text: And it happened when the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. And he passed by on the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, [he had] sackcloth inside on his flesh.

title: II Kings 6:31
text: And he said, May God do so, and more also, to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.

title: II Kings 6:32
text: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him. And he sent a man from before him. [But] before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door and hold him fast at the door. [Is] not the sound of his master's feet behind him?

title: II Kings 6:33
text: While he still talked with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. And he said, Behold, this evil [is] from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?

title: II Kings 7:1
text: And Elisha said, Hear the word of the LORD! So says the LORD, Tomorrow about this time a measure of fine flour [will be] sold at a shekel, and two measures of barley at a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

title: II Kings 7:2
text: And the third officer on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, [if] the LORD would make windows in heaven, then this thing might be. And he said, Behold, you shall see with your eyes, but you shall not eat of it.

title: II Kings 7:3
text: And four men, lepers, were at the gate entrance. And they said to one another, Why do we sit here until we die?

title: II Kings 7:4
text: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine [is] in the city, and we shall die there. And if we still sit here, we also shall die. And now come and let us fall to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we shall live. And if they kill us, we shall only die.

title: II Kings 7:5
text: And they rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. And when they had come to the outermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, no man [was] there!

title: II Kings 7:6
text: For the LORD had made the army of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots and a noise of horses, the noise of a great army. And they said to one another, Lo, the king of Israel has hired the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians against us, to come on us.

title: II Kings 7:7
text: And they arose and fled in the twilight and left their tents and their horses and their asses, the camp, as it [was], and fled for their life.

title: II Kings 7:8
text: And when these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent and ate and drank, and carried silver and gold and clothing from there, and went and hid [it]. And they came again and entered into another tent and carried from there, and went and hid [it].

title: II Kings 7:9
text: And they said to one another, We are not doing right. This day [is] a day of good news, and we hold our peace. If we stay until the morning light, some punishment will come on us. And now come, so that we may go and tell the king's household.

title: II Kings 7:10
text: And they came and called to the porter of the city. And they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, no man [was] there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they [were] .

title: II Kings 7:11
text: And he called the porters. And they told [it] to the king's house inside.

title: II Kings 7:12
text: And the king arose in the night and said to his servants, I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we [are] hungry, and they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive and get into the city.

title: II Kings 7:13
text: And one of his servants answered and said, Please let [some] take five of the horses which remain, which are left in the city; behold, they [are] like all the multitude of Israel that are left in it; behold, they [are] even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed. And we will send and see.

title: II Kings 7:14
text: And they took two chariots [with] horses. And the king sent after the army of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.

title: II Kings 7:15
text: And they went after them to Jordan. And, lo, all the way [was] full of clothing and vessels which the Syrians had thrown away in their haste. And the messengers returned and told the king.

title: II Kings 7:16
text: And the people went out and plundered the tents of the Syrians. And it happened, a measure of fine flour was [sold] for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.

title: II Kings 7:17
text: And the king appointed the third officer over the gate, [the one] on whose hand he had leaned. And the people trampled on him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.

title: II Kings 7:18
text: And it happened according to the saying of the man of God to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel: [This] shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria.

title: II Kings 7:19
text: And the third officer answered the man of God and said, Behold, [if] the LORD should make windows in heaven, then such a thing might be. And he said, Behold, you shall see it with your eyes, but you shall not eat of it.

title: II Kings 7:20
text: And it happened to him, for the people trampled on him in the gate, and he died.

title: II Kings 8:1
text: And Elisha spoke to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise and go, you and your household, and live wherever you can live. For the LORD has called for a famine. And it shall also come on the land seven years.

title: II Kings 8:2
text: And the woman arose and did according to the word of the man of God was. And she went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines seven years.

title: II Kings 8:3
text: And it happened at the end of seven years, the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines. And she went forth to cry to the king for her house and for her land.

title: II Kings 8:4
text: And the king was talking with Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, saying, Please tell me all the great things which Elisha has done.

title: II Kings 8:5
text: And it happened as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life cried to the king for the house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O, king, this [is] the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.

title: II Kings 8:6
text: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain eunuch saying, Restore all that [was] hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day when she left the land, even until now.

title: II Kings 8:7
text: And Elisha came to Damascus. And Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick. And they told him, saying, The man of God has come here.

title: II Kings 8:8
text: And the king said to Hazael, Take a present in your hand and go to meet the man of God, and ask of the LORD by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

title: II Kings 8:9
text: And Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Your servant Ben-hadad, king of Syria, has sent me to you, saying, Shall I recover from this disease?

title: II Kings 8:10
text: And Elisha said to him, Go and say to him, You shall certainly recover. But the LORD has shown me that he shall surely die.

title: II Kings 8:11
text: And he settled his face steadfastly until he was ashamed. And the man of God wept.

title: II Kings 8:12
text: And Hazael said, Why does my lord weep? And he answered, Because I know the evil that you will do to the sons of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their children, and rip up their women with child.

title: II Kings 8:13
text: And Hazael said, What! [Is] your servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD has shown me that you [shall be] king over Syria.

title: II Kings 8:14
text: And he departed from Elisha and came to his master, who said to him, What did Elisha say to you? And he answered, He told me you would surely recover.

title: II Kings 8:15
text: And it happened on the next day he took a thick cloth and dipped [it] in water, and spread it on his face so that he died. And Hazael reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 8:16
text: And in the fifth year of Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat [being] then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

title: II Kings 8:17
text: And he was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

title: II Kings 8:18
text: And he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab did; for the daughter of Ahab was his wife. And he did evil in the sight of the LORD.

title: II Kings 8:19
text: Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David His servant's sake, as He promised him to give him a light to his sons forever

title: II Kings 8:20
text: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

title: II Kings 8:21
text: And Jehoram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him. And he rose by night and struck the Edomites who were all around him, and the commanders of the chariots. And the people fled into their tents.

title: II Kings 8:22
text: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

title: II Kings 8:23
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoram, and all that he did, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matter of the Days of the Kings of Judah?

title: II Kings 8:24
text: And Jehoram slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 8:25
text: In the twelfth year of Jehoram the son of Ahab, king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, began to reign.

title: II Kings 8:26
text: Ahaziah [was] twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

title: II Kings 8:27
text: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the LORD, as the house of Ahab, for he [was] the son-in-law of the house of Ahab.

title: II Kings 8:28
text: And he went with Jehoram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth of Gilead. And the Syrians wounded Jehoram.

title: II Kings 8:29
text: And king Jehoram went back to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him in Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

title: II Kings 9:1
text: And Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, Bind up your loins and take this box of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth in Gilead.

title: II Kings 9:2
text: And you shall go there, and you shall see there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi. And you shall go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.

title: II Kings 9:3
text: And take the box of oil and pour [it] on his head, and say, So says the LORD, I have anointed you king over Israel. And you shall open the door, and flee, and shall not wait.

title: II Kings 9:4
text: And the young man went, the servant of the prophet, [to] Ramoth in Gilead.

title: II Kings 9:5
text: And [he] came in, and, behold, the commanders of the army [were] sitting. And he said, I have an errand to you, commander. And Jehu said, To which of all of us? And he said, To you, commander.

title: II Kings 9:6
text: And he arose and went into the house. And he poured the oil on his head and said to him, So says Jehovah God of Israel, I have anointed you king over the people of the LORD, over Israel.

title: II Kings 9:7
text: And you shall strike the house of Ahab your master, so that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD at the hand of Jezebel.

title: II Kings 9:8
text: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish. And I will cut off from Ahab everyone that urinates against the wall, both bound and free.

title: II Kings 9:9
text: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

title: II Kings 9:10
text: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in a part of Jezreel, and none [shall be there] to bury [her]. And he opened the door and fled.

title: II Kings 9:11
text: And Jehu went out to the servants of his lord. And [one] said to him, Well? Why did this mad man come to you? And he said to them, You know the man and what he had to say.

title: II Kings 9:12
text: And they said, [It is] false. Tell us now! And he said, This and this he spoke to me, saying, So says the LORD, I have anointed you king over Israel.

title: II Kings 9:13
text: And they hurried and each man took his garment and put [it] under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

title: II Kings 9:14
text: And Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi plotted against Jehoram. And Jehoram was keeping [watch at] Ramoth in Gilead, he and all Israel before Hazael king, of Syria.

title: II Kings 9:15
text: And king Jehoram returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael the king of Syria. And Jehu said, If it is your minds, [then] let no escapee leave to go to tell [it] in Jezreel.

title: II Kings 9:16
text: And Jehu rode in the chariot and went to Jezreel. For Jehoram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Jehoram.

title: II Kings 9:17
text: And a watchman stood on the tower in Jezreel. And [he] saw the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Jehoram said, Take a horseman and send to meet them, and let him say, [Is it] peace?

title: II Kings 9:18
text: And the rider on horseback went to meet him and said, So says the king, [Is it] peace? And Jehu said, What do you [have to do] with peace? Turn behind me! And the watchman reported, saying, The messenger came to them, but he does not come again.

title: II Kings 9:19
text: And he sent a second rider on horseback, who came to them and said, So says the king, [Is it] peace? And he answered, What [do you have] to do with peace? Turn behind me!

title: II Kings 9:20
text: And the watchman reported, saying, He came up to them, but does not come again. And the driving [is] like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.

title: II Kings 9:21
text: And Jehoram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Jehoram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his own chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth of Jezreel.

title: II Kings 9:22
text: And it happened when Jehoram saw Jehu, he said, [Is it] peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the harlotries of your mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts [are so] many?

title: II Kings 9:23
text: And Jehoram turned his hands and fled and said to Ahaziah, Treachery, Ahaziah!

title: II Kings 9:24
text: And Jehu drew a bow and struck Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sank down in his chariot.

title: II Kings 9:25
text: And he said to Bidkar his commander, Take him up [and] throw him in the portion of the field of Naboth of Jezreel. For, remember, you and I rode together after Ahab his father, and the LORD laid this burden on him.

title: II Kings 9:26
text: Surely, yesterday I have seen the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons, says the LORD, and I will repay you in this portion, says the LORD. And now, take [him] and throw him into the portion, according to the word of the LORD.

title: II Kings 9:27
text: And when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw, [he] fled by the way of the garden-house. And Jehu followed after him and said, Strike him also in the chariot, at the going up to Gur, that [is near] Ibleam. And [he] fled to Megiddo, and died there.

title: II Kings 9:28
text: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in the city of David.

title: II Kings 9:29
text: And in the eleventh year of Jehoram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.

title: II Kings 9:30
text: And Jehu had come to Jezreel. And Jezebel heard, and had painted her face and adorned her head, and looked out at a window.

title: II Kings 9:31
text: And Jehu came to the gate. And she said, [Was it] peace [to] Zimri the slayer of his lord?

title: II Kings 9:32
text: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who [is] with me? Who? And two [or] three eunuchs looked out at him.

title: II Kings 9:33
text: And he said, Throw her down! And they threw her down. And [some] of her blood was sprinkled on the wall and on the horses. And he trampled her.

title: II Kings 9:34
text: And when he had come in, he ate and drank, and said, Go, now see this cursed [woman] and bury her. For she is a king's daughter.

title: II Kings 9:35
text: And they went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull and the feet and the palms of [her] hands.

title: II Kings 9:36
text: And they came again and told him. And he said, [This is] the word of the LORD which He spoke by His servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel the dogs shall eat the flesh of Jezebel.

title: II Kings 9:37
text: And the dead body of Jezebel shall be as dung on the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel, [so] that they shall not say, This [is] Jezebel.

title: II Kings 10:1
text: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters and sent to Samaria to the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to the supporters of Ahab, saying,

title: II Kings 10:2
text: And now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master's sons [are] with you, and with you [are] chariots and horses, also a fortified city and armor,

title: II Kings 10:3
text: even look for the best and fittest of your master's sons, and set [him] on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.

title: II Kings 10:4
text: And they were exceedingly afraid and said, Behold, two kings did not stand before him; how then shall we stand?

title: II Kings 10:5
text: And he who [was] over the house, and he over the city, the elders also, and the guardians, sent to Jehu saying, We [are] your servants and will do all that you shall say to us; we will not make any king. Do what is good in your eyes.

title: II Kings 10:6
text: And he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If you [are] mine, and will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men, your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by this time tomorrow. And the king's sons, seventy persons, [were] with the great men of the city who brought them up.

title: II Kings 10:7
text: And it happened when the letter came to them, they took the king's sons and killed them, seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets and sent to him in Jezreel.

title: II Kings 10:8
text: And a messenger came and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

title: II Kings 10:9
text: And it happened in the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, You [are] righteous. Behold, I plotted against my master and killed him. But who killed all these?

title: II Kings 10:10
text: Now know that there shall fall to the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spoke concerning the house of Ahab. For the LORD has done that which He spoke by His servant Elijah.

title: II Kings 10:11
text: And Jehu killed all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

title: II Kings 10:12
text: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. He [was] at the shepherds' shearing-house in the way,

title: II Kings 10:13
text: And Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who [are] you? And they answered, The brothers of Ahaziah. And we are going down to greet the king's sons and the queen's sons.

title: II Kings 10:14
text: And he said, Take them alive! And they took them alive and killed them at the pit of the shearing-house, forty-two men. And he left not a man of them.

title: II Kings 10:15
text: And he left there and found Jehonadab the son of Rechab [coming] to meet him. And [he] greeted him and said to him, [Is] your heart right, as my heart [is] with your heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it is, give your hand. And he gave his hand. And he took him up to him into the chariot.

title: II Kings 10:16
text: And [he] said, Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD. And they made him ride in his chariot.

title: II Kings 10:17
text: And he came to Samaria, and killed all that remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD which he spoke to Elijah.

title: II Kings 10:18
text: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, Ahab served Baal a little, [but] Jehu shall serve him much.

title: II Kings 10:19
text: And now call to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants and all his priests. Let no one be lacking. For I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever shall be lacking, he shall not live. But Jehu did [it] in subtlety, to the end that he might destroy the worshipers of Baal.

title: II Kings 10:20
text: And Jehu said, Call a solemn feast for Baal. And they called [it].

title: II Kings 10:21
text: And Jehu sent through all Israel. And all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left who did not come. And they came into the house of Baal. And the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

title: II Kings 10:22
text: And he said to him who [was] over the robe-room, Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal. And he brought [them] out for them.

title: II Kings 10:23
text: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal. And he said to the servants of Baal, Search and look, that there [may] not [be] here with you any of the servants of the LORD, but only the servants of Baal.

title: II Kings 10:24
text: And they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. And Jehu had appointed eighty men outside, and said, [If] any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escapes, his life shall be for the life of him.

title: II Kings 10:25
text: And it happened when he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the commanders, Go in. Kill them! Do not let any come out! And they struck them with the edge of the sword. And the guard and the commanders threw [them] out. And they went to the city, to the house of Baal.

title: II Kings 10:26
text: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal and burned them.

title: II Kings 10:27
text: And [they] broke down the image of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal and made it a sewer-house until this day.

title: II Kings 10:28
text: And Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

title: II Kings 10:29
text: Only, Jehu did not depart [from] the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, going after them, the golden calves in Bethel and in Dan.

title: II Kings 10:30
text: And the LORD said to him, Jehu, because you have done well in doing the right in My eyes, and have done to the house of Ahab according to all that [was] in My heart, your sons of the fourth [generation] shall sit on the throne of Israel.

title: II Kings 10:31
text: But Jehu did not care to walk in the law of Jehovah God of Israel with all his heart, for he did not turn from the sins of Jeroboam, who made Israel to sin.

title: II Kings 10:32
text: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short. And Hazael struck them in all the border of Israel,

title: II Kings 10:33
text: from Jordan toward the rising of the sun, all the land of Gilead, the men of Gad and of Reuben and of Manasseh, from Aroer, by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

title: II Kings 10:34
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehu and all that he did, and all his might, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matter of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 10:35
text: And Jehu slept with his fathers. And they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 10:36
text: And the days that Jehu reigned over Israel and Samaria [were] twenty-eight years.

title: II Kings 11:1
text: And Athaliah was the mother of Ahaziah. And when she saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed of the kingdom.

title: II Kings 11:2
text: But Jehosheba the daughter of king Jehoram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah and stole him from among the king's sons [which were] killed. And they hid him from Athaliah in the bedroom, him and his nurse, so that he was not killed.

title: II Kings 11:3
text: And he was hidden with her in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah reigned over the land.

title: II Kings 11:4
text: And in the seventh year Jehoiada sent and brought the rulers over hundreds, with the commanders and the guards, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD. And he made a covenant with them and took an oath from them in the house of the LORD, and revealed to them the king's son.

title: II Kings 11:5
text: And he commanded them, saying, This [is] the thing that you shall do. A third part of you who enter in on the sabbath [shall be] keepers of the watch of the king's house.

title: II Kings 11:6
text: And a third part [shall be] at the gate of Sur. And a third part at the gate behind the guard. And you shall keep the watch of the house, alternately.

title: II Kings 11:7
text: And two parts of you, all who go forth [on] the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD around the king.

title: II Kings 11:8
text: And you shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand. And he who comes inside the ranks, let him be killed. And they shall be with the king as he goes out and as he comes in.

title: II Kings 11:9
text: And the rulers of the hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. And each man took his men, going in on the sabbath, with those going out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

title: II Kings 11:10
text: And the priest gave king David's spears and shields, which [were] in the temple of the LORD, to the rulers of the hundreds.

title: II Kings 11:11
text: And the guard stood, each man with his weapons in his hand, around the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, by the altar and the temple.

title: II Kings 11:12
text: And he brought forth the king's son, and put the crown and the testimony on him. And they made him king and anointed him, and clapped their hands and said, Let the king live!

title: II Kings 11:13
text: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard [and] of the people, she came [to] the people into the temple of the LORD.

title: II Kings 11:14
text: And she looked, and behold, the king stood by a pillar as usually [was] done, and the rulers and the trumpeters [were] by the king. And all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets. And Athaliah tore her clothes, and cried, Treason! Treason!

title: II Kings 11:15
text: And Jehoiada the priest commanded the rulers of the hundreds, those set over the army, and said to them, Take her out between the ranks, and let the one who follows her kill [her] with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD.

title: II Kings 11:16
text: And they laid hands on her, and she went by the way which the horses came into the king's house. And she was killed there.

title: II Kings 11:17
text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD's people; also between the king and the people.

title: II Kings 11:18
text: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images completely in pieces. And they killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.

title: II Kings 11:19
text: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the commanders, and the guard, and all the people of the land. And they brought the king down from the house of the LORD and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king's house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

title: II Kings 11:20
text: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. And they killed Athaliah with the sword [beside] the king's house.

title: II Kings 11:21
text: Joash [was] seven years old when he began to reign.

title: II Kings 12:1
text: And in the seventh year of Jehu, Joash began to reign. And he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. And his mother's name [was] Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

title: II Kings 12:2
text: And Joash did the right in the sight of the LORD all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

title: II Kings 12:3
text: But the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

title: II Kings 12:4
text: And Joash said to the priests, All the silver from things dedicated to God, which is brought into the house of the LORD, the silver from each man the silver of his valuation, all the silver that comes into any man's heart to bring to the house of the LORD,

title: II Kings 12:5
text: let the priests take [it] to themselves, each man from those he knows. And let them repair the breaks in the house, in all [places] where any break shall be found.

title: II Kings 12:6
text: And it happened in the twenty-third year of king Joash, the priests had not repaired the breaks of the house.

title: II Kings 12:7
text: Then king Joash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the priests, and said to them, Why are you not repairing the breaks of the house? And now take no silver from those you know, but deliver it for the breaks of the house.

title: II Kings 12:8
text: And the priests agreed to take no silver from the people, nor to repair the breaks of the house.

title: II Kings 12:9
text: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid. And he set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the house of the LORD. And the priests who kept the door put in it all the silver brought into the house of the LORD.

title: II Kings 12:10
text: And it happened when they saw that much silver [was] in the chest, the king's scribe and the high priest came up. And they bound and counted the silver that was found [in] the house of the LORD.

title: II Kings 12:11
text: And they gave the silver which was counted into the hands of those who did the work, those overseeing the house of the LORD. And they laid it out to the carpenters and builders who worked on the house of the LORD,

title: II Kings 12:12
text: and to masons and cutters of stone, and to buy timber and cut stone to repair the breaks of the house of the LORD, and for all that went forth for the house, to repair [it].

title: II Kings 12:13
text: Only, there were no bowls of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, or any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, made for the house of the LORD from the silver which [was] brought into the house of the LORD.

title: II Kings 12:14
text: For they gave it to the workmen, and repaired the house of the LORD with it.

title: II Kings 12:15
text: And they did not make an accounting with the men into whose hands they gave the silver to be given to the workmen. For they dealt faithfully.

title: II Kings 12:16
text: The trespass silver and sin silver was not brought into the house of the LORD. It was the priests'.

title: II Kings 12:17
text: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it. And Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

title: II Kings 12:18
text: And Joash king of Judah took all the holy things which Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold found in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and in the king's house, and sent [it] to Hazael king of Syria. And he went away from Jerusalem.

title: II Kings 12:19
text: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah?

title: II Kings 12:20
text: And his servants arose and made a plot. And they killed Joash in the house of Millo, which goes down [to] Silla.

title: II Kings 12:21
text: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died. And they buried him with his fathers in the city of David. And Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 13:1
text: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, seventeen years.

title: II Kings 13:2
text: And he did the evil in the sight of the LORD, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin. And he did not depart from them.

title: II Kings 13:3
text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and He delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, all [their] days.

title: II Kings 13:4
text: And Jehoahaz sought the LORD, and the LORD listened to him. For He saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.

title: II Kings 13:5
text: And the LORD gave Israel a deliverer, so that they went out from under the Syrians. And the sons of Israel lived in their tents, as before.

title: II Kings 13:6
text: But they did not depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel to sin, [but] walked in them. And also the Asherah in Samaria stood.

title: II Kings 13:7
text: For He had not left a people remaining to Jehoahaz, but only fifty horsemen and ten chariots and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them and had made them like the dust at threshing-time.

title: II Kings 13:8
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 13:9
text: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers. And they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoash his son reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 13:10
text: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria, sixteen years.

title: II Kings 13:11
text: And he did the evil in the sight of the LORD. He did not depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, [but] he walked in them.

title: II Kings 13:12
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoash, and all that he did, and his might which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 13:13
text: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and Jeroboam sat on his throne. And Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

title: II Kings 13:14
text: And Elisha had fallen sick with his illness in which he died. And Jehoash the king of Israel came down to him and wept over his face. And he said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel and the horsemen of it!

title: II Kings 13:15
text: And Elisha said to him, Take bow and arrows. And he took bow and arrows to himself.

title: II Kings 13:16
text: And he said to the king of Israel, Put your hand on the bow. And he placed his hand. And Elisha put his hands on the king's hands.

title: II Kings 13:17
text: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened. And Elisha said, Shoot! And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD's deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria. For you shall strike the Syrians in Aphek until it is finished.

title: II Kings 13:18
text: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took [them]. And he said to the king of Israel, Strike on the ground. And he struck three times and stopped.

title: II Kings 13:19
text: And the man of God was angry with him, and said, You should have stricken five or six times, then you would have stricken Syria until it was finished. But now you shall strike Syria three times.

title: II Kings 13:20
text: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at first of the year.

title: II Kings 13:21
text: And it happened as they were burying a man, behold, they spied a band. And they threw the man into the grave of Elisha. And the man went down and touched the bones of Elisha, and revived and stood up on his feet.

title: II Kings 13:22
text: But Hazael, the king of Syria, oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

title: II Kings 13:23
text: And the LORD was gracious to them, and had pity on them, and had respect to them, because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. And He would not destroy them, nor cast them from His presence as yet.

title: II Kings 13:24
text: And Hazael king of Syria died. And his son Ben-hadad reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 13:25
text: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz returned and took out of the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Jehoash beat him three times and recovered the cities of Israel.

title: II Kings 14:1
text: In the second year of Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah reigned.

title: II Kings 14:2
text: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

title: II Kings 14:3
text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father. He did according to all things that Joash his father did.

title: II Kings 14:4
text: Only, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

title: II Kings 14:5
text: And it happened when the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain his father the king;

title: II Kings 14:6
text: But he did not kill the sons of the servants, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, in which the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the sons, nor shall the sons be put to death for the fathers, but each shall be put to death for his own sin.

title: II Kings 14:7
text: He killed ten thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel until this day.

title: II Kings 14:8
text: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

title: II Kings 14:9
text: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle which [was] in Lebanon sent to the cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for a wife. And a beast of the field in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thistle.

title: II Kings 14:10
text: You have indeed stricken Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Rejoice and stay at home, for why should you meddle to [your] harm, so that you should fall, you and Judah with you?

title: II Kings 14:11
text: But Amaziah would not hear. And Jehoash king of Israel went up. And he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh, of Judah.

title: II Kings 14:12
text: And Judah was beaten before Israel. And every man fled to his tent.

title: II Kings 14:13
text: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and he came to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits.

title: II Kings 14:14
text: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels which were found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

title: II Kings 14:15
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 14:16
text: And Jehoash slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 14:17
text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

title: II Kings 14:18
text: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah?

title: II Kings 14:19
text: And they made a plot against him at Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. And they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

title: II Kings 14:20
text: And [they] brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.

title: II Kings 14:21
text: And all the people of Judah took Azariah who [was] sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

title: II Kings 14:22
text: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after the king slept with his fathers.

title: II Kings 14:23
text: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Jehoash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, forty-one years.

title: II Kings 14:24
text: And he did the evil in the sight of the LORD. He did not depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat who made Israel to sin.

title: II Kings 14:25
text: He restored the border of Israel from the entering of Hamath to the sea of the plain, according to the word of Jehovah God of Israel which He spoke by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, who [was] from Gath-hepher.

title: II Kings 14:26
text: For the LORD had seen the affliction of Israel [to be] very bitter. And one was bound, and none [was] free, and there was no helper for Israel.

title: II Kings 14:27
text: And the LORD did not say that He would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, but He saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Jehoash.

title: II Kings 14:28
text: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus and Hamath, of Judah, for Israel, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 14:29
text: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, with the kings of Israel. And his son Zachariah reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 15:1
text: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah the son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

title: II Kings 15:2
text: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Jecholiah of Jerusalem.

title: II Kings 15:3
text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

title: II Kings 15:4
text: Only, the high places were not removed. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

title: II Kings 15:5
text: And the LORD struck the king, so that he was a leper until the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. And the king's son, Jotham, [was] over the house, judging the people of the land.

title: II Kings 15:6
text: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah?

title: II Kings 15:7
text: And Azariah slept with his fathers. And they buried him with his fathers in the city of David. And his son Jotham reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 15:8
text: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria, six months.

title: II Kings 15:9
text: And he did the evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done. He did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

title: II Kings 15:10
text: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him. And he struck him before the people, and killed him, and reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 15:11
text: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they [are] written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel.

title: II Kings 15:12
text: This [was] the word of the LORD which He spoke to Jehu, saying, Your sons shall sit on the throne of Israel until the fourth [generation]. And it was so.

title: II Kings 15:13
text: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah. And he reigned in Samaria a full month.

title: II Kings 15:14
text: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria and struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria. And he killed him and reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 15:15
text: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and the conspiracy which he made, behold, they [are] written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel.

title: II Kings 15:16
text: Then Menahem struck Tiphsah, and all in it, and its borders, from Tirzah. Because they did not open, he struck it. He ripped up all its pregnant women.

title: II Kings 15:17
text: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel, ten years in Samaria.

title: II Kings 15:18
text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD. He did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, all his days.

title: II Kings 15:19
text: Pul, the king of Assyria came against the land. And Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver so that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

title: II Kings 15:20
text: And Menahem took the silver from Israel, from all the mighty men of wealth (fifty shekels of silver from each man) to give to the king of Assyria. And the king of Assyria turned back and did not stay there in the land.

title: II Kings 15:21
text: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 15:22
text: And Menahem slept with his fathers. And Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 15:23
text: In the fiftieth year of Uzziah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, two years.

title: II Kings 15:24
text: And he did the evil in the sight of the LORD. He did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

title: II Kings 15:25
text: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a commander of his, conspired against him and struck him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house, with Argob and Arieh, and fifty men of the Gileadites with him. And he killed him and reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 15:26
text: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they [are] written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel.

title: II Kings 15:27
text: In the fifty-second year of Uzziah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, twenty years.

title: II Kings 15:28
text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD. He did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

title: II Kings 15:29
text: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and he deported them Assyria.

title: II Kings 15:30
text: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a plot against Pekah the son of Remaliah. And he struck him and killed him and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

title: II Kings 15:31
text: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they [are] written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel.

title: II Kings 15:32
text: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, began to reign.

title: II Kings 15:33
text: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.

title: II Kings 15:34
text: And he did right in the sight of the LORD. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

title: II Kings 15:35
text: Only, the high places were not removed. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD.

title: II Kings 15:36
text: And the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah?

title: II Kings 15:37
text: In those days the LORD began to send Rezin the king of Syria against Judah, and also Pekah the son of Remaliah.

title: II Kings 15:38
text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father. And his son Ahaz reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 16:1
text: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

title: II Kings 16:2
text: Ahaz [was] twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And he did not do right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.

title: II Kings 16:3
text: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel. Yes, and he made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the sons of Israel.

title: II Kings 16:4
text: And he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

title: II Kings 16:5
text: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem for war. And they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome [him].

title: II Kings 16:6
text: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath. And the Syrians came to Elath and lived there until this day.

title: II Kings 16:7
text: And Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I [am] your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.

title: II Kings 16:8
text: And Ahaz took the silver and gold which was found in the house of the LORD and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent a present to the king of Assyria.

title: II Kings 16:9
text: And the king of Assyria listened to him, for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it. And he carried it away captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

title: II Kings 16:10
text: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria [at] Damascus. And [he] saw an altar at Damascus. And king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the pattern of the altar, and the form of it, according to all its work.

title: II Kings 16:11
text: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus. So Urijah the priest did until king Ahaz came in from Damascus.

title: II Kings 16:12
text: And the king came in from Damascus, and the king saw the altar. And the king approached to the altar and offered on it.

title: II Kings 16:13
text: And he offered his burnt offering and his food offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, on the altar.

title: II Kings 16:14
text: And he also brought the bronze altar which [was] before the LORD, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD, and put it on the north side of the altar.

title: II Kings 16:15
text: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, On the great altar burn the morning offering and the evening food offering, and the king's burnt sacrifice and his food offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their food offerings, and their drink offerings. And sprinkle all the blood of the burnt offerings on it, and all the blood of the sacrifice. And the bronze altar shall be for me to inquire by.

title: II Kings 16:16
text: And Urijah the priest did according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

title: II Kings 16:17
text: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from them. And he took down the sea from off the bronze oxen under it, and put it on a pavement of stones.

title: II Kings 16:18
text: And the covered way for the sabbath which they had built in the house, and the king's entry outside, he turned from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.

title: II Kings 16:19
text: And the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, [are] they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah?

title: II Kings 16:20
text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.

title: II Kings 17:1
text: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, nine years.

title: II Kings 17:2
text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, but not like the kings of Israel who were before him.

title: II Kings 17:3
text: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him. And Hoshea became his servant and gave him taxes.

title: II Kings 17:4
