text: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:22
text: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:23
text: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:24
text: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:25
text: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

title: I Chronicles 6:26
text: Elkanah; the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:27
text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:28
text: And the sons of Samuel: Joel, Vashni, the first-born, and Abijah.

title: I Chronicles 6:29
text: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzziah his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:30
text: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:31
text: And these [are] the men whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after the ark had rest.

title: I Chronicles 6:32
text: And they ministered before the dwelling-place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they waited on their office according to their order.

title: I Chronicles 6:33
text: And these [are] the ones who waited with their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

title: I Chronicles 6:34
text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

title: I Chronicles 6:35
text: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

title: I Chronicles 6:36
text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

title: I Chronicles 6:37
text: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

title: I Chronicles 6:38
text: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 6:39
text: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

title: I Chronicles 6:40
text: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

title: I Chronicles 6:41
text: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

title: I Chronicles 6:42
text: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

title: I Chronicles 6:43
text: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

title: I Chronicles 6:44
text: And their brothers the sons of Merari [stood] on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

title: I Chronicles 6:45
text: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

title: I Chronicles 6:46
text: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

title: I Chronicles 6:47
text: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

title: I Chronicles 6:48
text: And their brothers, the Levites, [were] appointed for all kinds of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

title: I Chronicles 6:49
text: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

title: I Chronicles 6:50
text: And these [are] the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:51
text: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:52
text: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:53
text: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:54
text: And these [are] their dwelling-places throughout their camps, within their borders, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, for the lot was theirs.

title: I Chronicles 6:55
text: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its open lands all around it.

title: I Chronicles 6:56
text: But the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

title: I Chronicles 6:57
text: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, and Libnah with its open lands, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with their open lands,

title: I Chronicles 6:58
text: and Hilen with its open lands, Debir with its open lands,

title: I Chronicles 6:59
text: and Ashan with its open lands, and Beth-shemesh with its open lands.

title: I Chronicles 6:60
text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its open lands, and Alemeth with its open lands, and Anathoth with its open lands. All their cities throughout their families [were] thirteen cities.

title: I Chronicles 6:61
text: And to the sons of Kohath left of the family of that tribe, cities were given out of the half tribe, the half of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

title: I Chronicles 6:62
text: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

title: I Chronicles 6:63
text: And to the sons of Merari [were given] by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

title: I Chronicles 6:64
text: And the sons of Israel gave these cities to the Levites, with their open lands.

title: I Chronicles 6:65
text: And they gave these cities which are called by their names, out of the tribe of the sons of Judah, and out of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin.

title: I Chronicles 6:66
text: And [some] of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

title: I Chronicles 6:67
text: And they gave to them for the cities of refuge, Shechem in Mount Ephraim, with its open lands, also Gezer with its open lands,

title: I Chronicles 6:68
text: and Jokmeam with its open lands, and Beth-horon with its open lands,

title: I Chronicles 6:69
text: and Aijalon with its open lands, and Gath-rimmon with its open lands.

title: I Chronicles 6:70
text: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its open lands, and Bileam with its open lands, for the family of the rest of the sons of Kohath.

title: I Chronicles 6:71
text: To the sons of Gershom [were given] out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its open lands, and Ashtaroth with its open lands.

title: I Chronicles 6:72
text: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its open lands, Daberath with its open lands,

title: I Chronicles 6:73
text: and Ramoth with its open lands, and Anem with its open lands were given.

title: I Chronicles 6:74
text: And out of the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its open lands, and Abdon with its open lands,

title: I Chronicles 6:75
text: and Hukok with its open lands, and Rehob with its open lands.

title: I Chronicles 6:76
text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its open lands, and Hammon with its open lands, and Kirjath-aim with its open lands.

title: I Chronicles 6:77
text: To the rest of the sons of Merari [were given] out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with its open lands, Tabor with its open lands.

title: I Chronicles 6:78
text: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan: out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness, with its open lands, and Jahzah with its open lands,

title: I Chronicles 6:79
text: and Kedemoth with its open lands, and Mephaath with its open lands.

title: I Chronicles 6:80
text: And out of the tribe of Gad they gave Ramoth in Gilead with its open lands, and Mahanaim with its open lands,

title: I Chronicles 6:81
text: and Heshbon with its open lands, and Jazer with its open lands.

title: I Chronicles 7:1
text: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, and Jashub, and Shimron, four.

title: I Chronicles 7:2
text: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers house, [these] to Tola, great men of might in their generations. Their number in the days of David [was] twenty-two thousand and six hundred.

title: I Chronicles 7:3
text: And the son of Uzzi was Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five. All of them chiefs.

title: I Chronicles 7:4
text: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, [were] bands of soldiers for war, thirty-six thousand men. For they had many wives and sons.

title: I Chronicles 7:5
text: And their brothers among all the families of Issachar [were] great men of might, being in all, by their genealogies, eighty-seven thousand.

title: I Chronicles 7:6
text: [The sons] of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

title: I Chronicles 7:7
text: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five heads of their fathers' house, mighty men of valor. And their genealogy, twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.

title: I Chronicles 7:8
text: And the sons of Becher: Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these [were] the sons of Becher.

title: I Chronicles 7:9
text: And their genealogy by their generations, heads of their fathers' house, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand and two hundred.

title: I Chronicles 7:10
text: And the son of Jediael was Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

title: I Chronicles 7:11
text: All these [were] the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand and two hundred men, going out to war for battle.

title: I Chronicles 7:12
text: And Shuppim, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.

title: I Chronicles 7:13
text: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

title: I Chronicles 7:14
text: The sons of Manasseh: Ashriel, the son born to his Syrian concubine with Machir the father of Gilead,

title: I Chronicles 7:15
text: and Machir took a wife for Huppim and for Shuppim; and the name of his sister [was] Maachah. And the name of the second [was] Zelophehad. And Zelophehad had daughters.

title: I Chronicles 7:16
text: And Maachah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh. And the name of his brother [was] Sheresh, and his sons [were] Ulam and Rakem.

title: I Chronicles 7:17
text: And the son of Ulam was Bedan. These [were] the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

title: I Chronicles 7:18
text: And his sister Hammoleketh bore Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

title: I Chronicles 7:19
text: And the sons of Shemida: Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Ahiam.

title: I Chronicles 7:20
text: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

title: I Chronicles 7:21
text: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead. And the men of Gath, natives in the land, killed them because they came down to take away their cattle.

title: I Chronicles 7:22
text: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

title: I Chronicles 7:23
text: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

title: I Chronicles 7:24
text: And his daughter [was] Sherah, who built Beth-horon the lower, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.

title: I Chronicles 7:25
text: And Rephah [was] his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

title: I Chronicles 7:26
text: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

title: I Chronicles 7:27
text: Non his son; Jehoshua his son.

title: I Chronicles 7:28
text: And their possessions and habitations: Bethel and its towns, and eastward to Naaran, and westward to Gezer, with its towns; and Shechem and its towns, to Gaza and its towns.

title: I Chronicles 7:29
text: And by the borders of the sons of Manasseh: Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these lived the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 7:30
text: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah; and Serah their sister.

title: I Chronicles 7:31
text: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel; he [is] the father of Birzavith.

title: I Chronicles 7:32
text: And Heber fathered Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

title: I Chronicles 7:33
text: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These [are] the sons of Japhlet.

title: I Chronicles 7:34
text: And the sons of Shamer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

title: I Chronicles 7:35
text: And the sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

title: I Chronicles 7:36
text: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

title: I Chronicles 7:37
text: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

title: I Chronicles 7:38
text: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

title: I Chronicles 7:39
text: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

title: I Chronicles 7:40
text: All these [were] the sons of Asher, heads of their fathers' house, choice, mighty warriors, heads of the rulers. And their enrollment in the warfare in the battle, their number [was] twenty-six thousand men.

title: I Chronicles 8:1
text: And Benjamin fathered Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

title: I Chronicles 8:2
text: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

title: I Chronicles 8:3
text: And the sons of Bela: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

title: I Chronicles 8:4
text: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

title: I Chronicles 8:5
text: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

title: I Chronicles 8:6
text: And these [are] the sons of Ehud, these are the heads of the fathers of the people of Geba; and they exiled them to Manahath.

title: I Chronicles 8:7
text: And Naaman and Ahiah and Gera, he exiled them. And Ehud fathered Uzza and Ahihud.

title: I Chronicles 8:8
text: And Shaharaim fathered [sons] in the land of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara [were] his wives.

title: I Chronicles 8:9
text: And by his wife Hodesh, [were] Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

title: I Chronicles 8:10
text: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These [were] his sons, heads of the fathers.

title: I Chronicles 8:11
text: And by Hushim he had Abitub, and Elpaal.

title: I Chronicles 8:12
text: The sons of Elpaal [were] Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono and Lod, with their towns.

title: I Chronicles 8:13
text: And Beriah and Shema [were] heads of the fathers of the people of Aijalon, who drove away the people of Gath;

title: I Chronicles 8:14
text: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

title: I Chronicles 8:15
text: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

title: I Chronicles 8:16
text: and Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah.

title: I Chronicles 8:17
text: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

title: I Chronicles 8:18
text: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab [were] the sons of Elpaal.

title: I Chronicles 8:19
text: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

title: I Chronicles 8:20
text: and Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

title: I Chronicles 8:21
text: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath [were] the sons of Shimhi.

title: I Chronicles 8:22
text: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

title: I Chronicles 8:23
text: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

title: I Chronicles 8:24
text: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah

title: I Chronicles 8:25
text: and Iphedeiah, and Penuel [were] the sons of Shashak.

title: I Chronicles 8:26
text: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

title: I Chronicles 8:27
text: and Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri [were] the sons of Jeroham.

title: I Chronicles 8:28
text: These [were] heads of the fathers, by their generations, chiefs. These lived in Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 8:29
text: And at Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, whose wife's name [was] Maachah.

title: I Chronicles 8:30
text: And his first-born son [was] Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

title: I Chronicles 8:31
text: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

title: I Chronicles 8:32
text: And Mikloth fathered Shimeah. And these also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, across from them.

title: I Chronicles 8:33
text: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul. And Saul fathered Jonathan, and Malchishua and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

title: I Chronicles 8:34
text: And the son of Jonathan [was] Meribbaal. And Meribbaal fathered Micah.

title: I Chronicles 8:35
text: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

title: I Chronicles 8:36
text: And Ahaz fathered Jehoadah. And Jehoadah fathered Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri fathered Moza.

title: I Chronicles 8:37
text: And Moza fathered Binea; Rapha [was] his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

title: I Chronicles 8:38
text: And Azel [had] six sons, and these their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these [were] the sons of Azel.

title: I Chronicles 8:39
text: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born; Jehush, the second; and Eliphelet, the third.

title: I Chronicles 8:40
text: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these [were] the sons of Benjamin.

title: I Chronicles 9:1
text: So all Israel enrolled themselves. And behold, they [were] written in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah was exiled to Babylon for their sins.

title: I Chronicles 9:2
text: And the first people in their possessions in their cities [were] the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the temple slaves.

title: I Chronicles 9:3
text: And in Jerusalem lived of the sons of Judah, and of the sons of Benjamin, and of the sons of Ephraim, and Manasseh:

title: I Chronicles 9:4
text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the sons of Pharez the son of Judah.

title: I Chronicles 9:5
text: And of the Shilonites, Asaiah the first-born and his sons.

title: I Chronicles 9:6
text: And of the sons of Zerah, Jeuel, and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.

title: I Chronicles 9:7
text: And of the sons of Benjamin, Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

title: I Chronicles 9:8
text: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah,

title: I Chronicles 9:9
text: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men [were] chief of the fathers to their fathers' house.

title: I Chronicles 9:10
text: And of the priests, Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

title: I Chronicles 9:11
text: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God,

title: I Chronicles 9:12
text: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer,

title: I Chronicles 9:13
text: and their brothers, heads of their fathers' house, seventeen hundred and sixty very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

title: I Chronicles 9:14
text: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari,

title: I Chronicles 9:15
text: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

title: I Chronicles 9:16
text: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

title: I Chronicles 9:17
text: And the gatekeepers [were] Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman; and their brothers, Shallum [was] the chief.

title: I Chronicles 9:18
text: And before they [were] at the king's gate eastward, they [were] gatekeepers in the companies of the sons of Levi.

title: I Chronicles 9:19
text: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of the house of his father, the Korahites, [were] over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle. And their fathers [were]  over the army of the LORD, keepers of the entry.

title: I Chronicles 9:20
text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar [was] the ruler over them in time past, [and] the LORD [was] with him.

title: I Chronicles 9:21
text: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah [was] gatekeeper of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: I Chronicles 9:22
text: All these chosen for gatekeepers in the gates [were] two hundred and twelve. These by their genealogies, in their villages, [were] the ones David and Samuel the seer ordained in their set office.

title: I Chronicles 9:23
text: So they and their sons [were] over the gates of the house of the LORD, the house of the tabernacle, by watches.

title: I Chronicles 9:24
text: The gatekeepers [were] to the four quarters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

title: I Chronicles 9:25
text: And their brothers in their villages, [were] to come in for seven days from time to time with them.

title: I Chronicles 9:26
text: For they [were] in faithfulness, the four chief gatekeepers; they [were] Levites, and were over the rooms, and over the treasuries of the house of God.

title: I Chronicles 9:27
text: And they lived around the house of God, because the duty [was] on them. And they [were] to open it morning by morning.

title: I Chronicles 9:28
text: And [certain] of them [were] over the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by count.

title: I Chronicles 9:29
text: Some of them also [were] appointed to oversee the vessels and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

title: I Chronicles 9:30
text: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

title: I Chronicles 9:31
text: And Mattithiah, of the Levites, who [was] the first-born of Shallum the Korahite, [was] faithful over the work of the pans.

title: I Chronicles 9:32
text: And others of the sons of the Kohathites, from among their brothers, [were] over the showbread, to prepare sabbath by sabbath.

title: I Chronicles 9:33
text: And these [were] the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites in the chambers, they [were] free of duty, for they were employed in that work day and night.

title: I Chronicles 9:34
text: These chief fathers of the Levites [were] chief throughout their generations. These lived at Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 9:35
text: And Jehiel, the father of Gibeon, lived in Gibeon. His wife's name [was] Maachah.

title: I Chronicles 9:36
text: And his first-born son [was] Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

title: I Chronicles 9:37
text: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

title: I Chronicles 9:38
text: And Mikloth fathered Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brothers at Jerusalem, across from their brothers.

title: I Chronicles 9:39
text: And Ner fathered Kish. And Kish fathered Saul. And Saul fathered Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

title: I Chronicles 9:40
text: And the son of Jonathan [was] Meribbaal. And Meribbaal fathered Micah.

title: I Chronicles 9:41
text: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz;

title: I Chronicles 9:42
text: and Ahaz; fathered Jarah. And Jarah fathered Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri fathered Moza.

title: I Chronicles 9:43
text: And Moza fathered Binea; and Rephaiah was his son; Eleasah, his son; Azel his son.

title: I Chronicles 9:44
text: And to Azel [were] six sons, and these their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. These [were] the sons of Azel.

title: I Chronicles 10:1
text: And the Philistines fought with Israel. And the men of Israel fled from the face of the Philistines, and fell down dead in Mount Gilboa.

title: I Chronicles 10:2
text: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons. And the Philistines killed Jonathan and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

title: I Chronicles 10:3
text: And the battle went sorely against Saul. And the archers hit him, and he was wounded by the archers.

title: I Chronicles 10:4
text: And Saul said to his armor-bearer, Draw your sword and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised ones come and abuse me. But his armor-bearer would not, for he was very much afraid. So Saul took a sword and fell on it.

title: I Chronicles 10:5
text: And his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, and he also fell on the sword and died.

title: I Chronicles 10:6
text: And Saul and his three sons died, and all his house died together.

title: I Chronicles 10:7
text: And all the men of Israel in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons had died. And they left their cities and fled. And the Philistines came and lived in them.

title: I Chronicles 10:8
text: And it happened on the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, and they found Saul and his sons fallen in Mount Gilboa.

title: I Chronicles 10:9
text: And they stripped him, and carried his head and his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry news to their idols and to the people.

title: I Chronicles 10:10
text: And they put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his skull in the temple of Dagon.

title: I Chronicles 10:11
text: And all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul.

title: I Chronicles 10:12
text: And all the mighty men arose and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

title: I Chronicles 10:13
text: And Saul died for his sin which he committed against the LORD, against the word of the LORD, which he did not keep, and also for seeking of a medium, to inquire, and

title: I Chronicles 10:14
text: inquired not of the LORD. And He killed him and turned the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.

title: I Chronicles 11:1
text: And all Israel gathered to David, to Hebron, saying, Behold, we [are] your bone and your flesh.

title: I Chronicles 11:2
text: And also in time past, even when Saul was king, you [were] the one who led out and brought in Israel. And the LORD your God said to you, You shall feed My people Israel, and you shall be ruler over My people Israel.

title: I Chronicles 11:3
text: And all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron. And David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. And they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.

title: I Chronicles 11:4
text: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus, where the Jebusites [were] the people of the land.

title: I Chronicles 11:5
text: And the people of Jebus said to David, You shall not come in here. But David took the stronghold of Zion, which [is] the city of David.

title: I Chronicles 11:6
text: And David said, Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first and was chief.

title: I Chronicles 11:7
text: And David lived in the stronghold. Therefore they called it the city of David.

title: I Chronicles 11:8
text: And he built the city all around, even from Millo all around. And Joab repaired the rest of the city.

title: I Chronicles 11:9
text: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of hosts [was] with him.

title: I Chronicles 11:10
text: And these [were] the chief of the mighty men whom David [had], making themselves strong with him in his kingdom, with all Israel to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

title: I Chronicles 11:11
text: And this [is] the number of the mighty men whom David [had]: Jashobeam, a Hachmonite, the chief of the captains. He lifted up his spear against three hundred, who were killed by him at one time.

title: I Chronicles 11:12
text: And after him [was] Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, he was one of the three mighty ones.

title: I Chronicles 11:13
text: He was with David at Pas-dammim. And there the Philistines were gathered together to battle and a portion of the field was full of barley. And the people fled from before the Philistines.

title: I Chronicles 11:14
text: And they set themselves in the midst of that place, and delivered it, and killed the Philistines. And the LORD saved [them] by a great deliverance.

title: I Chronicles 11:15
text: And three of the mighty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam. And the Philistine army camped in the Valley of the Giants.

title: I Chronicles 11:16
text: And David [was] then in the stronghold, and the Philistines garrison [was] then at Bethlehem.

title: I Chronicles 11:17
text: And David longed and said, Oh that someone would give me drink from the water of the well of Bethlehem, which [was] by the gate!

title: I Chronicles 11:18
text: And the three broke through the Philistine army and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem by the gate, and took [it], and brought [it] to David. But David would not drink it, but poured it out to the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 11:19
text: And he said, May my God forbid me to do this thing. Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in danger? For they brought it with their lives. And he [was] not willing to drink it. These three mighty ones did these things.

title: I Chronicles 11:20
text: And Abishai the brother of Joab [was] chief of the three. For lifting up his spear against three hundred, he killed them, and had a name among the three.

title: I Chronicles 11:21
text: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two for he was their captain. However, he did not attain the first three.

title: I Chronicles 11:22
text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a mighty man of Kabzeel, had done many acts. He killed two lion-like men of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in a pit on a snowy day.

title: I Chronicles 11:23
text: And he killed an Egyptian, a man of stature, five cubits high. And in the Egyptian's hand [was] a spear like a weaver's beam. And he went down to him with a staff and wrenched the spear out of the Egyptians hand, and killed him with his own spear.

title: I Chronicles 11:24
text: These [things] Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and had the name among the three mighty ones.

title: I Chronicles 11:25
text: Behold, he was honorable among the thirty, but did not attain the [first] three. And David set him over his court.

title: I Chronicles 11:26
text: And the mighty ones of the army: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

title: I Chronicles 11:27
text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

title: I Chronicles 11:28
text: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Ahiezer the Anathothite,

title: I Chronicles 11:29
text: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

title: I Chronicles 11:30
text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

title: I Chronicles 11:31
text: Ithai a son of Ribai of Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

title: I Chronicles 11:32
text: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

title: I Chronicles 11:33
text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

title: I Chronicles 11:34
text: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

title: I Chronicles 11:35
text: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

title: I Chronicles 11:36
text: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

title: I Chronicles 11:37
text: Hezro of Carmel, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

title: I Chronicles 11:38
text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

title: I Chronicles 11:39
text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

title: I Chronicles 11:40
text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

title: I Chronicles 11:41
text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

title: I Chronicles 11:42
text: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

title: I Chronicles 11:43
text: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

title: I Chronicles 11:44
text: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

title: I Chronicles 11:45
text: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

title: I Chronicles 11:46
text: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

title: I Chronicles 11:47
text: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

title: I Chronicles 12:1
text: And these [were] the ones who came to David to Ziklag, while banned from the face of Saul the son of Kish. And they [were] among the mighty men, helpers of the war,

title: I Chronicles 12:2
text: right and left-handed, armed with bows, with stones, and with arrows, with the bow from the brothers of Saul, of Benjamin

title: I Chronicles 12:3
text: The chief [was] Ahiezer, and Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite, and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth, and Berachah, and Jehu of Anathoth

title: I Chronicles 12:4
text: and Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty, and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

title: I Chronicles 12:5
text: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

title: I Chronicles 12:6
text: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

title: I Chronicles 12:7
text: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

title: I Chronicles 12:8
text: And of the Gadites mighty men separated themselves to David into the stronghold in the wilderness, men of the army for battle, setting in order shield and buckler, and their faces [were] the faces of a lion, and as gazelles on the heights for swiftness:

title: I Chronicles 12:9
text: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

title: I Chronicles 12:10
text: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

title: I Chronicles 12:11
text: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

title: I Chronicles 12:12
text: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

title: I Chronicles 12:13
text: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

title: I Chronicles 12:14
text: These [were] the sons of Gad, captains of the army. One of the least [was] over a hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

title: I Chronicles 12:15
text: These [were] they who went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks. And they put all those of the valleys to flight, toward the east and toward the west.

title: I Chronicles 12:16
text: And some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

title: I Chronicles 12:17
text: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, If you have come to me in peace, to help me, my heart shall be knit to you. But if you come to betray me to my enemies, since there is no wrong in my hands, let the God of our fathers look on it and rebuke it.

title: I Chronicles 12:18
text: And the Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the Thirty. [And he said], We [are] yours, David, and on your side, son of Jesse. Peace, peace be on you, and peace on your helpers. For your God has helped you. And David received them and made them captains of the band.

title: I Chronicles 12:19
text: And [some] from Manasseh fell to David when he came with the Philistines to battle against Saul. (But they did not help them. For the lords of the Philistines sent him away on advice, saying, He will fall to his master Saul with our heads.)

title: I Chronicles 12:20
text: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him these from Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of the thousands who [were] from Manasseh.

title: I Chronicles 12:21
text: And they helped David against the band, for they [were] all mighty men of power, and [were] commanders in the army.

title: I Chronicles 12:22
text: For at [that] time they came to David day by day to help him, until [it was] a great army, like an army of God.

title: I Chronicles 12:23
text: And these [were] the numbers of the chiefs of those armed for war who came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.

title: I Chronicles 12:24
text: The sons of Judah bearing shield and spear [were] six thousand and eight hundred, armed for war.

title: I Chronicles 12:25
text: From the sons of Simeon the mighty men of power for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

title: I Chronicles 12:26
text: From the sons of Levi [were] four thousand and six hundred.

title: I Chronicles 12:27
text: And Jehoiada [was] the leader of the Aaronites, and with him [were] three thousand and seven hundred.

title: I Chronicles 12:28
text: And Zadok, a young man mighty in power, and of his fathers' house [were] twenty-two captains.

title: I Chronicles 12:29
text: And the sons of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul [were] three thousand. And before, the most of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.

title: I Chronicles 12:30
text: And of the sons of Ephraim [were] twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

title: I Chronicles 12:31
text: And from the half tribe of Manasseh [were] eighteen thousand, who [were] chosen by name to come and make David king.

title: I Chronicles 12:32
text: And from the sons of Issachar, [men] who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, the heads of them [were] two hundred. And all their brothers [were] at their command.

title: I Chronicles 12:33
text: From Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all the weapons of war, fifty thousand who could keep rank. [They were] not of a double heart.

title: I Chronicles 12:34
text: And from Naphtali, a thousand captains; and with them with shield and spear [were] thirty-seven thousand.

title: I Chronicles 12:35
text: And of the Danites, expert in war, [were] twenty-eight thousand, six hundred.

title: I Chronicles 12:36
text: And of Asher, going out to the army to set in order the battle [were] forty thousand.

title: I Chronicles 12:37
text: And on the other side of Jordan, from the Reubenites, and of the Gadites, and from the half tribe of Manasseh, with all of the weapons of war for battle [were] a hundred and twenty thousand.

title: I Chronicles 12:38
text: All these [were] men of war, keeping rank, they came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over Israel. And also all the rest of Israel [was] of one heart to make David king.

title: I Chronicles 12:39
text: And they [were] with David three days, eating and drinking. For their brothers had prepared food for them.

title: I Chronicles 12:40
text: And also those who were near them, even to Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen. And they brought food, meal, cakes of figs and bunches of raisins, and wine and oil, and oxen and sheep abundantly. For there [was] joy in Israel.

title: I Chronicles 13:1
text: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, with every leader.

title: I Chronicles 13:2
text: And David said to all the congregation of Israel, If it is good to you, and if it has broken forth from the LORD our God, let us send to our brothers, those remaining in all the lands of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites in their cities that they be gathered to us.

title: I Chronicles 13:3
text: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us. For we did not inquire at it in the days of Saul.

title: I Chronicles 13:4
text: And all the congregation said to do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

title: I Chronicles 13:5
text: And David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even to the entering of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

title: I Chronicles 13:6
text: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, to Kirjath-jearim of Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, He who dwells between the cherubs, whose name is called on it.

title: I Chronicles 13:7
text: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab. And Uzza and Ahio led the cart.

title: I Chronicles 13:8
text: And David and all Israel played before God with all [their] might, and with singing, and with lyres, and with harps, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

title: I Chronicles 13:9
text: And when they came to the threshing-floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark for the oxen stumbled.

title: I Chronicles 13:10
text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and He struck him because he put his hand to the ark. And he died there before the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 13:11
text: And David was displeased because the LORD had made a break on Uzza. And he called that place The Breach of Uzza to this day.

title: I Chronicles 13:12
text: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God to me?

title: I Chronicles 13:13
text: And David did not bring the ark to himself to the City of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

title: I Chronicles 13:14
text: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that he had.

title: I Chronicles 14:1
text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timbers of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.

title: I Chronicles 14:2
text: And David saw that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted on high, because of His people Israel.

title: I Chronicles 14:3
text: And David took more wives at Jerusalem. And David fathered more sons and daughters.

title: I Chronicles 14:4
text: And these [were] the names of the children whom he [had] in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

title: I Chronicles 14:5
text: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

title: I Chronicles 14:6
text: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

title: I Chronicles 14:7
text: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

title: I Chronicles 14:8
text: And the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, and all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard, and went out against them.

title: I Chronicles 14:9
text: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the Valley of the Giants.

title: I Chronicles 14:10
text: And David asked of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? And will You deliver them into my hand? And the LORD said to him, Go up, for I will deliver them into your hand.

title: I Chronicles 14:11
text: And they came up to Baal-perazim. And David struck them there. Then David said, God has broken in on my enemies by my hand like the breaking forth of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place The Breaking of Baal.

title: I Chronicles 14:12
text: And they left their gods there. And David commanded, and they were burned with fire.

title: I Chronicles 14:13
text: And the Philistines still again made a raid in the valley.

title: I Chronicles 14:14
text: And David asked again of God. And God said to him, Do not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them over against the weeping trees.

title: I Chronicles 14:15
text: And it shall be, when you hear a sound of marching in the tops of the weeping trees, then you shall go out to battle. For God has gone forth before you to strike the army of the Philistines.

title: I Chronicles 14:16
text: And David did as God commanded him. And they struck the army of the Philistines from Gibeon to Gezer.

title: I Chronicles 14:17
text: And the name of David went out into all lands. And the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.

title: I Chronicles 15:1
text: And [David] made houses for himself in the City of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched a tent for it.

title: I Chronicles 15:2
text: Then David said, No one ought to carry the ark of God except the Levites, for God has chosen them to carry the ark of God, and to minister to Him forever.

title: I Chronicles 15:3
text: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD to its place which He had prepared for it.

title: I Chronicles 15:4
text: And David gathered the sons of Aaron, and the Levites.

title: I Chronicles 15:5
text: From the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and a hundred and twenty of his brothers.

title: I Chronicles 15:6
text: From the sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief, and two hundred and twenty of his brothers.

title: I Chronicles 15:7
text: From the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, and a hundred and thirty of his brothers.

title: I Chronicles 15:8
text: From the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief and two hundred of his brothers.

title: I Chronicles 15:9
text: From the sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief and eighty of his brothers.

title: I Chronicles 15:10
text: From the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief and a hundred and twelve of his brothers.

title: I Chronicles 15:11
text: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab.

title: I Chronicles 15:12
text: And he said to them, You [are] the heads of the fathers of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, you and your brothers, so that you may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel to the place which I have prepared for it.

title: I Chronicles 15:13
text: For because you did not do it at the first, the LORD our God made a break on us, since we did not seek Him in due order.

title: I Chronicles 15:14
text: And the priests and the Levites made themselves pure in order to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 15:15
text: And the sons of the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders, with the staves on it, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 15:16
text: And David spoke to the chief of the Levites to choose their brothers to be the singers with instruments of music, lyres, and harps, and cymbals, sounding by lifting the voice with joy.

title: I Chronicles 15:17
text: And the Levites chose Heman the son of Joel, and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah. And from the sons of Merari their brothers, was Ethan the son of Kushaiah.

title: I Chronicles 15:18
text: And with them [were] their brothers of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.

title: I Chronicles 15:19
text: And the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan [were chosen] to sound with cymbals of bronze;

title: I Chronicles 15:20
text: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with harps [set] to Alamoth.

title: I Chronicles 15:21
text: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, [were] to lead with lyres on the octave.

title: I Chronicles 15:22
text: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, [was] for song. He instructed about the song, because he [was] skillful.

title: I Chronicles 15:23
text: And Berechiah and Elkanah [were] gatekeepers for the ark.

title: I Chronicles 15:24
text: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew with the trumpets before the ark of God. And Obed-edom and Jehiah [were] gatekeepers for the ark.

title: I Chronicles 15:25
text: And it happened, David and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

title: I Chronicles 15:26
text: And it happened as God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they offered seven bulls and seven rams.

title: I Chronicles 15:27
text: And David [was] clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites who carried the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers. David also had on him an ephod of linen.

title: I Chronicles 15:28
text: And all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with harps and lyres.

title: I Chronicles 15:29
text: And it happened [as] the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the City of David, Michal the daughter of Saul, looking out a window, saw king David dancing and playing. And she despised him in her heart.

title: I Chronicles 16:1
text: And they brought the ark of God and set it in the middle of the tent which David had pitched for it. And they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

title: I Chronicles 16:2
text: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 16:3
text: And he divided to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread and a portion, and a raisin cake.

title: I Chronicles 16:4
text: And he appointed [certain] of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

title: I Chronicles 16:5
text: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom. And Jeiel praised with instruments of harps and with lyres; and Asaph made a sound with cymbals.

title: I Chronicles 16:6
text: Also Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests [praised] with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

title: I Chronicles 16:7
text: Then on that day David first delivered [this psalm] into the hand of Asaph and his brothers in order to thank the LORD:

title: I Chronicles 16:8
text: Give thanks to the LORD, call on His name, make known His deeds among the people.

title: I Chronicles 16:9
text: Sing to Him, sing psalms to Him, talk of all His wondrous works.

title: I Chronicles 16:10
text: Glory in His holy name, let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

title: I Chronicles 16:11
text: Seek the LORD and His strength; seek His face continually.

title: I Chronicles 16:12
text: Remember His marvelous works which He had done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,

title: I Chronicles 16:13
text: O seed of Israel His servant, sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.

title: I Chronicles 16:14
text: He [is] the LORD our God. His judgments [are] in all the earth.

title: I Chronicles 16:15
text: Be always mindful of His covenant, the word He commanded to a thousand generations,

title: I Chronicles 16:16
text: which He made with Abraham, and of His oath to Isaac.

title: I Chronicles 16:17
text: And He has confirmed the saying to Jacob for a law, to Israel [for] an everlasting covenant,

title: I Chronicles 16:18
text: saying, To you will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,

title: I Chronicles 16:19
text: when you were but few, even a few, and strangers in it,

title: I Chronicles 16:20
text: and they went from nation to nation, and from [one] kingdom to another people,

title: I Chronicles 16:21
text: He did not allow any man to do them wrong. Yea, He reproved kings for their sakes,

title: I Chronicles 16:22
text: saying, Touch not My anointed, and do My prophets no harm.

title: I Chronicles 16:23
text: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Show forth from day to day His salvation.

title: I Chronicles 16:24
text: Declare His glory among the heathen, His marvelous works among all nations.

title: I Chronicles 16:25
text: For great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also [is] to be feared above all gods.

title: I Chronicles 16:26
text: For all the gods of the peoples [are] idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

title: I Chronicles 16:27
text: Glory and honor [are] in His presence, strength and gladness in His place.

title: I Chronicles 16:28
text: Give to the LORD, O kindred of the people, give to the LORD glory and strength.

title: I Chronicles 16:29
text: Give to the LORD the glory of His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

title: I Chronicles 16:30
text: Tremble before Him, all the earth. Yea, the earth is established, it shall not be moved.

title: I Chronicles 16:31
text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. And let them say among the nations, The LORD reigns.

title: I Chronicles 16:32
text: Let the sea roar, and the fullness of it. Let the fields rejoice, and all [that is] in them.

title: I Chronicles 16:33
text: Then shall the trees of the forest sing out at the presence of the LORD, because He comes to judge the earth.

title: I Chronicles 16:34
text: O give thanks to the LORD, for [He is] good, for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: I Chronicles 16:35
text: And say, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us, and deliver us from the nations, so that we may give thanks to Your holy name, [and] glory in Your praise.

title: I Chronicles 16:36
text: Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel forever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 16:37
text: And he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, for Asaph and his brothers, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required;

title: I Chronicles 16:38
text: also Obed-edom, with their brothers, sixty-eight; and Obed-edom, the son of Jeduthun and Hosah [to be] gatekeepers.

title: I Chronicles 16:39
text: And he left Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place at Gibeon,

title: I Chronicles 16:40
text: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the burnt offering morning and evening without end, and [to do] according to all that is written in the law of the LORD which He commanded Israel.

title: I Chronicles 16:41
text: And [he left] with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were called by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because His mercy [endures] forever.

title: I Chronicles 16:42
text: And with them were Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those making a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun [were] gatekeepers.

title: I Chronicles 16:43
text: And all the people departed, each man to his house. And David returned to bless his house.

title: I Chronicles 17:1
text: And it happened as David sat in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in a house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD [is] under curtains.

title: I Chronicles 17:2
text: And Nathan said to David, Do all that [is] in your heart, for God [is] with you.

title: I Chronicles 17:3
text: And it happened the same night the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

title: I Chronicles 17:4
text: Go and tell David My servant, So says the LORD, You shall not build Me a house to dwell in.

title: I Chronicles 17:5
text: For I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel until today, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle [to another.]

title: I Chronicles 17:6
text: Wherever I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed My people, saying, Why have you not built Me a house of cedars?

title: I Chronicles 17:7
text: And now you shall say this to My servant David, So says the LORD of hosts, I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, so that you should be ruler over My people Israel.

title: I Chronicles 17:8
text: And I have been with you wherever you have walked, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a name like the name of the great men in the earth.

title: I Chronicles 17:9
text: And I will set a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall live in their place and shall be moved no more; nor shall the sons of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

title: I Chronicles 17:10
text: and since the time that I commanded judges to be over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. And I declare to you that the LORD will build you a house.

title: I Chronicles 17:11
text: And it will be, when your days have ended so that you must go [to be] with your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, who shall be from your sons. And I will make his kingdom sure.

title: I Chronicles 17:12
text: He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

title: I Chronicles 17:13
text: I will be his Father, and he shall be My son. And I will not take My mercy away from him as I took [it] from him who was before you.

title: I Chronicles 17:14
text: And I will settle him in My house, and in My kingdom forever. And his throne shall be established forever.

title: I Chronicles 17:15
text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

title: I Chronicles 17:16
text: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who [am] I, O, LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me here?

title: I Chronicles 17:17
text: And this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, for You have also spoken of Your servant's house for a great while to come, and have regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

title: I Chronicles 17:18
text: What can David [say] more to You for the honor of Your servant? For You know Your servant!

title: I Chronicles 17:19
text: O LORD, for Your servant's sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all this greatness, in making known all [these] great things.

title: I Chronicles 17:20
text: O LORD, [there is] none like You, neither [any] God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

title: I Chronicles 17:21
text: And what one nation in the earth [is] like Your people Israel, whom God went to redeem [to be] His own people, to make You a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before Your people whom You have redeemed out of Egypt?

title: I Chronicles 17:22
text: And You have chosen Your people Israel for Yourself, for a people forever. And You, LORD, became their God.

title: I Chronicles 17:23
text: And now, O LORD, let the thing which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house be established forever, and do as You have said.

title: I Chronicles 17:24
text: Let it even be established, so that Your name may be magnified forever, saying, The LORD of hosts [is] the God of Israel, a God to Israel. And [let] the house of David Your servant be established before You.

title: I Chronicles 17:25
text: For You, O my God, have told Your servant that You will build him a house. Therefore Your servant has found [in his heart] to pray before You.

title: I Chronicles 17:26
text: And now, LORD, You [are] God, and have promised this goodness to Your servant.

title: I Chronicles 17:27
text: And now let it please You to bless the house of Your servant so that it may be before You forever. For You have blessed, O LORD, and it [is] blessed forever.

title: I Chronicles 18:1
text: And it happened after this, David struck the Philistines and humbled them. And he took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

title: I Chronicles 18:2
text: And he struck Moab. And the people of Moab became David's servants and brought gifts.

title: I Chronicles 18:3
text: And David struck Hadarezer king of Zobah to Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

title: I Chronicles 18:4
text: And David took from him a thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen. David also hamstrung all the chariot [horses], but kept from them a hundred chariots.

title: I Chronicles 18:5
text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

title: I Chronicles 18:6
text: Then David placed [troops] in Syria, [in] Damascus. And the Syrians became David's servants, bringing gifts. And the LORD preserved David wherever he went.

title: I Chronicles 18:7
text: And David took the shields of gold which [were] on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 18:8
text: And David brought very much bronze from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

title: I Chronicles 18:9
text: And Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadarezer king of Zobah,

title: I Chronicles 18:10
text: he sent Hadoram his son to king David to ask of his welfare, and to praise him because he had fought against Hadarezer and had beaten him. For Hadarezer had war with Tou. And [he sent] all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

title: I Chronicles 18:11
text: And king David dedicated them to the LORD, with the silver and the gold which he brought from all the nations, from Edom, and from Moab, and from the sons of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

title: I Chronicles 18:12
text: And Abishai the son of Zeruiah killed eighteen thousand of the men of Edom in the Valley of Salt.

title: I Chronicles 18:13
text: And he put guards in Edom. And all the men of Edom [became] David's servants. And the LORD kept David safe wherever he went.

title: I Chronicles 18:14
text: And David reigned over all Israel, and did judgment and justice among all his people.

title: I Chronicles 18:15
text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah [was] over the army. And Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud [was] recorder.

title: I Chronicles 18:16
text: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar [were] the priests. And Shavsha [was] scribe.

title: I Chronicles 18:17
text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada [was] over the Cherethites and the Pelethites. And the sons of David [were] first ones at the hand of the king.

title: I Chronicles 19:1
text: And it happened after this, Nahash the king of the sons of Ammon died. And his son reigned in his place.

title: I Chronicles 19:2
text: And David said, I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David's servants came into the land of the sons of Ammon to Hanun, in order to comfort him.

title: I Chronicles 19:3
text: But the rulers of the sons of Ammon said to Hanun, Is David honoring your father in your eyes, because he has sent comforters to you? Have not his servants come to you to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land?

title: I Chronicles 19:4
text: And Hanun took David's servants and shaved them, and cut off their garments in half, to the buttocks, and sent them away.

title: I Chronicles 19:5
text: And [some] came and told David how the men were treated. And he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Stay at Jericho until your beards are grown, and [then] return.

title: I Chronicles 19:6
text: And the Ammonites saw that they had made themselves stink before David, and Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia and out of Maachah of Syria, and out of Zobah.

title: I Chronicles 19:7
text: And they hired thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people, who came and pitched before Medeba. And the Ammonites gathered themselves from their cities and came to battle.

title: I Chronicles 19:8
text: And David heard, and he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

title: I Chronicles 19:9
text: And the sons of Ammon came out and put the battle in order before the gate of the city. And the kings who had come [were] by themselves in the field.

title: I Chronicles 19:10
text: And Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, and he chose out of all the choice young men of Israel and set in order against the Syrians.

title: I Chronicles 19:11
text: And he delivered the rest of the people into the hand of his brother Abishai. And they set in order against the sons of Ammon.

title: I Chronicles 19:12
text: And he said, If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me. But if the sons of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

title: I Chronicles 19:13
text: Be of good courage and let us behave ourselves bravely for our people, and for the cities of our God. And let the LORD do what is good in His sight.

title: I Chronicles 19:14
text: And Joab and the people with him drew near before the Syrians to the battle. And they fled before him.

title: I Chronicles 19:15
text: And when the sons of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they also fled before his brother Abishai. And they entered into the city. And Joab came to Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 19:16
text: And the Syrians saw that they were beaten before Israel, and sent messengers and drew forth the Syrians who [were] beyond the river. And Shophach the captain of the army of Hadarezer went before them.

title: I Chronicles 19:17
text: And it was told to David. And he gathered all Israel and passed over Jordan and came on them. And he set in order against them. And David set in order against the Syrians, and they fought with him.

title: I Chronicles 19:18
text: But the Syrians fled before Israel. And David killed seven thousand of the Syrians [in] chariots, and forty thousand footmen; and he killed Shophach the commander of the army.

title: I Chronicles 19:19
text: And the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were beaten before Israel, and they made peace with David and became his servants. And Syria was not willing to help the sons of Ammon any more.

title: I Chronicles 20:1
text: And it happened after the year had ended, at the time kings go forth, Joab led out the power of the army and wasted the country of the sons of Ammon. And he came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. And Joab struck Rabbah and destroyed it.

title: I Chronicles 20:2
text: And David took the crown of their king from off his head and found its weight a talent of gold. And precious stones [were] in it. And it was set on David's head, and he also brought exceeding much spoil out of the city.

title: I Chronicles 20:3
text: And he brought out the people who [were] in it. And [they] sawed with saws and with sharp tools of iron, and with the axes. And so David did with the cities of the sons of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 20:4
text: And it happened after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbechai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the children of the giant. And they were humbled.

title: I Chronicles 20:5
text: And there was war again with the Philistines. And Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear [was] like a weavers' beam.

title: I Chronicles 20:6
text: And again there was a battle in Gath, and a man of stature was there, and his fingers and toes [were] twenty-four, six [on each hand] and six [on each foot]. And he also had been born son of the giant.

title: I Chronicles 20:7
text: But he cursed Israel, and Jonathan the son of Shimea, David's brother, killed him.

title: I Chronicles 20:8
text: These were born to the giant in Gath. And they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

title: I Chronicles 21:1
text: And Satan stood up against Israel and provoked David to take a census of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 21:2
text: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go number Israel from Beer-sheba to Dan. And bring the number of them to me so that I may know.

title: I Chronicles 21:3
text: And Joab answered, May the LORD add to His people a hundred times, but my lord the king, [are] they not all my lord's servants? Why then does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

title: I Chronicles 21:4
text: But the king's word prevailed against Joab. And Joab departed and went up and down all Israel, and came again to Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 21:5
text: And Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. And in all Israel there were one million and a hundred thousand men who drew sword. And in Judah [were] four hundred and seventy thousand men who drew sword.

title: I Chronicles 21:6
text: But Levi and Benjamin he did not count among them; for the king's word was evil to Joab.

title: I Chronicles 21:7
text: And it was evil in the eyes of God as to this thing. And He struck Israel.

title: I Chronicles 21:8
text: And David said to God, I have sinned greatly because I have done this thing. But now, I beseech You, remove the iniquity of Your servant for I have done very foolishly.

title: I Chronicles 21:9
text: And the LORD spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying,

title: I Chronicles 21:10
text: Go and speak to David, saying, So says the LORD: I offer you three [things]. Choose one of them so that I may do it to you.

title: I Chronicles 21:11
text: And Gad came to David and said to him, So says the LORD, Choose for yourself:

title: I Chronicles 21:12
text: either three years of famine, or three months to be swept away before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtake you, or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even the plague in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the border of Israel. And now say what word I shall bring again to Him who sent me.

title: I Chronicles 21:13
text: And David said to Gad, I am in great distress. Let me fall now into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies [are] very great. But do not let me fall into the hand of man.

title: I Chronicles 21:14
text: And the LORD sent a plague on Israel. And there fell seventy thousand men of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 21:15
text: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. And as he was destroying, the LORD looked. And He repented of the evil and said to the angel who destroyed, Enough! Stay your hand now! And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

title: I Chronicles 21:16
text: And David lifted up his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between the earth and the heavens, and his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem. And David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

title: I Chronicles 21:17
text: And David said to God, Did not I command to number the people? I am the one who has sinned and done evil indeed. But these sheep, what have they done? I pray You, let Your hand be on me, O LORD my God, and on my father's house, but not on Your people, that they should be plagued.

title: I Chronicles 21:18
text: And the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David that David should go up and set up an altar to the LORD in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

title: I Chronicles 21:19
text: And David went up at the word of Gad which he spoke in the name of the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 21:20
text: And Ornan turned back and saw the angel. And his four sons with him hid themselves. And Ornan was threshing wheat.

title: I Chronicles 21:21
text: And David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David. And he went out of the threshing-floor and bowed to David with his face to the ground.

title: I Chronicles 21:22
text: Then David said to Ornan, Give me the place of this threshing-floor, so that I may build an altar in it to the LORD. You shall give it to me for the full price, so that the plague may be stayed from the people.

title: I Chronicles 21:23
text: And Ornan said to David, Take for yourself, and let my lord the king do what is good in his eyes. Lo, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the food offering. I give it all.

title: I Chronicles 21:24
text: And king David said to Ornan, No, but I will truly buy it for the full silver. For I will not take what [is] yours for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

title: I Chronicles 21:25
text: And David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

title: I Chronicles 21:26
text: And David built an altar there to the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD. And He answered him from Heaven by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

title: I Chronicles 21:27
text: And the LORD commanded the angel, and he put up his sword again into its sheath.

title: I Chronicles 21:28
text: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

title: I Chronicles 21:29
text: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, [were] at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

title: I Chronicles 21:30
text: But David could not go before it to ask of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 22:1
text: Then David said, This [is] the house of the LORD God, and this [is] the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

title: I Chronicles 22:2
text: And David commanded the strangers in the land of Israel to be gathered. And he set masons to cut squared stones to build the house of God.

title: I Chronicles 22:3
text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

title: I Chronicles 22:4
text: and also cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the Tyrians brought in cedar trees in abundance to David.

title: I Chronicles 22:5
text: And David said, Solomon my son [is] young and tender, and the house to be built for the LORD is to be highly magnificent, for a name and for beauty to all the lands. I will now prepare for it. And David prepared abundantly before his death.

title: I Chronicles 22:6
text: And he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD God of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 22:7
text: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

title: I Chronicles 22:8
text: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, You have shed much blood and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to My name because you have shed much blood on the earth in My sight.

title: I Chronicles 22:9
text: Behold, a son shall be born to you who shall be a man of rest. And I will give him rest from all his enemies all around. For his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

title: I Chronicles 22:10
text: He shall build a house for My name. And he shall be My son, and I [will be] his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.

title: I Chronicles 22:11
text: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and bless you, and build the house of the LORD your God as He has said of you.

title: I Chronicles 22:12
text: Only may the LORD give you wisdom and understanding, and direct you concerning Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.

title: I Chronicles 22:13
text: Then you shall prosper, if you take heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments with which the LORD charged Moses, concerning Israel. Be strong and of good courage. Do not fear, nor be dismayed.

title: I Chronicles 22:14
text: And, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a million talents of silver, and of bronze and iron without weight, for it is in abundance. I have prepared timber also, and stone, and you may add to them.

title: I Chronicles 22:15
text: And there [are] many workmen with you, cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of skillful men for every kind of work.

title: I Chronicles 22:16
text: Of the gold, the silver, and the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.

title: I Chronicles 22:17
text: And David commanded all the rulers of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

title: I Chronicles 22:18
text: Is not the LORD your God with you? And has He not given you rest on every side? For He has given the people of the land into my hand. And the land is humbled before the LORD and before His people.

title: I Chronicles 22:19
text: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God. Arise therefore and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 23:1
text: And David was old and full of days, and he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

title: I Chronicles 23:2
text: And [he] gathered all the rulers of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

title: I Chronicles 23:3
text: And the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward. And their number by their heads, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

title: I Chronicles 23:4
text: Of these, twenty-four thousand [were] to set forward the work of the house of the LORD, and six thousand officers and judges.

title: I Chronicles 23:5
text: And four thousand [were] gatekeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which [David] made for praising.

title: I Chronicles 23:6
text: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

title: I Chronicles 23:7
text: Of the men of Gershon [were] Laadan and Shimei.

title: I Chronicles 23:8
text: The sons of Laadan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

title: I Chronicles 23:9
text: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These [were] the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

title: I Chronicles 23:10
text: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four [were] the sons of Shimei.

title: I Chronicles 23:11
text: And Jahath [was] the chief, and Zizah the second. But Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons. Therefore they were in one roster, according to [their] father's house.

title: I Chronicles 23:12
text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

title: I Chronicles 23:13
text: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was separated so that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to Him, and to bless in His name forever.

title: I Chronicles 23:14
text: And [as to] Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

title: I Chronicles 23:15
text: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

title: I Chronicles 23:16
text: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel [was] the chief.

title: I Chronicles 23:17
text: And the sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

title: I Chronicles 23:18
