text: Of the sons of Izhar, Shelomith [was] the chief;

title: I Chronicles 23:19
text: of the sons of Hebron, Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

title: I Chronicles 23:20
text: Of the sons of Uzziel, Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

title: I Chronicles 23:21
text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

title: I Chronicles 23:22
text: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but had daughters. And their brothers, the sons of Kish, took them.

title: I Chronicles 23:23
text: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

title: I Chronicles 23:24
text: These [were] the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers, the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their heads, the ones who did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.

title: I Chronicles 23:25
text: For David said, The LORD God of Israel has given rest to His people so that they may dwell in Jerusalem forever,

title: I Chronicles 23:26
text: and also to the Levites, so that they shall no [more] carry the tabernacle, nor any of its vessels for its service.

title: I Chronicles 23:27
text: For by the last words of David the Levites [were] numbered from twenty years old and above,

title: I Chronicles 23:28
text: because their office [was] to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God

title: I Chronicles 23:29
text: both for the showbread, and for the fine flour for food offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all kinds of measure and size,

title: I Chronicles 23:30
text: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at evening.

title: I Chronicles 23:31
text: And [they] were to offer all burnt sacrifices to the LORD in the sabbath, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded to them, continually before the LORD,

title: I Chronicles 23:32
text: and that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the Holy Place, and the charge of their brothers, the sons of Aaron, in the service of the house of the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 24:1
text: And the divisions of the sons of Aaron [were]: The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

title: I Chronicles 24:2
text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons. And Eleazar and Ithamar were priests.

title: I Chronicles 24:3
text: And David distributed them according to their offices in their service, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar.

title: I Chronicles 24:4
text: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar. And so they were divided. Among the sons of Eleazar [were] sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

title: I Chronicles 24:5
text: So they divided them by lot, one sort with another. For the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

title: I Chronicles 24:6
text: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the rulers, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and [before] the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites. One principal household was taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

title: I Chronicles 24:7
text: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

title: I Chronicles 24:8
text: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

title: I Chronicles 24:9
text: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

title: I Chronicles 24:10
text: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

title: I Chronicles 24:11
text: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

title: I Chronicles 24:12
text: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

title: I Chronicles 24:13
text: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

title: I Chronicles 24:14
text: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

title: I Chronicles 24:15
text: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

title: I Chronicles 24:16
text: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

title: I Chronicles 24:17
text: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

title: I Chronicles 24:18
text: the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

title: I Chronicles 24:19
text: These [were] their orderings in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, to Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

title: I Chronicles 24:20
text: And the rest of the sons of Levi: Of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

title: I Chronicles 24:21
text: Concerning Rehabiah, of the sons of Rehabiah, the first [was] Isshiah.

title: I Chronicles 24:22
text: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

title: I Chronicles 24:23
text: And the sons [of Hebron]: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

title: I Chronicles 24:24
text: [Of] the sons of Uzziel, Michah. Of the sons of Michah, Shamir.

title: I Chronicles 24:25
text: The brother of Michah [was] Isshiah. Of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

title: I Chronicles 24:26
text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Jaaziah, Beno.

title: I Chronicles 24:27
text: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

title: I Chronicles 24:28
text: Of Mahli [was] Eleazar, who had no sons.

title: I Chronicles 24:29
text: Of Kish, the son of Kish [was] Jerahmeel.

title: I Chronicles 24:30
text: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These [were] the sons of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

title: I Chronicles 24:31
text: And they also cast lots along with their brothers, the sons of Aaron, before David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, the head of the fathers, as well as his younger brother.

title: I Chronicles 25:1
text: And David and the army commanders separated to the service those of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who [were] prophets with lyres and with cymbals. And the number of the workmen according to their service was:

title: I Chronicles 25:2
text: of the sons of Asaph, Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons under the hands of Asaph, who prophesied according to the order of the king.

title: I Chronicles 25:3
text: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, [and Shimei], six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the lyre to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 25:4
text: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Josh-bekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.

title: I Chronicles 25:5
text: All these [were] the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

title: I Chronicles 25:6
text: All these [were] under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, harps and lyres, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

title: I Chronicles 25:7
text: So the number of them, with their brothers who [were] instructed in the songs of the LORD, all that [were] skillful, was two hundred and eighty-eight.

title: I Chronicles 25:8
text: And they cast lots, for duty, the small as well as the great, the teacher as the pupil.

title: I Chronicles 25:9
text: And the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second was to Gedaliah, with his brothers and sons, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:10
text: the third [was] to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve men;

title: I Chronicles 25:11
text: the fourth [was] to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:12
text: the fifth [was] to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:13
text: the sixth [was] to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:14
text: the seventh [was] to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:15
text: the eighth [was] to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:16
text: the ninth [was] to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:17
text: the tenth [was] to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:18
text: the eleventh [was] to Azareel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:19
text: the twelfth [was] to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:20
text: the thirteenth [was] to Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:21
text: the fourteenth [was] to Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:22
text: the fifteenth [was] to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve,

title: I Chronicles 25:23
text: the sixteenth [was] to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:24
text: the seventeenth [was] to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:25
text: the eighteenth [was] to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:26
text: the nineteenth [was] to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:27
text: the twentieth [was] to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:28
text: the twenty-first [was] to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:29
text: the twenty-second [was] to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:30
text: the twenty-third [was] to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

title: I Chronicles 25:31
text: the twenty-fourth [was] to Romamti-ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 26:1
text: For the divisions of the gatekeepers: Of the Korhites: Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

title: I Chronicles 26:2
text: And the sons of Meshelemiah: Zechariah the first-born, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

title: I Chronicles 26:3
text: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

title: I Chronicles 26:4
text: And the sons of Obed-edom: Shemaiah the first-born, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

title: I Chronicles 26:5
text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth-- for God blessed him.

title: I Chronicles 26:6
text: Also sons [were] born to his son Shemaiah, who ruled for the house of their father, for they [were] mighty men of valor.

title: I Chronicles 26:7
text: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brothers [were] strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

title: I Chronicles 26:8
text: All these [were] the sons of Obed-edom. They and their sons and their brothers [were] able men for strength for the service, and there [were] sixty-two of Obed-edom.

title: I Chronicles 26:9
text: And Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, strong men, eighteen.

title: I Chronicles 26:10
text: Also to Hosah, of the sons of Merari, [were] sons: Simri was the chief ([though] not the first-born, yet his father made him the chief),

title: I Chronicles 26:11
text: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah [were] thirteen.

title: I Chronicles 26:12
text: among these [were] the divisions of the gatekeepers, among the chief men, having charges like their brothers, to minister in the house of the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 26:13
text: And they cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

title: I Chronicles 26:14
text: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah; then Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots. And his lot came out northward.

title: I Chronicles 26:15
text: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse;

title: I Chronicles 26:16
text: to Shuppim and Hosah westward, with the gate of Shallecheth, by the highway going up, guard corresponding to guard.

title: I Chronicles 26:17
text: Eastward [were] six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward the storehouse, two by two.

title: I Chronicles 26:18
text: At the Parbar, westward, four at the highway, two at the Parbar.

title: I Chronicles 26:19
text: These are the divisions of the gatekeepers among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

title: I Chronicles 26:20
text: And of the Levites, Ahijah [was] over the treasures of the house of God and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

title: I Chronicles 26:21
text: The sons of Laadan, sons of the Gershonites; chief fathers of Laadan the Gershonite: Jehieli;

title: I Chronicles 26:22
text: the sons of Jehieli: Zetham and Joel his brother, [who were] over the treasures of the house of the LORD,

title: I Chronicles 26:23
text: for the Amramites, [and] the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites.

title: I Chronicles 26:24
text: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, [was] ruler of the treasures.

title: I Chronicles 26:25
text: And his brothers by Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

title: I Chronicles 26:26
text: This Shelomith and his brothers [were] over all the treasures of the holy things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the commanders over thousands and hundreds, and the commanders of the army, had given.

title: I Chronicles 26:27
text: They dedicated [part of] the spoils won in battles, to maintain the house of the LORD,

title: I Chronicles 26:28
text: and all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated. Whoever had dedicated [anything, it was] at the hand of Shelomith and of his brothers.

title: I Chronicles 26:29
text: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons [were] for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

title: I Chronicles 26:30
text: Of the men of Hebron, Hashabiah and his brothers, men of valor, a thousand and seven hundred, [were] officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.

title: I Chronicles 26:31
text: Jerijah [was] the chief among the men of Hebron. He was of the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valor at Jazer of Gilead.

title: I Chronicles 26:32
text: And his brothers, mighty men, [were] two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers whom king David made rulers over the men of Reuben, of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter having to do with God and the affairs of the king.

title: I Chronicles 27:1
text: And the sons of Israel according to their number, the chief fathers and commanders of thousands and hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions, who came in and went out month by month for all the months of the year, [were] twenty-four thousand of every division.

title: I Chronicles 27:2
text: Over the first division for the first month [was] Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:3
text: Of the sons of Perez [was] the chief of all the commanders of the army for the first month.

title: I Chronicles 27:4
text: And over the division of the second month [was] Dodai the Ahohite, and of his division Mikloth [was] also the ruler. In his division also [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:5
text: The third commander of the army for the third month [was] Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:6
text: This [is that] Benaiah who [was] mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty. And in his division [was] Ammizabad his son.

title: I Chronicles 27:7
text: The fourth for the fourth month [was] Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:8
text: The fifth commander for the fifth month [was] Shamhuth the Izrahite. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:9
text: The sixth for the sixth month [was] Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:10
text: The seventh for the seventh month [was] Helez the Pelonite, of the sons of Ephraim. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:11
text: The eighth for the eighth month [was] Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:12
text: The ninth for the ninth month [was] Abiezer the Anethothite, of the Benjamites. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:13
text: The tenth for the tenth month [was] Maharai of Netopha, of the Zerahites. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:14
text: The eleventh for the eleventh month [was] Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the sons of Ephraim. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:15
text: The twelfth for the twelfth month [was] Heldai of Netopha, of Othniel. And in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:16
text: And over the tribes of Israel, the ruler of the Reubenites [was] Eliezer the son of Zichri. The ruler of the Simeonites [was] Shephatiah the son of Maachah.

title: I Chronicles 27:17
text: The ruler of the Levites was Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; over the Aaronites [was] Zadok.

title: I Chronicles 27:18
text: Over Judah [was] Elihu, of the brothers of David. The ruler of Issachar [was] Omri the son of Michael.

title: I Chronicles 27:19
text: The ruler of Zebulun [was] Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah. The ruler of Naphtali [was] Jerimoth the son of Azriel.

title: I Chronicles 27:20
text: The ruler of the sons of Ephraim [was] Hoshea the son of Azaziah. The ruler of the half tribe of Manasseh [was] Joel the son of Pedaiah.

title: I Chronicles 27:21
text: The ruler of the [half] tribe of Manasseh in Gilead [was] Iddo the son of Zechariah. The ruler of Benjamin [was] Jaasiel the son of Abner.

title: I Chronicles 27:22
text: [The ruler] of Dan [was] Azareel the son of Jeroham. These [were] the rulers of the tribes of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 27:23
text: But David did not take the number of those from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said [He would] increase Israel like the stars of the heavens.

title: I Chronicles 27:24
text: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he did not finish because wrath fell against the sons of Israel for this. And the number did not go up in the account of the chronicles of king David.

title: I Chronicles 27:25
text: And over the king's treasures [was] Azmaveth the son of Adiel. And over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the strongholds, [was] Jehonathan the son of Uzziah.

title: I Chronicles 27:26
text: Ezri the son of Chelub [was] over the work of the field for farming the ground.

title: I Chronicles 27:27
text: And over the vineyards [was] Shimei of Ramah. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars [was] Zabdi the Shiphmite.

title: I Chronicles 27:28
text: And over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that [were] in the low plains [was] Baal-hanan of Geder. And over the cellars of oil [was] Joash.

title: I Chronicles 27:29
text: And over the herds that fed in Sharon [was] Shitrai of Sharon. And over the herds in the valleys [was] Shaphat the son of Adlai.

title: I Chronicles 27:30
text: Over the camels also [was] Obil the Ishmaelite. And over the asses [was] Jehdeiah the Meronothite.

title: I Chronicles 27:31
text: And over the flocks [was] Jaziz the son of Hagar. All these [were] the rulers of the substance which [was] king David's.

title: I Chronicles 27:32
text: And Jonathan, David's uncle, [was] an adviser, a wise man and a scribe. And Jehiel the son of Hachmoni [was] with the king's sons.

title: I Chronicles 27:33
text: And Ahithophel [was] the king's counselor. And Hushai the Archite [was] the king's companion.

title: I Chronicles 27:34
text: And after Ahithophel [was] Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. And the general of the king's army [was] Joab.

title: I Chronicles 28:1
text: And David gathered to Jerusalem all the rulers of Israel, the rulers of the tribes, and the commanders of the divisions that ministered to the king by division, and the commanders over the thousands, and commanders over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the eunuchs and the mighty ones, even to every mighty one of valor.

title: I Chronicles 28:2
text: And David the king stood up on his feet and said, Hear me, my brothers and my people. I [had] in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building.

title: I Chronicles 28:3
text: But God said to me, You shall not build a house for My name, because you [have been] a man of war and have shed blood.

title: I Chronicles 28:4
text: But the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For He has chosen Judah to be the ruler, and of the house of Judah the house of my father. And in my father's house He was pleased to make me king over all Israel.

title: I Chronicles 28:5
text: And of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), He has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

title: I Chronicles 28:6
text: And He said to me, Solomon your son shall build My house and My courts, for I have chosen him [to be] My son, and I will be his Father.

title: I Chronicles 28:7
text: And I will establish his kingdom forever if he will always do My commandments and My judgments, as at this day.

title: I Chronicles 28:8
text: And now in the sight of all Israel, the congregation of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God, so that you may possess this good land and leave [it] for an inheritance for your sons after you forever.

title: I Chronicles 28:9
text: And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind. For the LORD searches all hearts and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek Him, He will be found by you. But if you forsake Him, He will cast you off forever.

title: I Chronicles 28:10
text: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong and do [it].

title: I Chronicles 28:11
text: And David gave to his son Solomon the pattern of the porch, and of its houses, and of its treasuries, and of its upper rooms, and of its innermost rooms, and of the place of the mercy-seat,

title: I Chronicles 28:12
text: and the pattern of all that he had by the Spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the rooms all around the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the holy things;

title: I Chronicles 28:13
text: And for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD;

title: I Chronicles 28:14
text: even gold by weight for [things] of gold, for all instruments of every kind of service; silver for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels every kind of service;

title: I Chronicles 28:15
text: and by weight for the lampstands of gold, and for their lamps of gold, with the weight of each lampstand and its lamps. And he gave for the lampstands of silver by weight, for the lampstand and for its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;

title: I Chronicles 28:16
text: and by weight gold for the tables of the showbread, for every table; silver for the tables of silver;

title: I Chronicles 28:17
text: and pure gold for the flesh-hooks, and the bowls, and the cups; and for the golden basins by weight for each basin, and by weight for each basin of silver;

title: I Chronicles 28:18
text: and the altar of incense refined gold by weight, and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubs, who spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 28:19
text: All [was] in writing from the hand of the LORD. He made me understand all the work of this pattern.

title: I Chronicles 28:20
text: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do [it]. Do not fear, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, my God, [will be] with you. He will not fail you nor leave you until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.

title: I Chronicles 28:21
text: And, behold, the divisions of the priests and the Levites are for all the service of the house of God. And [there shall be] with you every willing skillful man for every kind of workmanship, for any kind of service. Also the rulers and all the people will be according to all your words.

title: I Chronicles 29:1
text: And David the king said to all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, [is] young and tender, and the work [is] great. For the palace [is] not for man, but for the LORD God.

title: I Chronicles 29:2
text: And I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for [things of] gold, and the silver for [things] of silver, and the bronze for [things] of bronze, the iron for [things] of iron, and wood for [ things] of wood, onyx stones, and [stones to] be set, and also stones of antimony, and stones of many colors, and every precious stone, and stones of alabaster, in abundance.

title: I Chronicles 29:3
text: And also, because I have delighted in the house of my God, out of my own treasure of gold and silver I have given to the house of my God over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

title: I Chronicles 29:4
text: three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses;

title: I Chronicles 29:5
text: the gold for [things] of gold, and the silver for [things] of silver, and for all kinds of work by the hands of skillful workers. And who [is] willing to consecrate his service this day to the LORD?

title: I Chronicles 29:6
text: And the chiefs of the fathers, and the rulers of the tribes of Israel, and the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly.

title: I Chronicles 29:7
text: And they gave for the service of the house of God five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand darics, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

title: I Chronicles 29:8
text: And he [who had] precious stones gave to the treasury of the house of the LORD by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

title: I Chronicles 29:9
text: And the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD. And David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

title: I Chronicles 29:10
text: And David blessed the LORD before all the congregation. And David said, Blessed [are] You, LORD God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

title: I Chronicles 29:11
text: O LORD, Yours [is] the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and, the majesty. For all in the heavens and in the earth [is Yours]. Yours [is] the kingdom, O LORD, and You lift up [Yourself] to all as Head.

title: I Chronicles 29:12
text: And the riches and the honor [are] from You, and You reign over all. And in Your hand [is] power and might. And [it is] in Your hand to make great and to give strength to all.

title: I Chronicles 29:13
text: And now, our God, we thank You and praise Your glorious name.

title: I Chronicles 29:14
text: But who [am] I, and who my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? For all things [are] from You, and we have given to You that which is Yours.

title: I Chronicles 29:15
text: For we [are] strangers before You, and pilgrims, as our fathers [were]. Our days on the earth [are] like a shadow, and none abides.

title: I Chronicles 29:16
text: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy name [comes] from Your hand, and is all Your own.

title: I Chronicles 29:17
text: I know also, my God, that You try the heart, and have pleasure in uprightness. I, in the uprightness of my heart, have willingly offered all these things. And now I have seen with joy Your people who are present here to offer willingly to You.

title: I Chronicles 29:18
text: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this forever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of Your people, and prepare their heart to You.

title: I Chronicles 29:19
text: And give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep Your commandments, Your testimonies, and Your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the magnificent house [for] which I have made ready.

title: I Chronicles 29:20
text: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God! And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed and worshiped the LORD, and [bowed] to the king.

title: I Chronicles 29:21
text: And they sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD, and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

title: I Chronicles 29:22
text: And they ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed [him] before the LORD as ruler, and Zadok [to be] as priest.

title: I Chronicles 29:23
text: And Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of David his father. And he was blessed, and all Israel obeyed him.

title: I Chronicles 29:24
text: And all the rulers and the mighty men, and also all the sons of king David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

title: I Chronicles 29:25
text: And the LORD made Solomon very great in the sight of all Israel, and placed on him [such] royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

title: I Chronicles 29:26
text: And David, the son of Jesse, reigned over all Israel.

title: I Chronicles 29:27
text: And the time that he reigned over Israel [was] forty years. He reigned seven years in Hebron, and thirty-three [years] in Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 29:28
text: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor. And Solomon his son reigned in his place.

title: I Chronicles 29:29
text: And the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

title: I Chronicles 29:30
text: with all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the lands.

title: II Chronicles 1:1
text: And Solomon the son of David was made strong in his kingdom, and the LORD his God [was] with him and made him very great.

title: II Chronicles 1:2
text: And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

title: II Chronicles 1:3
text: And Solomon and all the congregation with him went to the high place at Gibeon. For there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

title: II Chronicles 1:4
text: But the ark of God David had brought up from Kirjath-jearim to the place which David had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 1:5
text: And he put the bronze altar which Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made before the tabernacle of the LORD. And Solomon and the congregation of the LORD sought to it.

title: II Chronicles 1:6
text: And Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the LORD, which [was] at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

title: II Chronicles 1:7
text: In that night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, Ask what I shall give you.

title: II Chronicles 1:8
text: And Solomon said to God, You have shown great mercy to David my father, and have made me to reign in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 1:9
text: Now, O LORD God, Your promise to David my father has been fulfilled. For You have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

title: II Chronicles 1:10
text: Give me now wisdom and knowledge that I may go out and come in before this people. For who can judge this Your great people?

title: II Chronicles 1:11
text: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, nor honor, nor the life of your enemies, nor yet have asked for long life but have asked wisdom and knowledge for yourself that you may judge My people, over whom I have made you king.

title: II Chronicles 1:12
text: wisdom and knowledge [is] granted to you. And I will give you riches and wealth and honor, such as none of the kings have had that have been before you, nor shall any after you have the like.

title: II Chronicles 1:13
text: And Solomon came [from] the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

title: II Chronicles 1:14
text: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. And he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 1:15
text: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem like stones, and he made cedar trees as plentiful as the sycamore trees in the valley.

title: II Chronicles 1:16
text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt and Kue. The king's merchants received [them] from Kue at a price.

title: II Chronicles 1:17
text: And they carried up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred [shekels] of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. And so they brought out [horses] for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their hands.

title: II Chronicles 2:1
text: And Solomon purposed to build a house for the name of the LORD, and a house for his kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 2:2
text: And Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, and eighty thousand as cutters in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

title: II Chronicles 2:3
text: And Solomon sent to Hiram the king of Tyre, saying, As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house to dwell in, [so deal with me.]

title: II Chronicles 2:4
text: Behold, I am building a house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate [it] to Him, and to burn before Him sweet incense, and for the continual showbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

title: II Chronicles 2:5
text: And the house which I am building [is] great. For our God is great above all gods.

title: II Chronicles 2:6
text: But who is able to build Him a house, since the heavens and the heaven of heavens cannot contain Him? Who [am] I then, that I should build Him a house, except only to burn sacrifice before Him?

title: II Chronicles 2:7
text: And now send me a man skillful to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and one who is skillful to engrave with the skillful men who [are] with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

title: II Chronicles 2:8
text: And send me cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon. For I know that your servants are skillful to cut timber in Lebanon. And, behold, my servants [shall be] with your servants

title: II Chronicles 2:9
text: in order to prepare plenty of timber for me. For the house which I am about to build shall be great and wonderful.

title: II Chronicles 2:10
text: And behold, I will give to the hewers, those who cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

title: II Chronicles 2:11
text: And Hiram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD has loved His people, He has made you king over them.

title: II Chronicles 2:12
text: And Hiram said, Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son blessed with judgment and understanding, who might build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 2:13
text: And now I have sent a skillful man blessed with understanding, of Hiram my father,

title: II Chronicles 2:14
text: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father [was] a man of Tyre, skillful to work in gold, and in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson. He also can engrave any kind of engraving, and can invent every device which shall be put to him, with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.

title: II Chronicles 2:15
text: And now the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants.

title: II Chronicles 2:16
text: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you shall need. And we will bring it to you in floats by sea to Joppa. And you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 2:17
text: And Solomon numbered all the aliens in the land of Israel, according to the numbering with which David his father had numbered them. And they [were] found to be a hundred and fifty-three thousand and six hundred.

title: II Chronicles 2:18
text: And he set seventy thousand of them [to be] bearers of burdens, and eighty thousand to be cutters in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people to work.

title: II Chronicles 3:1
text: And Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in Mount Moriah, where He appeared to David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

title: II Chronicles 3:2
text: And he began to build in the second [day] of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

title: II Chronicles 3:3
text: Now these [are] the foundations Solomon [laid], to build the house of God. The length [by] cubits according to the first measure, sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

title: II Chronicles 3:4
text: And the porch on the front, the length according to the breadth of the house, [was] twenty cubits, and the height a hundred and twenty. And he overlaid it inside with pure gold.

title: II Chronicles 3:5
text: And he made the ceiling of the greater house with fir wood, which he overlaid with fine gold. And he set palm trees and chains on it.

title: II Chronicles 3:6
text: And he covered the house with precious stones for beauty. And the gold [was] gold of Parvaim.

title: II Chronicles 3:7
text: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the posts, and its walls, and its doors, with gold. And he engraved cherubs on the walls.

title: II Chronicles 3:8
text: And he made the Most Holy Place. Its length [was] by the front, of the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and its breadth, twenty cubits. And he overlaid it with fine gold, to six hundred talents.

title: II Chronicles 3:9
text: And the weight of the nails [was] fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

title: II Chronicles 3:10
text: And in the most holy house he made two cherubs of carved work, and overlaid them with gold.

title: II Chronicles 3:11
text: And the wings of the cherubs [were] twenty cubits long. One wing [was] five cubits, touching to the wall of the house; and the other wing five cubits, touching to the wing of the other cherub.

title: II Chronicles 3:12
text: And [one] wing of the other cherub [was] five cubits, touching to the wall of the house; and the other wing five cubits, touching to the wing of the other cherub.

title: II Chronicles 3:13
text: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits. And they stood on their feet, and their faces [were] inward.

title: II Chronicles 3:14
text: And he made the veil [of] blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and worked cherubs on it.

title: II Chronicles 3:15
text: He also made two pillars of thirty-five cubits high in front of the house, and the capital on the tops of each of them [was] five cubits.

title: II Chronicles 3:16
text: And he made chains, [as] in the holy place, and put them on the tops of the pillars. And he made a hundred pomegranates and put them on the chains.

title: II Chronicles 3:17
text: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left. And he called the name of the one on the right Jachin, and the name of the one on the left Boaz.

title: II Chronicles 4:1
text: And he made an altar of bronze. Twenty cubits [was] the length of it, and twenty cubits its breadth, and ten cubits its height.

title: II Chronicles 4:2
text: And He cast a sea of melted bronze, ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, and five cubits [was] its height. And a line of thirty cubits went around it.

title: II Chronicles 4:3
text: And under it was the shape of oxen, under it and all around it for ten cubits, going all around the sea. Two rows of oxen [were] cast when it was cast.

title: II Chronicles 4:4
text: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing the north, and three facing the west, and three facing the south, and three facing the east. And the sea [was] set above on them, and all their hinder parts [were] inward.

title: II Chronicles 4:5
text: And its thickness [was] a handbreadth, and its brim like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies. It received [and] held three thousand baths.

title: II Chronicles 4:6
text: He also made ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them. They washed in them such things as they offered for the burnt offering. But the sea [was] for the priests to wash in.

title: II Chronicles 4:7
text: And he made ten lampstands of gold according to their form, and set [them] in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

title: II Chronicles 4:8
text: And He made ten tables, and placed [them] in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left. And he made a hundred basins of gold.

title: II Chronicles 4:9
text: And he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

title: II Chronicles 4:10
text: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

title: II Chronicles 4:11
text: And Hiram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. And Hiram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God:

title: II Chronicles 4:12
text: the two pillars, and the bowls, and the capitals on the tops of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two bowls of the capitals which [were] on the top of the pillars,

title: II Chronicles 4:13
text: and four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths, two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two bowls of the capitals on the pillars.

title: II Chronicles 4:14
text: He also made bases, and he made lavers on the bases;

title: II Chronicles 4:15
text: and one sea, and twelve oxen under it.

title: II Chronicles 4:16
text: And Hiram made the pots, and the shovels, and the flesh-hooks, and all their vessels of burnished bronze for king Solomon for the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 4:17
text: In the plain of Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

title: II Chronicles 4:18
text: And Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance. For the weight of the bronze could not be found out.

title: II Chronicles 4:19
text: And Solomon made all the vessels [for] the house of God, and the golden altar, and the tables on which the showbread [was set];

title: II Chronicles 4:20
text: and the lampstands of pure gold with their lamps, so that they should burn according to the law before the holy place;

title: II Chronicles 4:21
text: and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs [of] gold, perfect gold;

title: II Chronicles 4:22
text: and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the censers, [of] pure gold; and the entrance of the house, the inner doors of it for the Holy of Holies, and the doors of the house of the temple, [of] gold.

title: II Chronicles 5:1
text: And all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished. And Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated. And he put the silver and the gold, and all the vessels among the treasures of the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 5:2
text: And Solomon gathered the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the sons of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which [is] Zion.

title: II Chronicles 5:3
text: And all the men of Israel gathered themselves to the king in the feast in the seventh month.

title: II Chronicles 5:4
text: And all the elders of Israel came. And the Levites took up the ark.

title: II Chronicles 5:5
text: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that [were] in the tabernacle. The priests [and] the Levites brought these up.

title: II Chronicles 5:6
text: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were gathered to him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen which could not be counted nor numbered for multitude.

title: II Chronicles 5:7
text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place, to the Holy of Holies in the house, into the most holy place, under the wings of the cherubs.

title: II Chronicles 5:8
text: For the cherubs spread out [their] wings over the ark, and the cherubs covered the ark and its staves above.

title: II Chronicles 5:9
text: And they drew out the staves so that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle. But they were not seen outside. And there it is until this day.

title: II Chronicles 5:10
text: Nothing [was] in the ark except the two tables which Moses put [in it] at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the sons of Israel when they came out of Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 5:11
text: And it happened as the priests came out of the holy [place], for all the priests present were sanctified, and did not wait by division.

title: II Chronicles 5:12
text: And the Levitical singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brothers, [being] clothed in white linen, having cymbals and with harps and lyres, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them a hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets,

title: II Chronicles 5:13
text: and [they] were as one to the trumpeters and to the singers, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and as they lifted up [their] voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised the LORD, [saying], For He is good, for His mercy [endures] forever, the house was filled with a cloud, the house of the LORD,

title: II Chronicles 5:14
text: so that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God!

title: II Chronicles 6:1
text: And Solomon said, The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick darkness.

title: II Chronicles 6:2
text: And I have built a house for You to live in, and a place for Your dwelling forever.

title: II Chronicles 6:3
text: And the king turned his face and blessed the whole congregation of Israel. And all the congregation of Israel stood.

title: II Chronicles 6:4
text: And he said, Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel, who has with His hands fulfilled that which He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,

title: II Chronicles 6:5
text: From the day that I brought My people out of the land of Egypt I have not chosen any city among all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, so that My name might be there. Nor have I chosen any man to be a ruler over My people Israel.

title: II Chronicles 6:6
text: But now I have chosen Jerusalem, so that My name might be there, and now I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.

title: II Chronicles 6:7
text: And it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 6:8
text: But the LORD said to David my father, Because it was in your heart to build a house for My name, you did well in that it was in your heart.

title: II Chronicles 6:9
text: But you shall not build the house; but your son, who shall come forth out of your loins, shall build the house for My name.

title: II Chronicles 6:10
text: And the LORD has lifted up His word that He has spoken. For I have risen up in place of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and I have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 6:11
text: And I have put the ark in it, in which [is] the covenant of the LORD which He made with the sons of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 6:12
text: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands.

title: II Chronicles 6:13
text: For Solomon had made a bronze scaffold, five cubits long and five cubits broad and three cubits high. And he had set it in the midst of the court. And he stood on it, and kneeled down on his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward Heaven.

title: II Chronicles 6:14
text: And he said, O LORD God of Israel, [there is] no God like You in Heaven or in earth. You keep Your covenant and show mercy to Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.

title: II Chronicles 6:15
text: You have kept with Your servant David my father that which You have promised him. And You spoke with Your mouth, and have fulfilled [it] with Your hand, as [it is] this day.

title: II Chronicles 6:16
text: And now, O LORD God of Israel, keep with Your servant David my father that which You have promised him, saying, There shall not fail you a man in My sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your sons take heed to their way to walk in My law, as you have walked before Me.

title: II Chronicles 6:17
text: And now, O LORD God of Israel, let Your word be proven true, which You have spoken to Your servant David.

title: II Chronicles 6:18
text: But truly will God in deed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, Heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain You! How much less this house which I have built?

title: II Chronicles 6:19
text: And You have turned toward the prayer of Your servant, and to his cry, O LORD my God, to listen to the cry and the prayer which Your servant prays before You.

title: II Chronicles 6:20
text: I pray that Your eyes may be open on this house day and night, on the place of which You have said that You would put Your name there, to listen to the prayer which Your servant prays toward this place.

title: II Chronicles 6:21
text: And You will listen to the cries of Your servant, and of Your people Israel, which they shall pray toward this place, and You will from Your dwelling-place, from Heaven, and shall hear and forgive.

title: II Chronicles 6:22
text: If a man sins against his neighbor, and if an oath is laid on him to make him swear, and if the oath comes before Your altar in this house,

title: II Chronicles 6:23
text: then hear from Heaven, and do, and judge Your servants by repaying the wicked, by bringing his way back on his own head, and by justifying [the] righteous, by giving to him according to his righteousness.

title: II Chronicles 6:24
text: And if Your people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy because they have sinned against You, and if they shall return and confess Your name, and shall pray and cry before You in this house,

title: II Chronicles 6:25
text: then hear from Heaven, and forgive the sin of Your people Israel, and bring them again into the land which You give to them and to their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 6:26
text: When the heavens shall be shut up, and there is no rain because they have sinned against You; if they pray toward this place, and confess Your name, and turn from their sin when You afflict them,

title: II Chronicles 6:27
text: then hear from Heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants and of Your people Israel, when You have taught them the good way in which they should walk. And send rain on Your land which You have given to Your people for an inheritance.

title: II Chronicles 6:28
text: If there is famine in the land, if there is a plague, if blasting or mildew, locusts or ravagers, if their enemies have distressed them in the gates of their land, with any plague and any sickness;

title: II Chronicles 6:29
text: whatever prayer, whatever cry shall be made by any man, or by all Your people Israel, when everyone shall know his own plague and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house;

title: II Chronicles 6:30
text: then hear from Heaven, Your dwelling-place, and forgive, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart You know. For You only know the hearts of the sons of men.

title: II Chronicles 6:31
text: Do this so that they may fear You, to walk in Your ways, as long as they live in the land which You gave to our fathers.

title: II Chronicles 6:32
text: And also to the stranger who is not of Your people Israel, but has come from a far country for Your great name's sake, and Your mighty hand, and Your stretched out arm, if they come and pray in this house;

title: II Chronicles 6:33
text: then hear from Heaven, from Your dwelling-place, and do according to all that the stranger calls to You for, so that all people of the earth may know Your name, and fear You, as Your people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by Your name.

title: II Chronicles 6:34
text: If Your people go out to war against their enemies by the way that You shall send them, and if they pray to You toward this city which You have chosen, and the house which I have built for Your name,

title: II Chronicles 6:35
text: then hear from Heaven their prayer and their cry and maintain their cause.

title: II Chronicles 6:36
text: If they sin against You (for there is no man who does not sin), and if You are angry with them and deliver them up before their enemies, and they carry them away captives to a land far off or near,

title: II Chronicles 6:37
text: yet if they think within themselves in the land where they are carried captive, and turn and pray to You in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done wrong and have dealt wickedly

title: II Chronicles 6:38
text: if they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity where they have carried them captives, and if they pray toward their land which You gave to their fathers and toward the city which You have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for Your name;

title: II Chronicles 6:39
text: then hear from Heaven, from Your dwelling-place, their prayer and their cries, and maintain their cause, and forgive Your people who have sinned against You.

title: II Chronicles 6:40
text: Now, my God, I beseech You, let Your eyes be open and Your ears hear the prayer made in this place.

title: II Chronicles 6:41
text: And now arise, O LORD God, into Your resting-place, You, and the ark of Your strength. Let Your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let Your saints rejoice in goodness.

title: II Chronicles 6:42
text: O LORD God, do not turn away the face of Your anointed. Remember the good deeds of David Your servant.

title: II Chronicles 7:1
text: And when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from Heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices. And the glory of the LORD filled the house.

title: II Chronicles 7:2
text: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD's house.

title: II Chronicles 7:3
text: And when all the sons of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD on the house, they bowed [their] faces to the ground on the pavement, and worshiped and praised the LORD, saying, For [He is] good, for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: II Chronicles 7:4
text: And the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 7:5
text: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand oxen, and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. And the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 7:6
text: And the priests waited on their offices, and the Levites with instruments of music of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because His mercy [endures] forever, when David praised by their ministry. And the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

title: II Chronicles 7:7
text: And Solomon made the middle of the court before the house of the LORD holy. For there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the food offerings, and the fat.

title: II Chronicles 7:8
text: And at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath to the river of Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 7:9
text: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly. For they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

title: II Chronicles 7:10
text: And on the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shown to David, and to Solomon, and to Israel His people.

title: II Chronicles 7:11
text: So Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king's house. And all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he did with success.

title: II Chronicles 7:12
text: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place to Myself for a house of sacrifice.

title: II Chronicles 7:13
text: If I shut up the heavens, and there is no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send a plague among My people;

title: II Chronicles 7:14
text: if My people, who are called by My name, shall humble themselves and pray, and seek My face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from Heaven and will forgive their sin and will heal their land.

title: II Chronicles 7:15
text: Now My eyes shall be open, and My ears shall be open to the prayer of this place.

title: II Chronicles 7:16
text: For now I have chosen and sanctified this house, so that My name may be there forever. And My eyes and My heart shall be there forever.

title: II Chronicles 7:17
text: And you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and shall observe My statutes and My judgments,

title: II Chronicles 7:18
text: then I will make the throne of your kingdom sure, as I have covenanted with David your father, saying, There shall not fail you a man [to be] ruler in Israel.

title: II Chronicles 7:19
text: But if you turn away and forsake My statutes and My commandments which I have set before you, and if you shall go and serve other gods and worship them,

title: II Chronicles 7:20
text: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of My land which I have given them. And this house which I have sanctified for My name, I will cast out of My sight, and I will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.

title: II Chronicles 7:21
text: And this house, which is high, shall be a wonder to everyone who passes by it, so that [they] shall shudder and say, Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?

title: II Chronicles 7:22
text: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers who brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods and worshiped them and served them. Therefore He has brought all this evil on them.

title: II Chronicles 8:1
text: And it happened at the end of twenty years, Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own house.

title: II Chronicles 8:2
text: As to the cities that Hiram had given to Solomon, Solomon had built them, and he caused the sons of Israel to live there.

title: II Chronicles 8:3
text: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.

title: II Chronicles 8:4
text: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities which he built in Hamath.

title: II Chronicles 8:5
text: And he built Beth-horon the upper and Beth-horon the lower, fenced cities with walls, gates, and bars.

title: II Chronicles 8:6
text: And he built Baalath, and all the store cities which Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

title: II Chronicles 8:7
text: All the people [who were] left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who [were] not of Israel,

title: II Chronicles 8:8
text: of their sons who [were] left after them in the land, whom the sons of Israel did not destroy, Solomon made them subject to forced labor until this day.

title: II Chronicles 8:9
text: And of the sons of Israel, Solomon did not make any servants for his work. But they [were] men of war, and commanders of his officers, and commanders of his chariots, and his horsemen.

title: II Chronicles 8:10
text: And these [were] the chief of king Solomon's officers, two hundred and fifty who bore rule over the people.

title: II Chronicles 8:11
text: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David to the house which he had built for her. For he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because [the places] into which the ark of the LORD has come are holy.

title: II Chronicles 8:12
text: And Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD which he had built before the porch,

title: II Chronicles 8:13
text: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the Feast of Unleavened [Bread], and in the Feast of Weeks, and in the Feast of Tabernacles.

title: II Chronicles 8:14
text: And according to the order of David his father, he appointed the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required; and the gatekeepers by their divisions at every gate; for so David the man of God had commanded.

title: II Chronicles 8:15
text: And they did not depart [from] the command of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

title: II Chronicles 8:16
text: And all the work of Solomon was prepared until the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. And the house of the LORD was complete.

title: II Chronicles 8:17
text: And Solomon went to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the seaside in the land of Edom.

title: II Chronicles 8:18
text: And Hiram sent ships to him by the hand of his servants, and servants who knew [the] sea. And they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took four hundred and fifty talents of gold from there, and brought [them] to king Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 9:1
text: And the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, and came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that carried spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones. And she came in to Solomon and spoke with him of all that was in her heart.

title: II Chronicles 9:2
text: And Solomon told her all her questions. And there was nothing hidden from Solomon which he did not tell her.

title: II Chronicles 9:3
text: And the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

title: II Chronicles 9:4
text: and the food of his table, and the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers and their apparel, and his burnt offerings that he offered up in the house of the LORD, there was no more spirit in her.

title: II Chronicles 9:5
text: And she said to the king, The word that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom is true.

title: II Chronicles 9:6
text: But I did not believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen. And behold, the one half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me. You are greater than the fame which I heard.

title: II Chronicles 9:7
text: Happy [are] your men, and happy are these your servants who stand always before you and hear your wisdom.

title: II Chronicles 9:8
text: Blessed [be] the LORD your God, who delighted in you to set you on His throne to [be] king for the LORD your God. Because your God loved Israel to establish them forever, therefore He made you king over them to do judgment and justice.

title: II Chronicles 9:9
text: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and an abundance of spices, and precious stones. And there has not been any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 9:10
text: And also the servants of Hiram, and the servants of Solomon who brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

title: II Chronicles 9:11
text: And the king made terraces to the house of the LORD with the algum trees, and terraces to the king's palace, and lyres and harps for singers. And there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 9:12
text: And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, besides what she had brought to the king. And she returned and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

title: II Chronicles 9:13
text: And the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,

title: II Chronicles 9:14
text: besides [that] from the traders, and that the merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 9:15
text: And king Solomon made two hundred targets [of] beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

title: II Chronicles 9:16
text: And he [made] three hundred shields [of] beaten gold. Three hundred [shekels] of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

title: II Chronicles 9:17
text: And the king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with pure gold.

title: II Chronicles 9:18
text: And there [were] six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold. fastened to the throne. And there [were] stays on each [side] of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays.

title: II Chronicles 9:19
text: And twelve lions stood there on the one [side], and on the other, on the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 9:20
text: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon [were] of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon [were] of pure gold. None [were] of silver. It was not prized in the days of Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 9:21
text: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Hiram. Once every three years the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

title: II Chronicles 9:22
text: And king Solomon was greater than all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

title: II Chronicles 9:23
text: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom that God had put in his heart.

title: II Chronicles 9:24
text: And they each brought his present, vessels of silver and vessels of gold, and clothing, weapons, and spices, horses, and mules, a ration year by year.

title: II Chronicles 9:25
text: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he put in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 9:26
text: And he reigned over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 9:27
text: And the king made silver in Jerusalem like stones, and he made cedar trees as the sycamore trees in the low plains.

title: II Chronicles 9:28
text: And they brought to Solomon horses out of Egypt and out of all lands.

title: II Chronicles 9:29
text: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, [are] they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah of Shiloh, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

title: II Chronicles 9:30
text: And Solomon reigned forty years in Jerusalem over all Israel.

title: II Chronicles 9:31
text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father. And his son Rehoboam reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 10:1
text: And Rehoboam went to Shechem. For all Israel had come [to] Shechem to make him king.

title: II Chronicles 10:2
text: And it happened when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who [was] in Egypt where he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard [it], Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 10:3
text: And they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

title: II Chronicles 10:4
text: Your father made our yoke heavy. And now lighten the heavy service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you.

title: II Chronicles 10:5
text: And he said to them, Come again to me after three days. And the people departed.

title: II Chronicles 10:6
text: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What advice do you give [me] to return answer to this people?

title: II Chronicles 10:7
text: And they spoke to him saying, If you are kind to this people and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be your servants forever.

title: II Chronicles 10:8
text: But he departed from the advice which the old men gave him and listened to the young men who were brought up with him, who stood before him.

title: II Chronicles 10:9
text: And he said to them, What advice do you give that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Lighten the yoke which your father put on us?

title: II Chronicles 10:10
text: And the young men who were brought up with him spoke to him saying, In this way shall you answer the people who spoke to you, saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, but you lighten our yoke, this you shall say to them, My little [finger]  shall be thicker than my father's loins.

title: II Chronicles 10:11
text: And now my father put a heavy yoke on you, and I will surely add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I [will chastise you] with scorpions.

title: II Chronicles 10:12
text: And Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day as the king commanded, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

title: II Chronicles 10:13
text: And the king answered them roughly. And king Rehoboam departed from the advice of the old men,

title: II Chronicles 10:14
text: and answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I [will chastise you] with scorpions.

title: II Chronicles 10:15
text: And the king did not listen to the people, for [the] revolution was from God so that the LORD might perform His word which He spoke by the hand of Ahijah of Shiloh to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

title: II Chronicles 10:16
text: And all Israel [saw] that the king would not listen to them, and the people answered the king saying, What part do we have in David? And we have no inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, O Israel! Now, David, see to your own house. And all Israel went to their tents.

title: II Chronicles 10:17
text: [As for] the sons of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

title: II Chronicles 10:18
text: And king Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who [was] over the forced labor. And the sons of Israel stoned him with stones so that he died. But king Rehoboam [was] warned to get up into [his] chariot to flee to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 10:19
text: And Israel rebelled against the house of David until this day.

title: II Chronicles 11:1
text: And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem and gathered a hundred and eighty thousand chosen warriors from the house of Judah, to fight against Israel, so that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

title: II Chronicles 11:2
text: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

title: II Chronicles 11:3
text: Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

title: II Chronicles 11:4
text: So says the LORD, You shall not go up nor fight against your brothers. Let every man return to his house. For this thing is done by Me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

title: II Chronicles 11:5
text: And Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built cities for defense in Judah.

title: II Chronicles 11:6
text: And he built Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

title: II Chronicles 11:7
text: and Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

title: II Chronicles 11:8
text: and Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

title: II Chronicles 11:9
text: and Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

title: II Chronicles 11:10
text: and Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which [are] in Judah and in Benjamin, fortified cities.

title: II Chronicles 11:11
text: And he fortified the strongholds and put commanders in them, and stores of food, and of oil and wine.

title: II Chronicles 11:12
text: And [he put] in each separate city shields and spears, and made them very strong, and Judah and Benjamin were his.

title: II Chronicles 11:13
text: And the priests and the Levites in all Israel presented themselves to him out of all their borders.

title: II Chronicles 11:14
text: For the Levites left their open lands and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem. For Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priests' office to the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 11:15
text: And he ordained priests for himself for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

title: II Chronicles 11:16
text: And after them, those who gave their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel, out of all the tribes of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 11:17
text: And they made the kingdom of Judah stronger, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years. For three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 11:18
text: And Rehoboam took Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David as a wife for himself, [and] Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse,

title: II Chronicles 11:19
text: who bore him sons, Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

title: II Chronicles 11:20
text: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom, who bore Abijah to him, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

title: II Chronicles 11:21
text: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines (for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and had twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters).

title: II Chronicles 11:22
text: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, [to be] ruler among his brothers, in order to make him king.

title: II Chronicles 11:23
text: And he dealt wisely and dispersed all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to all the fortified cities. And he gave them food in abundance. And he demanded many wives.

title: II Chronicles 12:1
text: And it happened when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had made himself strong, he departed from the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.

title: II Chronicles 12:2
text: And it happened in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had sinned against the LORD

title: II Chronicles 12:3
text: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. And the people who came with him out of Egypt [were] without number: Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

title: II Chronicles 12:4
text: And he took the fortified cities in Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 12:5
text: And Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam, and [to] the rulers of Judah who were gathered to Jerusalem because of Shishak. And [he] said to them, So says the LORD, You have forsaken Me, and therefore I also have left you in the hand of Shishak.

title: II Chronicles 12:6
text: And the rulers of Israel and the king humbled themselves. And they said, The LORD [is] righteous.

title: II Chronicles 12:7
text: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will give them some deliverance. And My wrath shall not be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

title: II Chronicles 12:8
text: But they shall be his servants, so that they may know My service, and the service of the kings of the countries.

title: II Chronicles 12:9
text: And Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house. He took all. And he carried away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

title: II Chronicles 12:10
text: In place of these king Rehoboam made shields of bronze, and gave [them] into the hands of the chief of the guard who kept the entrance of the king's house.
