title: II Chronicles 12:11
text: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and carried them and brought them again into the guardroom.

title: II Chronicles 12:12
text: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him so that He would not destroy [him] altogether. And also things went well in Judah.

title: II Chronicles 12:13
text: And king Rehoboam strengthened himself at Jerusalem, and reigned. For Rehoboam [was] forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put His name there. And his mother's name [was] Naamah the Ammonitess.

title: II Chronicles 12:14
text: And he did the evil because he did not prepare his heart to seek the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 12:15
text: And the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, [are] they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And the wars of Rehoboam and Jeroboam [lasted] all their days.

title: II Chronicles 12:16
text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David. And his son Abijah reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 13:1
text: And in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam Abijah began to reign over Judah.

title: II Chronicles 13:2
text: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also [was] Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

title: II Chronicles 13:3
text: And Abijah set the battle in order with an army of mighty men of war, four hundred thousand chosen men. Jeroboam also set the battle in order against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, mighty men of valor.

title: II Chronicles 13:4
text: And Abijah stood up on mount Zemaraim, in the hills of Ephraim, and said, Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel.

title: II Chronicles 13:5
text: Should you not know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

title: II Chronicles 13:6
text: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, has risen up and has rebelled against his lord.

title: II Chronicles 13:7
text: And there are gathered to him vain men, the sons of Belial, and have made themselves strong against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, and Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted and could not withstand them.

title: II Chronicles 13:8
text: And now you think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hands of the sons of David. And you [are] a great multitude, and there [are] with you golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods.

title: II Chronicles 13:9
text: Have you not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made priests to yourselves like the peoples of the lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams, he may be a priest of [those who are] no gods.

title: II Chronicles 13:10
text: But as for us, Jehovah [is] our God, and we have not forsaken Him. And the priests who minister to the LORD are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in the work.

title: II Chronicles 13:11
text: And they burn to the Lord every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense, and the showbread on the pure table, and the lampstand of gold with its lamps, to burn every evening. For we keep the charge of the LORD our God. But you have forsaken Him.

title: II Chronicles 13:12
text: And behold, God Himself [is] with us as Commander, and His priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O sons of Israel, do not fight against the LORD God of your fathers, for you shall not prosper!

title: II Chronicles 13:13
text: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come around behind them, so that they were in front of Judah, and the ambush [was] behind them.

title: II Chronicles 13:14
text: And Judah turned, and, behold, the battle [was] before and behind. And they cried to the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

title: II Chronicles 13:15
text: And the men of Judah shouted. And it happened as the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

title: II Chronicles 13:16
text: And the sons of Israel fled before Judah. And God delivered them into their hand.

title: II Chronicles 13:17
text: And Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter. And there fell down dead five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 13:18
text: And the sons of Israel were humbled at that time, and the sons of Judah won because they relied on the LORD God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 13:19
text: And Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with its villages, and Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephrain with its villages.

title: II Chronicles 13:20
text: And Jeroboam did not recover strength again [in] the days of Abijah. And the LORD struck him and he died.

title: II Chronicles 13:21
text: And Abijah became mighty, and married fourteen wives, and fathered twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

title: II Chronicles 13:22
text: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, [are] written in the inquiry of the prophet Iddo.

title: II Chronicles 14:1
text: And Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And his son Asa reigned in his place. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

title: II Chronicles 14:2
text: And Asa did the good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.

title: II Chronicles 14:3
text: For he took away the altars of the strange [gods], and the high places, and broke down the images, and cut down the Asherahs.

title: II Chronicles 14:4
text: And he commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

title: II Chronicles 14:5
text: He also took out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images. And the kingdom was quiet before him.

title: II Chronicles 14:6
text: And he built fortified cities in Judah. For the land had rest, and he had no war in those years, because the LORD had given him rest.

title: II Chronicles 14:7
text: And he said to Judah, Let us build these cities and make walls around [them], and towers, gates and bars, while the land [is] still before us. Because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought, and He has given us rest on every side. And they built and were blessed.

title: II Chronicles 14:8
text: And Asa had an army which bore bucklers and spears, three hundred thousand out of Judah. And out of Benjamin there [were] two hundred and eighty thousand who bore shields and drew bows; all these mighty men of valor.

title: II Chronicles 14:9
text: And Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million men, and three hundred chariots. And he came to Mareshah.

title: II Chronicles 14:10
text: And Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in order in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

title: II Chronicles 14:11
text: And Asa cried to the LORD his God and said, LORD, [it is] nothing with You to help, whether with many or with him who has no power. Help us, O LORD our God, for we rest on You, and in Your name we go against this multitude. O LORD, You are our God. Do not let man prevail against You.

title: II Chronicles 14:12
text: And the LORD struck the Cushites before Asa and before Judah. And the Cushites fled.

title: II Chronicles 14:13
text: And Asa and the people with him pursued them to Gerar. And the Cushites fell, for none was left alive of them. For they were destroyed before the LORD and before His army. And they carried away very much plunder.

title: II Chronicles 14:14
text: And they struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the LORD came on them. And they plundered all the cities, for there was very much plunder in them.

title: II Chronicles 14:15
text: And they struck the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance and returned to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 15:1
text: And the Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

title: II Chronicles 15:2
text: And he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin. The LORD [is] with you while you are with Him. And if you seek Him, He will be found by you. But if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.

title: II Chronicles 15:3
text: And for a long time Israel [had been] without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

title: II Chronicles 15:4
text: And when they turned in their trouble to the LORD God of Israel, and sought Him, He was found by them.

title: II Chronicles 15:5
text: And in those times [there was] no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in, but great tumult [was] on all the people of the lands.

title: II Chronicles 15:6
text: And nation was beaten by nation, and city by city, for God troubled them with every distress.

title: II Chronicles 15:7
text: But you be strong and do not let your hands be weak, for your work shall be rewarded.

title: II Chronicles 15:8
text: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim. And he renewed the altar of the LORD before the porch of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 15:9
text: And [he] gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon. For they fell to him out of Israel in great numbers, when they saw that the LORD his God [was] with him.

title: II Chronicles 15:10
text: And they gathered to Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

title: II Chronicles 15:11
text: And [they] offered to the LORD in that day part of the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

title: II Chronicles 15:12
text: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul,

title: II Chronicles 15:13
text: and that whoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

title: II Chronicles 15:14
text: And they swore to the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with ram's horns.

title: II Chronicles 15:15
text: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought Him with their whole desire. And He was found by them, and the LORD gave them rest all around.

title: II Chronicles 15:16
text: And also [as to] Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from [being] queen mother, because she had made an idol in a grove. And Asa cut down her idol and stamped it and burned [it] at the brook Kidron.

title: II Chronicles 15:17
text: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel. But the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

title: II Chronicles 15:18
text: And he brought into the house of God the things which his father had dedicated, and which he himself had dedicated, silver and gold and vessels.

title: II Chronicles 15:19
text: And there was no war to the thirty-fifth year of the reign of Asa.

title: II Chronicles 16:1
text: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, so that he might let no one go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 16:2
text: And Asa brought out silver and gold from the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house and sent them to Ben-hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

title: II Chronicles 16:3
text: A treaty between you and me, as [there was] between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he may depart from me.

title: II Chronicles 16:4
text: And Ben-hadad listened to king Asa, and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel. And they struck Ijon and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

title: II Chronicles 16:5
text: And it happened when Baasha heard, he left off building Ramah, and let his work stop.

title: II Chronicles 16:6
text: And Asa the king took all Judah. And they carried away the stones of Ramah, and timber with which Baasha was building. And he built with it Geba and Mizpah.

title: II Chronicles 16:7
text: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him, Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on the LORD your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

title: II Chronicles 16:8
text: Were not the Cushites and the Libyans a huge army with many chariots and horsemen? Yet, because you relied on the LORD, he delivered them into your hand.

title: II Chronicles 16:9
text: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro in all the whole earth to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose heart [is] perfect toward Him. You have done foolishly in this; therefore from now on you shall have wars.

title: II Chronicles 16:10
text: And Asa was angry with the seer and put him in a prison-house. For [he was] in a rage with him because of this. And Asa oppressed some of the people at that time.

title: II Chronicles 16:11
text: And behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they [are] written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

title: II Chronicles 16:12
text: And in the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa [was] diseased in his feet, until his disease [was] very grievous. Yet in his disease he did not seek to the LORD, but to the physicians.

title: II Chronicles 16:13
text: And Asa slept with his fathers and died in the forty-first year of his reign.

title: II Chronicles 16:14
text: And they buried him in his own tomb, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and kinds [of spices] prepared by the perfumers art. And they made a very great burning for him.

title: II Chronicles 17:1
text: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place. And he made himself strong against Israel.

title: II Chronicles 17:2
text: And [he] placed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set troops in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim which Asa his father had taken.

title: II Chronicles 17:3
text: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he walked in the first ways of his father David and did not seek to Baals.

title: II Chronicles 17:4
text: But he looked to the God of his father, and walked in His commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 17:5
text: And the LORD made the kingdom sure in his hand. And all Judah brought presents to Jehoshaphat. And he had great riches and honor.

title: II Chronicles 17:6
text: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD. And he took away the high places and Asherahs out of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 17:7
text: And in the third year of his reign he sent to his rulers, to Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 17:8
text: And with them [he sent] Levites, Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites. And with them he sent Elishama and Jehoram the priests.

title: II Chronicles 17:9
text: And they taught in Judah and [had] the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went around throughout all the cities of Judah and taught the people.

title: II Chronicles 17:10
text: And the fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands around Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.

title: II Chronicles 17:11
text: And from the Philistines they brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. Also the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he-goats.

title: II Chronicles 17:12
text: And Jehoshaphat became exceedingly great. And he built fortresses in Judah, and store cities.

title: II Chronicles 17:13
text: And he had much business in the cities of Judah. And the men of war, mighty men of valor, [were] in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 17:14
text: And these [were] their numbers, for the house of their fathers from Judah, the commanders of thousands: Adnah the chief, and with him were three hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

title: II Chronicles 17:15
text: And on his hand, Jehohanan the chief, and with him were two hundred and eighty thousand.

title: II Chronicles 17:16
text: And on his hand, Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

title: II Chronicles 17:17
text: And from Benjamin [was] Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand men armed with bow and shield.

title: II Chronicles 17:18
text: And on his hand, Jehozabad, and with him a hundred and eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

title: II Chronicles 17:19
text: These waited on the king, besides [those] whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

title: II Chronicles 18:1
text: And Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance, and he contracted a marriage with Ahab.

title: II Chronicles 18:2
text: And after [some] years [he] went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen in abundance for him, and for the people that were with him. And he persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth-gilead.

title: II Chronicles 18:3
text: And Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead? And he answered him, I [am] as you, and my people are as your people, and [we] with you in the war.

title: II Chronicles 18:4
text: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Please inquire at the word of the LORD today.

title: II Chronicles 18:5
text: And the king of Israel gathered four hundred men of the prophets and said to them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I wait? And they said, Go up, for God will deliver [it] into the king's hand.

title: II Chronicles 18:6
text: But Jehoshaphat said, [Is there] not a prophet of Jehovah here besides, so that we might ask of Him?

title: II Chronicles 18:7
text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, [There is] yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD. But I hate him, for he never prophesied good to me, but always evil. The same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

title: II Chronicles 18:8
text: And the king of Israel called to a certain eunuch and said, Bring quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.

title: II Chronicles 18:9
text: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat each of them on his throne, clothed in robes. And [they] sat in a grain floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria. And all the prophets prophesied before them.

title: II Chronicles 18:10
text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made horns of iron for himself. And he said, And says the LORD, With these you shall push Syria until they are crushed.

title: II Chronicles 18:11
text: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead and be blessed. For the LORD shall deliver [it] into the king's hand.

title: II Chronicles 18:12
text: And the messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets [declare] good to the king with one Mouth, and please let your word be like one of theirs, and speak good.

title: II Chronicles 18:13
text: And Micaiah said, [As] the Lord lives, even what my God says, that I will speak.

title: II Chronicles 18:14
text: And he came to the king. And the king said to him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I wait? And he said, Go up and be blessed. And they shall be delivered into your hand.

title: II Chronicles 18:15
text: And the king said to him, How many times shall I warn you that you say nothing but the truth to me in the name of Jehovah?

title: II Chronicles 18:16
text: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, like sheep that [have] no shepherd. And the LORD said, These [have] no master; let them return, each man to his own house in peace.

title: II Chronicles 18:17
text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell you he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?

title: II Chronicles 18:18
text: Again he said, And hear the word of the LORD. I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the host of Heaven were standing on His right hand and [on] His left.

title: II Chronicles 18:19
text: And the LORD said, Who shall tempt Ahab king of Israel so that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one spoke saying in one way, and another saying in another way.

title: II Chronicles 18:20
text: And a spirit came out and stood before the LORD and said, I will tempt him. And the LORD said, With what?

title: II Chronicles 18:21
text: And he said, I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And [the LORD] said, You shall tempt him, and you are able. Go out and do so.

title: II Chronicles 18:22
text: And now behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets, and the LORD has spoken evil against you.

title: II Chronicles 18:23
text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek. And he said, Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go from me to speak to you?

title: II Chronicles 18:24
text: And Micaiah said, Behold, you shall see on that day when you shall go into an inner room to hide yourself.

title: II Chronicles 18:25
text: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son.

title: II Chronicles 18:26
text: And you shall say, So says the king, Put this [fellow] in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction until I return in peace.

title: II Chronicles 18:27
text: And Micaiah said, If you certainly return in peace, [then] the LORD has not spoken by me. And he said, Listen, all you people.

title: II Chronicles 18:28
text: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

title: II Chronicles 18:29
text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself and will go to the battle. But you put on your robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself. And they went to the battle.

title: II Chronicles 18:30
text: And the king of Syria had commanded the commanders of the chariots with him, saying, Do not fight with small or great, but only with the king of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 18:31
text: And it happened when the commanders of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, It [is] the king of Israel. And they surrounded him to fight. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him. And God moved them [to leave] him.

title: II Chronicles 18:32
text: For it happened when the commanders of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.

title: II Chronicles 18:33
text: And a [certain] man drew a bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joinings and the breastplate. And he said to the charioteer, Turn your hand, and you shall bring me out of the army, for I am wounded.

title: II Chronicles 18:34
text: And the battle increased that day; and the king of Israel was made to stand up in [his] chariot against the Syrians until the evening. And about the time of the sunset he died.

title: II Chronicles 19:1
text: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 19:2
text: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him. And he said to king Jehoshaphat, Should you help the ungodly and love those who hate the LORD? And by this [bring] wrath on you from before the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 19:3
text: But there are good things found in you, in that you have taken away the Asherahs out of the land and have prepared your heart to seek God.

title: II Chronicles 19:4
text: And Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem. And he went out again among the people from Beer-sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back to the LORD God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 19:5
text: And he set judges in the land, in all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city.

title: II Chronicles 19:6
text: And he said to the judges, Take heed what you do. For you do not judge for man, but for the LORD, who [is] with you in the judgment.

title: II Chronicles 19:7
text: And now let the fear of the LORD be on you. Be careful and act wisely, for [there is] no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

title: II Chronicles 19:8
text: And Jehoshaphat set some of the Levites and [of] the priests and of the chief of the fathers of Israel in Jerusalem for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 19:9
text: And he charged them, saying, And you shall act in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

title: II Chronicles 19:10
text: And whatever cause shall come to you from your brothers that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, you shall even warn them so that they do not sin against the LORD, and wrath come on you and your brothers. Do this and you shall not sin.

title: II Chronicles 19:11
text: And behold, Amariah the chief priest [is] over you in all matters of the LORD. And Zebadiah the son of Ishmael is the ruler of the house of Judah for all the king's matters. Also the Levites [shall be] officers before you. Take courage and act, and the LORD shall be with the good.

title: II Chronicles 20:1
text: And it happened after this the sons of Moab, and the sons of Ammon came in, and with them [others] besides the Ammonites, to battle against Jehoshaphat.

title: II Chronicles 20:2
text: And they came in and spoke to Jehoshaphat, saying, A great multitude has come against you from beyond the sea on this side of Syria. And behold, they [are] in Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi.

title: II Chronicles 20:3
text: And Jehoshaphat feared and set himself to seek the LORD, and called for a fast throughout all Judah.

title: II Chronicles 20:4
text: And Judah gathered themselves to ask of the LORD. Even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 20:5
text: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,

title: II Chronicles 20:6
text: and said, O LORD God of our Fathers, [are] You not God in Heaven? And do You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? And [is there] power and might in Your hand, so that none is able to withstand You?

title: II Chronicles 20:7
text: [Are] You not our God? Did [You] not drive out the people of this land before Israel, and give it to the seed of Your friend Abraham forever?

title: II Chronicles 20:8
text: And they lived in it. And they have built You a temple in it for Your name, saying,

title: II Chronicles 20:9
text: If evil comes on us, [whether] the sword, judgment, or plague, or famine, and we stand before this house and in Your presence (for Your name [is] in this house) and cry to You in our affliction, then You will hear and help.

title: II Chronicles 20:10
text: And now, behold, the sons of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom You would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them and did not destroy them,

title: II Chronicles 20:11
text: behold, they reward us by coming to cast us out of Your possession, which You have given us to inherit.

title: II Chronicles 20:12
text: O our God, will You not judge them? For we have no might against this great company which comes against us. Nor do we know what to do, but our eyes [are] on You.

title: II Chronicles 20:13
text: And all Judah stood before the LORD with their little ones, their wives, and their sons.

title: II Chronicles 20:14
text: And the Spirit of the LORD came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, in the midst of the congregation.

title: II Chronicles 20:15
text: And he said, Listen, all Judah, and you people of Jerusalem, and king Jehoshaphat! So says the LORD to you, Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of this great multitude. For the battle [is] not yours, but God's.

title: II Chronicles 20:16
text: Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz. And you shall find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

title: II Chronicles 20:17
text: You shall not fight in this [battle]. Set yourselves and stand, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem. Do not fear nor be dismayed. Tomorrow go out against them, for the LORD [will be] with you.

title: II Chronicles 20:18
text: And Jehoshaphat bowed his face to the ground. And all Judah and the people of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshiping the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 20:19
text: And the Levites, of the sons of the Kohathites and of the sons of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

title: II Chronicles 20:20
text: And they rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. And as they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and you people of Jerusalem. Believe in the LORD your God, and so you shall be established. Believe His prophets, and so you shall be blessed.

title: II Chronicles 20:21
text: And he consulted with the people, and he appointed singers to the LORD and praisers to praise the beauty of holiness as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD, for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: II Chronicles 20:22
text: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushes against the sons of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, who had come against Judah. And they were beaten.

title: II Chronicles 20:23
text: For the sons of Ammon and Moab stood up against the people of mount Seir to completely kill and destroy. And when they had made an end of the people of Seir, everyone helped to destroy another.

title: II Chronicles 20:24
text: And when Judah came to the watchtower in the wilderness, they looked at the multitude. And behold! They [were] dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

title: II Chronicles 20:25
text: And Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and precious jewels in great number with the dead bodies, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away. And they were three days in gathering of the plunder, it was so much.

title: II Chronicles 20:26
text: And on the fourth day they gathered themselves in the Valley of Blessing. For there they blessed the LORD. And the name of the same place was called the Valley of Blessing until this day.

title: II Chronicles 20:27
text: And they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in front of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy. For the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

title: II Chronicles 20:28
text: And they came into Jerusalem with harps and with lyres, and with trumpets to the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 20:29
text: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of [those] countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 20:30
text: And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was quiet. For his God gave him rest round about.

title: II Chronicles 20:31
text: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah, thirty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

title: II Chronicles 20:32
text: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and did not depart from it, doing the right in the sight of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 20:33
text: But, the high places were not taken away, for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts to the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 20:34
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they [are] written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, which [were] taken up in the /Book of the Kings of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 20:35
text: And after this Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel; he did wickedly to do so.

title: II Chronicles 20:36
text: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. And they made the ships in Ezion-geber.

title: II Chronicles 20:37
text: And Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has broken your works. And the ships were broken so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

title: II Chronicles 21:1
text: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 21:2
text: And he had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah. All these [were] the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 21:3
text: And their father gave them great gifts of silver and of gold and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah. But the kingdom he gave to Jehoram, because he [was] the first-born.

title: II Chronicles 21:4
text: And when Jehoram had risen up to the kingdom of his father, he made himself strong and killed all his brothers with the sword, and also [many] of the rulers of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 21:5
text: Jehoram [was] thirty-two years old when he began to reign. And he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 21:6
text: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like the house of Ahab for he had the daughter of Ahab for a wife. And he did the evil in the eyes of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 21:7
text: And the LORD was not willing to destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that He had made with David, and as He promised to give a light to him and to his sons forever.

title: II Chronicles 21:8
text: In his days Edom revolted from under the rule of Judah, and made themselves a king.

title: II Chronicles 21:9
text: And Jehoram went forth with his rulers, and all his chariots with him. And he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, and the commanders of the chariots.

title: II Chronicles 21:10
text: And the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah until this day. The same time Libnah revolted from under his hand, because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.

title: II Chronicles 21:11
text: Besides he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the people of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and led astray Judah.

title: II Chronicles 21:12
text: And a writing came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, So says the LORD God of David your father, Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

title: II Chronicles 21:13
text: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the people of Jerusalem to go lusting like the fornications of the house of Ahab, and also have killed your brothers of your fathers house ([who were] better than you),

title: II Chronicles 21:14
text: behold, the LORD will strike your people with a great plague, and your sons, and your wives, and all your goods.

title: II Chronicles 21:15
text: And you [shall have] great sickness by disease in your bowels, until your bowels fall out because of the sickness day by day.

title: II Chronicles 21:16
text: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of the Philistines against Jehoram, and of the Arabians who [were] near the Ethiopians.

title: II Chronicles 21:17
text: And they came up into Judah and broke into it, and carried away all the stuff that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives, so that there was not a son left with him except Ahaziah, the youngest of his sons.

title: II Chronicles 21:18
text: And after this the LORD struck him in his bowels with a disease that could not be cured.

title: II Chronicles 21:19
text: And it happened as days and as the time went out, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out because of his sickness. And he died of painful diseases. And his people made no burning for him like the burning of his fathers.

title: II Chronicles 21:20
text: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. And they buried him in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

title: II Chronicles 22:1
text: And the people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place. For the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had killed all the older ones. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

title: II Chronicles 22:2
text: Ahaziah's [dynasty was] forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name [was] Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

title: II Chronicles 22:3
text: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab. For his mother was his counselor to do wickedly.

title: II Chronicles 22:4
text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab. For they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his ruin.

title: II Chronicles 22:5
text: He also walked after their advice and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead. And the Syrians struck Jehoram.

title: II Chronicles 22:6
text: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel, because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.

title: II Chronicles 22:7
text: And by coming to Jehoram, the destruction of Ahaziah was of God. He went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

title: II Chronicles 22:8
text: And it happened when Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, and found the rulers of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah, the servants of Ahaziah, he killed them.

title: II Chronicles 22:9
text: And he looked for Ahaziah. And they caught him (for he was hidden in Samaria), and brought him to Jehu. And when they had killed him, they buried him because they said, He [is] the son of Jehoshaphat who looked to the LORD with all his heart. And the house of Ahaziah had no power still to keep the kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 22:10
text: And Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, and she arose and spoke to [destroy] all the royal seed of the house of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 22:11
text: But Jehoshabeath the daughter of the king took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons who were killed. And she put him and his nurse in a bedroom. And Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah) hid him from Athaliah so that she did not kill him.

title: II Chronicles 22:12
text: And he was with them six years, hidden in the house of God. And Athaliah reigned over the land.

title: II Chronicles 23:1
text: And in the seventh year Jehoiada made himself strong. And he took the commanders of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri into covenant with him.

title: II Chronicles 23:2
text: And they went about in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 23:3
text: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said to them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the LORD has said of the sons of David.

title: II Chronicles 23:4
text: This [is] the thing that you shall do. A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, [shall be] keepers of the doors.

title: II Chronicles 23:5
text: And a third part [shall be] at the king's house. And a third part shall be at the gate of the foundation. And all the people [shall be] in the courts of the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 23:6
text: But let none come into the house of the LORD except the priests, and those of the Levites who minister. They shall go in, for they [are] holy. But all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 23:7
text: And the Levites shall surround the king, each man with his weapons in his hand. And whoever comes into the house, he shall be put to death. But you be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.

title: II Chronicles 23:8
text: And the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded. And every man took his men who were to come in on the sabbath, with the ones who were to go [out] on the sabbath. For Jehoiada the priest did not dismiss the divisions.

title: II Chronicles 23:9
text: And Jehoiada the priest delivered to the commanders of hundreds king David's spears and bucklers and shields, which [were] in the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 23:10
text: And he set all the people, each man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.

title: II Chronicles 23:11
text: And they brought out the king's son and put the crown on him, and [gave him] the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him and said, Let the king live!

title: II Chronicles 23:12
text: And Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, and she came to the people into the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 23:13
text: And she looked, and behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entrance, and the rulers and the trumpets by the king. And all the people of the land [were] rejoicing and sounding with trumpets, and the singers with instruments of music, and giving signals to praise. And Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, Treason! Treason!

title: II Chronicles 23:14
text: And Jehoiada the priest brought out the commanders of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, Take her out of the ranks. And whoever follows her shall be killed with the sword. For the priest said, Do not kill her [in] the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 23:15
text: And they laid hands on her; and she came to the entrance of the Gate of the Horses, beside the king's house, and they executed her there.

title: II Chronicles 23:16
text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people and between the king, that they should be the LORD's people.

title: II Chronicles 23:17
text: And all the people went to the house of Baal and broke it down, and smashed his altars and his images. And they killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

title: II Chronicles 23:18
text: And Jehoiada chose the officers of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as [it is] written in the law of Moses, with joy and with singing, by the hands of David.

title: II Chronicles 23:19
text: And he set the gatekeepers at the gates of the house of the LORD, so that the unclean in any way could not go in.

title: II Chronicles 23:20
text: And he took the commanders of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the house of the LORD. And they came through the Upper Gate into the king's house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 23:21
text: And all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet after they had killed Athaliah with the sword.

title: II Chronicles 24:1
text: Joash [was] seven years old when he began to reign. And he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also [was] Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

title: II Chronicles 24:2
text: And Joash did the right in the eyes of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

title: II Chronicles 24:3
text: And Jehoiada took two wives for him, and he fathered sons and daughters

title: II Chronicles 24:4
text: And it happened after this, it had been in the mind of Joash to repair the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 24:5
text: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites and said to them, Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather silver from all Israel to repair the house of your God from year to year. And see that you hasten the matter. And the Levites did not hasten [it].

title: II Chronicles 24:6
text: And the king called for Jehoiada and said to him, Why have you not made the Levites bring in the collection out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, according to Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?

title: II Chronicles 24:7
text: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, have broken up the house of God. And also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD they have given to Baals.

title: II Chronicles 24:8
text: And the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 24:9
text: And they gave a call in Judah and in Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection [that] Moses the servant of God [laid] on Israel in the wilderness.

title: II Chronicles 24:10
text: And all the rulers and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and threw into the chests until [it was] finished.

title: II Chronicles 24:11
text: And it happened at the time the chest was brought into the king's office by the Levites, and when they saw that the silver [was] abundant, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it and carried it to its place again. So they did day by day, and gathered a great amount of silver.

title: II Chronicles 24:12
text: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of the house of the LORD. And they hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also artisans in iron and bronze, to mend the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 24:13
text: And the workmen worked, and the work was completed by them, and they set the house of God in its proper state and made it strong.

title: II Chronicles 24:14
text: And when they had finished, they brought the rest of the silver before the king and Jehoiada. Of this silver were made vessels for the house of the LORD, vessels to minister and to offer, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they continually offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada.

title: II Chronicles 24:15
text: But Jehoiada became old, and was full of days when he died. He [was] a hundred and thirty years old when he died.

title: II Chronicles 24:16
text: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God and toward His house.

title: II Chronicles 24:17
text: And after the death of Jehoiada the rulers of Judah came and bowed down to the king. And the king listened to them.

title: II Chronicles 24:18
text: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served Asherahs and idols. And wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guilt.

title: II Chronicles 24:19
text: Yet He sent prophets to them to bring them again to the LORD. And they testified against them. But they would not listen.

title: II Chronicles 24:20
text: And the Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, who stood above the people and said to them, So says God, Why do you transgress the commandments of the LORD so that you cannot be blessed? Because you have forsaken the LORD, He has also forsaken you.

title: II Chronicles 24:21
text: And they conspired against him and stoned him [with] stones at the command of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 24:22
text: And Joash the king did not remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD will seek [you out].

title: II Chronicles 24:23
text: And it happened at the end of the year the army of Syria came up against him. And they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the rulers of the people from among the people, and sent all the plunder of them to the king of Damascus.

title: II Chronicles 24:24
text: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken the God of the fathers. And they executed judgment against Joash.

title: II Chronicles 24:25
text: And when they had departed from him (for they left him in great diseases), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. And they buried him in the city of David, but they did not bury him in the tombs of the kings.

title: II Chronicles 24:26
text: And these are the ones who conspired against him Zabad the son of Shimeath of Ammon, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.

title: II Chronicles 24:27
text: And [as to] his sons, and the greatness of the burdens on him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the Book of the Kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 25:1
text: Amaziah [was] twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 25:2
text: And he did the right in the eyes of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.

title: II Chronicles 25:3
text: And it happened when the kingdom was made sure to him, he killed his servants who had killed his father, the king.

title: II Chronicles 25:4
text: But he did not kill their sons, but as [it is] written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The father shall not die for the sons, nor shall the sons die for [the] fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

title: II Chronicles 25:5
text: And Amaziah gathered Judah and made them commanders over thousands and commanders over hundreds, according to the houses of the fathers, for all Judah and Benjamin. And he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice [men, able] to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

title: II Chronicles 25:6
text: And he hired a hundred thousand mighty men of war out of Israel for a hundred talents of silver.

title: II Chronicles 25:7
text: But a man of God came to him saying, O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD [is] not with Israel, with all the sons of Ephraim.

title: II Chronicles 25:8
text: But if you will go, do [it]! Be strong for the battle, for God shall make you fall before the enemy, for God has power to help and to throw down.

title: II Chronicles 25:9
text: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what [shall we] do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give you much more than this.

title: II Chronicles 25:10
text: And Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. And their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.

title: II Chronicles 25:11
text: And Amaziah made himself strong, and led forth his people, and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the sons of Seir.

title: II Chronicles 25:12
text: And the sons of Judah carried away captive ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock so they were all broken in pieces.

title: II Chronicles 25:13
text: And the sons of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Judah from Samaria even to Beth-horon, and struck three thousand of them and took much plunder.

title: II Chronicles 25:14
text: And it happened after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the sons of Seir and set them up [to be] his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.

title: II Chronicles 25:15
text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and He sent to him a prophet who said to him, Why have you sought after the gods of the people which could not deliver their own people out of your hand?

title: II Chronicles 25:16
text: And it happened as he talked with him, [the king] said to him, Have we made you of the king's counsel? Stop! Why should you be stricken? And the prophet stopped. And he said, I know that God has determined to destroy you because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.

title: II Chronicles 25:17
text: And Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come let us look one another in the face.

title: II Chronicles 25:18
text: And Jehoash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah saying, The thistle that [was] in Lebanon sent to the cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for a wife. [And] a beast of the field in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thistle down.

title: II Chronicles 25:19
text: You have said, Lo, I have stricken the Edomites, and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home why should you meddle to [your] hurt, so that you should fall, you and Judah with you?

title: II Chronicles 25:20
text: But Amaziah would not hear, for it [was] from God so that He might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.

title: II Chronicles 25:21
text: And Jehoash the king of Israel went up. And they saw one another in the face, he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 25:22
text: And Judah was beaten before Israel, and each man fled to his tent.

title: II Chronicles 25:23
text: And Jehoash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits.

title: II Chronicles 25:24
text: And [he took] all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels which were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

title: II Chronicles 25:25
text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived fifteen years after the death of Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 25:26
text: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, [are] they not written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel?

title: II Chronicles 25:27
text: And after the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD, they made a plot against him in Jerusalem. And he fled to Lachish. But they sent to Lachish after him and killed him there.

title: II Chronicles 25:28
text: And they brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 26:1
text: And all the people of Judah took Uzziah, and he [was] sixteen years old, and made him king in his father Amaziah's place.

title: II Chronicles 26:2
text: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after the king lay with his fathers.

title: II Chronicles 26:3
text: Uzziah [was] sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also [was] Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 26:4
text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.

title: II Chronicles 26:5
text: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God. As long as he sought the LORD, God blessed him.

title: II Chronicles 26:6
text: And he went out and warred against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities around Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

title: II Chronicles 26:7
text: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gurbaal, and the Meunites.

title: II Chronicles 26:8
text: And the Ammonites paid tribute to Uzziah. And his name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he was made very strong.

title: II Chronicles 26:9
text: And, Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate and at the Valley Gate, and at the Turning, and fortified them.

title: II Chronicles 26:10
text: And he built towers in the desert, and dug many wells. For he had many cattle, both in the low country and in the plains. He [also] had husbandmen and vinedressers in the mountains, and in Carmel. For he loved the earth.

title: II Chronicles 26:11
text: And, Uzziah had an army of making war, going out to war by troops, according to the number of their oversight by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, [one] of the king's leaders.

title: II Chronicles 26:12
text: The whole number of the heads of the fathers of the mighty men of power [was] two thousand and six hundred.

title: II Chronicles 26:13
text: And under their hand [was] an army of three hundred and seven thousand, five hundred, that made war with mighty power to help the king against the enemy.

title: II Chronicles 26:14
text: And Uzziah prepared for them, for all the army, shields and spears and helmets and coats of armor and bows and stones for the slings.

title: II Chronicles 26:15
text: And he made engines in Jerusalem, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the corners, to shoot arrows and great stones with. And his name spread far abroad. For he was wonderfully helped until he was strong.

title: II Chronicles 26:16
text: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to ruin. For he sinned against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.

title: II Chronicles 26:17
text: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of the LORD, mighty men.

title: II Chronicles 26:18
text: And they withstood Uzziah the king and said to him, [It is] not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord, but to the priests, the sons of Aaron who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the temple, for you have sinned. Nor shall it be for your honor from the LORD God.

title: II Chronicles 26:19
text: And Uzziah was angry. And he [had] a censer in his hand to burn incense. And while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.

title: II Chronicles 26:20
text: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked on him. And, behold, he [was] leprous in his forehead! And they thrust him out from there. Yes, he himself hurried to go out also, because the LORD had stricken him.

title: II Chronicles 26:21
text: And Uzziah the king was a leper until the day of his death, and lived in a separate house a leper. For he was cut off from the house of the LORD. And Jotham his son [was] over the king's house, judging the people of the land.

title: II Chronicles 26:22
text: And the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.

title: II Chronicles 26:23
text: And Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial of the kings. For they said, He [is] a leper. And his son Jotham reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 27:1
text: Jotham [was] twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

title: II Chronicles 27:2
text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did. Only, he did not enter into the temple of the LORD. And the people still did evilly.

title: II Chronicles 27:3
text: He built the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

title: II Chronicles 27:4
text: And he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built palaces and towers.

title: II Chronicles 27:5
text: And He fought with the king of the Ammonites and prevailed over them. And the sons of Ammon gave him the same year a hundred talents of silver and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. This the sons of Ammon paid to him, both the second year and the third.

title: II Chronicles 27:6
text: And Jotham became mighty because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.

title: II Chronicles 27:7
text: And the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they [are] written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.

title: II Chronicles 27:8
text: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 27:9
text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And his son Ahaz reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 28:1
text: Ahaz [was] twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. But he did not do the right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father.

title: II Chronicles 28:2
text: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molded images for Baals.

title: II Chronicles 28:3
text: And he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his sons in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD had cast out before the sons of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 28:4
text: And He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

title: II Chronicles 28:5
text: And the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. And they struck him and carried away a great captivity, and brought [them] to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.

title: II Chronicles 28:6
text: And Pekah the son of Remaliah killed a hundred and twenty thousand in Judah in one day, all mighty men, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 28:7
text: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah [who was] next to the king.

title: II Chronicles 28:8
text: And the sons of Israel carried away captive two hundred thousand of their brothers, women, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them and brought the plunder to Samaria.

title: II Chronicles 28:9
text: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name [was] Oded. And he went out before the army that came to Samaria and said to them, Behold, because the Lord God of your fathers was angry with Judah, He has delivered them into your hands, and you have killed them in a rage which reaches up to Heaven.

title: II Chronicles 28:10
text: And now you intend to keep under the sons of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen to you. [Are there] not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?

title: II Chronicles 28:11
text: And now hear me, and deliver again the captives which you have taken captive of your brothers. For the fierce wrath of the LORD [is] on you.

title: II Chronicles 28:12
text: And certain of the heads of the sons of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them who came from the war.

title: II Chronicles 28:13
text: And they said to them, You shall not bring the captives here. For we have offended the LORD, and you intend to add to our sins and to our trespass. For our trespass is great, and [there is] fierce wrath against Israel.

title: II Chronicles 28:14
text: And the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the rulers and all the congregation.

title: II Chronicles 28:15
text: And the men who were called by name rose up and took the captives and clothed all that were naked among them with the plunder, and dressed them, and shod them, and made them eat and drink, and anointed them, and led the feeble ones on asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. And they returned to Samaria.

title: II Chronicles 28:16
text: At that time king Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

title: II Chronicles 28:17
text: For again the Edomites had come and had beaten Judah and had carried away captives.

title: II Chronicles 28:18
text: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country and of the south of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh and Aijalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with its villages, and Timnah with its villages, and Gimzo and its villages. And they lived there.

title: II Chronicles 28:19
text: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel. For he loosed [immorality] in Judah, and sinned grievously against the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 28:20
text: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and troubled him, but did not strengthen him.

title: II Chronicles 28:21
text: For Ahaz took away a portion [of] the house of the LORD, and [of] the house of the king, and [of] the rulers, and gave [it] to the king of Assyria. But [it was] no help to him.

title: II Chronicles 28:22
text: And in the time of his distress he trespassed even more against the LORD, this king Ahaz.

title: II Chronicles 28:23
text: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus who struck him. And he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them so that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.

title: II Chronicles 28:24
text: And Ahaz gathered the vessels of the house of God and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD. And [he] made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 28:25
text: And in each separate city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.

title: II Chronicles 28:26
text: And the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they [are] written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

title: II Chronicles 28:27
text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem. But they did not bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel. And his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 29:1
text: Hezekiah began to reign [being] twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Abijah the daughter of Zechariah.

title: II Chronicles 29:2
text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.

title: II Chronicles 29:3
text: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the LORD and repaired them.

title: II Chronicles 29:4
text: And [he] brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them into the east street.

title: II Chronicles 29:5
text: And he said to them, Hear me, Levites, now sanctify yourselves and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry out the filthiness out of the holy [place].

title: II Chronicles 29:6
text: For our fathers have sinned and did the evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken Him, and have turned away their faces from the house of the LORD, and have turned [their] backs.

title: II Chronicles 29:7
text: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 29:8
text: Therefore the wrath of the LORD was on Judah and Jerusalem, and He has delivered them to trouble, to ruin, and to hissing as you see with your eyes.

title: II Chronicles 29:9
text: For lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives [are] in captivity for this.

title: II Chronicles 29:10
text: And [it is] in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that His fierce wrath may turn away from us.

title: II Chronicles 29:11
text: My sons, do not be negligent now. For the LORD has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, and that you should minister to Him and burn incense.

title: II Chronicles 29:12
text: And the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites. And of the sons of Merari arose Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel. And of the Gershonites: Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah.

title: II Chronicles 29:13
text: And of the sons of Elizaphan: Shimri and Jeiel. And of the sons of Asaph: Zechariah and Mattaniah.

title: II Chronicles 29:14
text: And of the sons of Heman: Jehiel and Shimei. And of the sons of Jeduthun: Shemaiah and Uzziel.

title: II Chronicles 29:15
text: And they gathered their brothers and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the command of the king, by the words of the LORD, to clean the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 29:16
text: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD to clean [it]. And they brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took [it]  out to the brook Kidron.

title: II Chronicles 29:17
text: And they began to sanctify on the first of the first month. And on the eighth day of the month they came to the porch of the LORD. And they made the house of the LORD pure in eight days, and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

title: II Chronicles 29:18
text: And they went in to Hezekiah the king and said, We have cleaned all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and the showbread table, and all its vessels.

title: II Chronicles 29:19
text: And we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which king Ahaz in his reign cast away in his sin. And behold, they [are] before the altar of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 29:20
text: And Hezekiah the king rose early and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 29:21
text: And they brought seven bulls and seven rams and seven lambs and seven he-goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer [them] on the altar of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 29:22
text: And they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled [it] on the altar. And they killed the rams, and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood on the altar.

title: II Chronicles 29:23
text: And they brought out the he-goats [for] the sin offering before the king and the congregation. And they laid their hands on them.

title: II Chronicles 29:24
text: And the priest killed them, and they made atonement with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel. For the king commanded the burnt offering and the sin offering [to be made] for all Israel.

title: II Chronicles 29:25
text: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with harps, and with lyres, according to the command of David, and of Gad the king's seer and Nathan the prophet. For the commandment [was] by the hand of the LORD by His prophets.

title: II Chronicles 29:26
text: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

title: II Chronicles 29:27
text: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering on the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began with the trumpets and with the instruments [ordained] by David king of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 29:28
text: And all the congregation worshiped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this [went on] until the burnt offering was finished.

title: II Chronicles 29:29
text: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.

title: II Chronicles 29:30
text: And Hezekiah the king and the rulers commanded the Levites to sing praise to the LORD with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.

title: II Chronicles 29:31
text: And Hezekiah answered and said, And you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings. And as many as were of a free heart [brought] burnt offerings.

title: II Chronicles 29:32
text: And the number of the burnt offerings which the congregation brought was seventy oxen, a hundred rams, two hundred lambs. All these [were] for a burnt offering to the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 29:33
text: And the things consecrated [were] six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

title: II Chronicles 29:34
text: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. And their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves. For the Levites [were] more upright of heart to make themselves pure than the priests.

title: II Chronicles 29:35
text: And also the burnt offerings [were] in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and the drink offerings for [every] burnt offering. And the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

title: II Chronicles 29:36
text: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people. For the thing happened suddenly.

title: II Chronicles 30:1
text: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to the LORD God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 30:2
text: And the king and his leaders, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, took counsel to keep the Passover in the second month.

title: II Chronicles 30:3
text: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not made themselves pure enough, nor had the people gathered to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 30:4
text: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.

title: II Chronicles 30:5
text: And they established a decree to send a notice throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem. For not many [of them] had done as it was written.

title: II Chronicles 30:6
text: And the runners went with the letters from the king and his rulers to Israel and Judah, and according to the command of the king, saying, O sons of Israel, turn again to the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and He will return to the remnant of you who have escaped out of the hands of the king of Assyria.

title: II Chronicles 30:7
text: And do not be like your fathers and like your brothers who sinned against the LORD God of their fathers, and He made them for a horror, as you see.

title: II Chronicles 30:8
text: And do not be stiffnecked like your fathers. Yield yourselves to the LORD and enter into His temple which He has sanctified forever. And serve the LORD your God, so that the fierceness of His wrath may turn away from you.

title: II Chronicles 30:9
text: For if you turn again to the LORD, your brothers and your sons will have mercies before those who lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land. For the LORD your God [is] gracious and merciful, and will not turn His face away from you if you return to Him.

title: II Chronicles 30:10
text: And the runners passed from city to city in the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun. But they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

title: II Chronicles 30:11
text: However, men from Asher and Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 30:12
text: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the command of the king and of the rulers, by the word of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 30:13
text: And many people gathered at Jerusalem to keep the Feast of Unleavened [Bread] in the second month, a very great congregation.

title: II Chronicles 30:14
text: And they arose and took away the altars in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense they took away, and threw [them] into the brook Kidron.

title: II Chronicles 30:15
text: And they killed the Passover on the fourteenth of the second month. And the priests and the Levites were ashamed and made themselves pure, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 30:16
text: And they stood in their place in their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood from the hand of the Levites.

title: II Chronicles 30:17
text: For many in the congregation [were] not sanctified. And the Levites were over the killing of the passovers for every one [who was] not clean, to sanctify them to the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 30:18
text: For many of the people, many from Ephraim and Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun, had not been cleansed, but ate the Passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, May the good LORD pardon everyone

title: II Chronicles 30:19
text: [who] prepares his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though not [cleansed] according to the purification of the sanctuary.

title: II Chronicles 30:20
text: And the LORD listened to Hezekiah and healed the people.

title: II Chronicles 30:21
text: And the sons of Israel found at Jerusalem kept the Feast of Unleavened [Bread] seven days with great gladness. And the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day with loud instruments to the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 30:22
text: And Hezekiah spoke comfortably to all the Levites who taught the good knowledge of the LORD. And they ate the appointed things seven days, offering peace offerings and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 30:23
text: And the whole gathering agreed to keep another seven days. And they kept [another] seven days with gladness.

title: II Chronicles 30:24
text: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the congregation a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep. And the rulers gave to the congregation a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep. And a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

title: II Chronicles 30:25
