text: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.

title: II Chronicles 30:26
text: And there was great joy in Jerusalem. For from the days of Solomon the son of David the king of Israel [there was] nothing like this in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 30:27
text: And the priests, the Levites, arose and blessed the people. And their voice was heard, and their prayer came to His holy dwelling-place, to Heaven.

title: II Chronicles 31:1
text: And when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the images in pieces, and cut down the Asherahs, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, even to the end. And all the sons of Israel returned, each to his possession, into their own cities.

title: II Chronicles 31:2
text: And Hezekiah set the courses of the priests and the Levites according to their divisions, each according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 31:3
text: And the king's portion from his goods [was] for burnt offerings, and for burnt offerings, of the morning and the evening and the burnt offerings of the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as [it is] written in the law of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 31:4
text: And he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites so that they might be strong in the law of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 31:5
text: And as the command spread, the sons of Israel brought plentifully of the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field. And the tithe of all [things] they brought in abundance.

title: II Chronicles 31:6
text: And the sons of Israel and Judah who lived in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated to the LORD their God, and laid it up by heaps.

title: II Chronicles 31:7
text: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished in the seventh month.

title: II Chronicles 31:8
text: And Hezekiah and the rulers came and saw the heaps, and they blessed the LORD and His people Israel.

title: II Chronicles 31:9
text: And Hezekiah asked the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

title: II Chronicles 31:10
text: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him and said, Since [the people] began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat and have plenty left. For the LORD has blessed His people, and this great store is left.

title: II Chronicles 31:11
text: And Hezekiah commanded storehouses to be prepared in the house of the LORD. And they prepared,

title: II Chronicles 31:12
text: and brought in the offerings and the tithes and the [things] dedicated to God faithfully. And over them [was] Cononiah the Levite ruler, and Shimei his brother the next.

title: II Chronicles 31:13
text: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, [were] overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the command of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 31:14
text: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper toward the east, [was] over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the sacrifices of the LORD and the most holy things.

title: II Chronicles 31:15
text: And next to him Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in [their] set office, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small,

title: II Chronicles 31:16
text: besides registering the males from three years and upward, to everyone who enters into the house of the LORD, giving his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their divisions

title: II Chronicles 31:17
text: both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, and their charges by their divisions,

title: II Chronicles 31:18
text: and to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation. For in their set office they set themselves apart in holiness.

title: II Chronicles 31:19
text: And to the sons of Aaron, the priests, in the fields of the open lands of their cities, in each separate city [were] the men who were named by name, to give shares to all the males among the priests, and to all who were counted by genealogies among the Levites.

title: II Chronicles 31:20
text: And Hezekiah did throughout all Judah, and did the good and the right and the true before the LORD his God.

title: II Chronicles 31:21
text: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did [it] with all his heart, and prospered.

title: II Chronicles 32:1
text: After these things done in faithfulness, Sennacherib, the king of Assyria, came and entered into Judah, and camped against the fortified cities, and commanded to break them open to himself.

title: II Chronicles 32:2
text: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he [had set] his face to fight against Jerusalem,

title: II Chronicles 32:3
text: he took counsel with his rulers and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains outside the city. And they helped him.

title: II Chronicles 32:4
text: And there were gathered many people, who stopped all the fountains, and the torrent which ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the king of Assyria come and find much water?

title: II Chronicles 32:5
text: And he made himself strong and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised [it] up to the towers, and another wall outside, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

title: II Chronicles 32:6
text: And he set commanders of war over the people and gathered them to himself in the street of the gate of the city. And he spoke to their heart, saying,

title: II Chronicles 32:7
text: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of the king of Assyria, or for all the multitude with him. For [there are] more with us than with him.

title: II Chronicles 32:8
text: With him [is] an arm of flesh, but with us [is] the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 32:9
text: After this Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem; and he [was] against Lachish, and all his forces with him against Hezekiah king of Judah, and against all Judah in Jerusalem, saying,

title: II Chronicles 32:10
text: Sennacherib king of Assyria says this, On what do you trust that you sit under siege in Jerusalem?

title: II Chronicles 32:11
text: Does not Hezekiah persuade you to give yourselves over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, Jehovah our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

title: II Chronicles 32:12
text: Has not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, You shall worship before one altar and burn incense on it?

title: II Chronicles 32:13
text: Do you not know what I and my fathers have done to all the people of other lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their lands out of my hands?

title: II Chronicles 32:14
text: Who among all the gods of those nations that my fathers completely destroyed [is] able to deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

title: II Chronicles 32:15
text: And now do not let Hezekiah deceive you or persuade you in this way, nor yet believe him. For no god of any nation was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less shall your god deliver you out of my hand?

title: II Chronicles 32:16
text: And his servants spoke still [more] against the LORD God, and against His servant Hezekiah.

title: II Chronicles 32:17
text: He also wrote letters to revile the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against Him, saying, As the gods of the nations of [other] lands have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver His people out of my hand.

title: II Chronicles 32:18
text: And they cried out with a loud voice [in] Jewish to the people of Jerusalem on the wall, in order to frighten them and to trouble them, so that they might take the city.

title: II Chronicles 32:19
text: And they spoke against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the peoples of the earth, the work of the hands of man.

title: II Chronicles 32:20
text: And for this [reason] Hezekiah the king and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz prayed and cried to Heaven.

title: II Chronicles 32:21
text: And the LORD sent an angel to cut off all the mighty men of power, and the leaders and commanders in the camp of the king of Assyria. And he returned with shame of face to his own land. And he came into the house of his god, and those from his own bowels killed him there with the sword.

title: II Chronicles 32:22
text: And the LORD saved Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all [others], and guided them on every side.

title: II Chronicles 32:23
text: And many brought gifts to the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from that time on.

title: II Chronicles 32:24
text: In those days Hezekiah was sick to death, and prayed to the LORD. And He spoke to him, and He gave him a sign.

title: II Chronicles 32:25
text: But Hezekiah did not give again according to the good [done] to him, for his heart was lifted up. And there was wrath on him and on Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 32:26
text: And Hezekiah was humbled for the pride of his heart, he and the people of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD did not come on them in the days of Hezekiah.

title: II Chronicles 32:27
text: And Hezekiah had exceedingly much riches and honor. And he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all kinds of pleasant jewels.

title: II Chronicles 32:28
text: And he made storehouses for the increase of grain and wine and oil, and stalls for all kinds of animals, and stalls for flocks.

title: II Chronicles 32:29
text: And he provided himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds, in abundance. For God had given him very many things.

title: II Chronicles 32:30
text: And Hezekiah himself stopped the upper water courses of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah was blessed in all his works.

title: II Chronicles 32:31
text: But, in [regard to] the ambassadors of the rulers of Babylon who sent to him to ask about the wonder that was done in the land, God left him in order to try him, to know all that was in his heart.

title: II Chronicles 32:32
text: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they [are] written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

title: II Chronicles 32:33
text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the highest of the tombs of the sons of David. And all Judah and the people of Jerusalem honored him at his death. And his son Manasseh reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 33:1
text: Manasseh [was] twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 33:2
text: But he did the evil in the sight of the LORD, like the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the sons of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:3
text: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for the Baals, and made Asherahs, and worshiped all the host of heaven, and served them.

title: II Chronicles 33:4
text: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall My name be forever.

title: II Chronicles 33:5
text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 33:6
text: And he caused his sons to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He also practiced secret arts, and used fortune-telling, and used witchcraft, and dealt with mediums, and with soothsayers. He did much evil in the sight of the LORD in order to provoke Him to anger.

title: II Chronicles 33:7
text: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, I will put My name forever.

title: II Chronicles 33:8
text: Nor will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have set apart for your fathers; only if they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

title: II Chronicles 33:9
text: And Manasseh made Judah and the people of Jerusalem to err, to do worse than the nations whom the LORD had destroyed before the sons of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:10
text: And the LORD spoke to Manasseh and to His people, but they would not listen.

title: II Chronicles 33:11
text: And the LORD brought on them the commanders of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh among the thorns and bound him with chains and carried him to Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 33:12
text: And when he was in affliction, he sought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

title: II Chronicles 33:13
text: And he prayed to Him, and He was entreated of him, and heard his prayer, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. And Manasseh knew that Jehovah [is] God.

title: II Chronicles 33:14
text: And after this he built a wall outside the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance of the Fish Gate, and went around Ophel, and raised it to a very great height. And he put army commanders in all the fortified cities of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 33:15
text: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and threw [them] out of the city.

title: II Chronicles 33:16
text: And he repaired the altar of the LORD and sacrificed on it peace offerings and thank-offerings. And he commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:17
text: But the people still sacrificed in the high places, [but only] to the LORD their God.

title: II Chronicles 33:18
text: And the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they [are written] in the Book of the Kings of Israel;

title: II Chronicles 33:19
text: and his prayer, and his entreaty, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up Asherahs and graven images, before he was humbled, behold, they [are] written among the Matters of the Seers.

title: II Chronicles 33:20
text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house. And his son Amon reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 33:21
text: Amon [was] twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 33:22
text: And he did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did; and to all the graven images that his father Manasseh had made, Amon sacrificed, and served them.

title: II Chronicles 33:23
text: And [he] did not bow before the LORD, like the humbling of his father Manasseh. For Amon himself multiplied guilt.

title: II Chronicles 33:24
text: And his servants conspired against him and killed him in his own house.

title: II Chronicles 33:25
text: And the people of the land killed all those who conspired against king Amon. And the people of the land made his son Josiah to reign in his place.

title: II Chronicles 34:1
text: Josiah [was] eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.

title: II Chronicles 34:2
text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and did not turn aside to the right nor to the left.

title: II Chronicles 34:3
text: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek after the God of David his father. And in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the Asherahs, and the carved images, and the molten images.

title: II Chronicles 34:4
text: And they broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence. And he cut down the images which [were] on high above them, and the Asherahs. And the carved images and the molten images he also broke in pieces and made dust [from them] , and scattered on the graves of the ones who had sacrificed to them.

title: II Chronicles 34:5
text: And he burned the bones of the priests on their altars and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:6
text: And [so he did] in the cities of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon, even to Naphtali, with their tools round about.

title: II Chronicles 34:7
text: And he broke down the altars and the Asherahs, and had beaten the carved images into powder, and cut down all the idols in all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:8
text: And in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

title: II Chronicles 34:9
text: And they came to Hilkiah the high priest, and they delivered the silver that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered from the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and from all the remnant of Israel, and from all Judah and Benjamin, and they returned to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:10
text: And they put [it] in the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of the house of the LORD. And they gave it [to] the workmen who worked in the house of the LORD, to repair and mend the house.

title: II Chronicles 34:11
text: They gave to the artisans and builders, to buy cut stone and timber for joints, and beams to build up the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

title: II Chronicles 34:12
text: And the men did the work faithfully. And the overseers of them [were] Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, and of the Levites, all who [were] skillful with instruments of music;

title: II Chronicles 34:13
text: and over the bearers of burdens, and overseers of all who worked the work in any manner of service. And of the Levites [were] scribes and officers and gatekeepers.

title: II Chronicles 34:14
text: And when they brought out the silver that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD by Moses.

title: II Chronicles 34:15
text: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

title: II Chronicles 34:16
text: And Shaphan carried the Book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was given into the hands of your servants, they are doing.

title: II Chronicles 34:17
text: And they poured out the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

title: II Chronicles 34:18
text: And Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

title: II Chronicles 34:19
text: And it happened when the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his garments.

title: II Chronicles 34:20
text: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan. and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king, saying,

title: II Chronicles 34:21
text: Go inquire of the LORD for me and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found. For great [is] the wrath of the LORD that is poured out on us because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD to do according to all that is written in this Book.

title: II Chronicles 34:22
text: And Hilkiah, and those of the king, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, the keeper of the robes. (And she lived in Jerusalem in the second [part].) And they spoke to her about this.

title: II Chronicles 34:23
text: And she answered them, So says the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man who sent you to me,

title: II Chronicles 34:24
text: So says the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil on this place and upon its people, all the curses that are written in the Book which they have read before the king of Judah,

title: II Chronicles 34:25
text: because they have forsaken Me, and have burned incense to other gods, so that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. And My wrath shall be poured out on this place and shall not be quenched.

title: II Chronicles 34:26
text: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, so shall you say to him, So says the LORD God of Israel whose words you have heard,

title: II Chronicles 34:27
text: Because your heart [was] tender and you humbled yourself before your God when you heard His words against this place and against its people, and humbled yourself before Me, and tore your garments and wept before Me, I have even heard also, says the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 34:28
text: Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, nor shall your eyes see all the evil which I will bring on this place and upon its people. And they brought the king word again.

title: II Chronicles 34:29
text: And the king sent and gathered all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:30
text: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the people of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people from the great to [the] small. And he read in their ears all the words of the Book of the Covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 34:31
text: And the king stood in his place and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD and to keep His commandments and His testimonies, and His statutes, with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

title: II Chronicles 34:32
text: And he caused all who were found in Jerusalem and in Benjamin, and the people of Jerusalem, to stand to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 34:33
text: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the territories that [belonged] to the sons of Israel. And he made all that were present in Israel to serve, to serve the LORD their God. All his days they did not depart from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 35:1
text: And Josiah kept a Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem. And they killed the passover lamb on the fourteenth of the first month.

title: II Chronicles 35:2
text: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 35:3
text: And he said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David, king of Israel, built. [It shall] not [be] a burden on your shoulders. And serve the LORD your God and His people Israel,

title: II Chronicles 35:4
text: and prepare by the houses of your fathers, according to your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

title: II Chronicles 35:5
text: And stand in the holy [place] according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brothers, the sons of the people, and the division of the families of the Levites.

title: II Chronicles 35:6
text: And kill the passover lamb, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brothers so that [they] may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

title: II Chronicles 35:7
text: And Josiah gave to the people from the flock, lambs and kids, all for the Passover offerings, for all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand oxen. These [were] from what the king owned.

title: II Chronicles 35:8
text: And his rulers offered to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand, six hundred [sheep], and three hundred oxen.

title: II Chronicles 35:9
text: And Conaniah, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brothers, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for Passover offerings five thousand [sheep] and five hundred oxen.

title: II Chronicles 35:10
text: And the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their divisions, according to the king's command.

title: II Chronicles 35:11
text: And they killed the passover lamb, and the priests sprinkled from their hands, and the Levites skinned [them].

title: II Chronicles 35:12
text: And they removed the burnt offerings so that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer to the LORD, as [it is] written in the book of Moses; and so they did to the oxen.

title: II Chronicles 35:13
text: And they roasted the passover lamb with fire according to the law. But the holy [offerings] they boiled in pots, and in kettles, and in pans, and carried to all the sons of the people.

title: II Chronicles 35:14
text: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were offering up the burnt offerings and the fat until nightfall. And the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.

title: II Chronicles 35:15
text: And the singers, the sons of Asaph [were] in their place, according to the command of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun, the king's seer. And the gatekeepers [were] at every gate. It was not for them to depart from their service; for their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

title: II Chronicles 35:16
text: And all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD, according to the command of king Josiah.

title: II Chronicles 35:17
text: And the sons of Israel present kept the Passover at that time, and the Feast of Unleavened [Bread] seven days.

title: II Chronicles 35:18
text: And there was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet. Yea, none of the kings of Israel kept such a Passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were found, and the people of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 35:19
text: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah.

title: II Chronicles 35:20
text: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates. And Josiah went out against him.

title: II Chronicles 35:21
text: But he sent messengers to him, saying, What have I to do with you, king of Judah? [I do] not [come] against you today, but against the house [with which] I have war. For God commanded me to make haste. You must cease from [opposing] God, who [is] with me, so that He does not destroy you.

title: II Chronicles 35:22
text: But Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself so that he might fight with him. And he did not listen to the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

title: II Chronicles 35:23
text: And the archers shot at king Josiah. And the king said to his servants, Take me away, for I am grievously wounded.

title: II Chronicles 35:24
text: And his servants took him out of that chariot and put him in the second chariot that he had. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

title: II Chronicles 35:25
text: And Jeremiah mourned for Josiah. And all the singing men and the singing women have spoken of Josiah in their lamentations until this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel. And behold, they [are] written in the Lamentations.

title: II Chronicles 35:26
text: And the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, [are] according as it [is] written in the law of the LORD,

title: II Chronicles 35:27
text: and his deeds, first and last, behold, they [are] written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.

title: II Chronicles 36:1
text: And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's place in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:2
text: Jehoahaz [was] twenty-three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:3
text: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and laid a fine of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold on the land.

title: II Chronicles 36:4
text: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother and carried him to Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 36:5
text: Jehoiakim [was] twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And he did the evil in the sight of the LORD his God.

title: II Chronicles 36:6
text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him and bound him in chains to carry him to Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 36:7
text: And Nebuchadnezzar carried away [some] of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 36:8
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they [are] written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah. And Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

title: II Chronicles 36:9
text: Jehoiachin [was] eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. And he did the evil in the sight of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 36:10
text: And when the year had ended, king Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the valuable vessels of the house of the LORD. And he made his brother Zedekiah king over Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:11
text: Zedekiah [was] twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:12
text: And he did the evil in the sight of the LORD his God. He was not humbled before Jeremiah the prophet, from the mouth of the LORD.

title: II Chronicles 36:13
text: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God. But he stiffened his neck and hardened his heart from turning to the LORD God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 36:14
text: Also all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the nations. And they polluted the house of the LORD which He had made holy in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:15
text: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by His messengers, rising up early and sending, for He had pity on His people and on His dwelling-place.

title: II Chronicles 36:16
text: But they mocked the messengers of God and despised His words, and ill-treated His prophets until the wrath of the LORD arose against His people, until [there was] no healing.

title: II Chronicles 36:17
text: And He caused the king of the Chaldeans to go up against them. And he killed their choice ones by the sword in the house of their holy place, and had no pity on the young man and the virgin, the old man and the very aged; He gave all into his hand.

title: II Chronicles 36:18
text: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his rulers, he brought all [these] to Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 36:19
text: And they burned the house of God, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and burned all the palaces of it with fire, and destroyed all its beautiful vessels.

title: II Chronicles 36:20
text: And the ones who had escaped from the sword he carried away to Babylon, where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,

title: II Chronicles 36:21
text: to fulfill the word of the LORD in the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed its sabbaths. All the days of the desolation it kept the sabbath, to the full measure of seventy years.

title: II Chronicles 36:22
text: And in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, so that the word of the LORD in the mouth of Jeremiah might be done, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and also in writing, saying,

title: II Chronicles 36:23
text: So says Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth have been given to me by the LORD God. And He has commanded me to build Him a house in Jerusalem, which [is] in Judah. Who [is] among you of all His people? May the LORD his God [be] with him, and let him go up.

title: Ezra 1:1
text: And in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, so that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might he fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and also in writing, saying,

title: Ezra 1:2
text: So says Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of Heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth. And He has commanded me to build Him a house at Jerusalem, which [is] in Judah.

title: Ezra 1:3
text: Who [is there] among you of all His people? Let his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which [is] in Judah, and build the house of Jehovah God of Israel (He is God) which is in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 1:4
text: And whoever remains in any place where he resides, let the men of his place help him with silver and with gold and with goods and with animals, besides the freewill offering for the house of God that [is] in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 1:5
text: And the chiefs of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, and all whose spirit God had raised, rose up to go up to build the house of the LORD which [is] in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 1:6
text: And all those who [were] around them made [their] hands strong with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, and with precious things, besides all [being] willingly offered.

title: Ezra 1:7
text: And Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem and had put them in the house of his gods.

title: Ezra 1:8
text: Even those Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them to Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

title: Ezra 1:9
text: And this [is] the number of them: thirty platters of gold, a thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,

title: Ezra 1:10
text: thirty basins of gold, four hundred and ten silver basins of a second [kind], [and] a thousand other vessels.

title: Ezra 1:11
text: All the vessels of gold and of silver [were] five thousand and four hundred. All [these] Sheshbazzar brought up, when the exiles were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 2:1
text: And these [are] the sons of the province who went up out of the captivity, of those who had been exiled, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had exiled to Babylon. And these came again to Jerusalem and Judah, each one to his city.

title: Ezra 2:2
text: These are the ones who came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. [This is] the number of the men of the people of the sons of Israel:

title: Ezra 2:3
text: The sons of Parosh, two thousand one hundred and seventy-two.

title: Ezra 2:4
text: The sons of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two.

title: Ezra 2:5
text: The sons of Arah, seven hundred and seventy-five.

title: Ezra 2:6
text: The sons of Pahath-moab, of the sons of Jeshua [and] Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

title: Ezra 2:7
text: The sons of Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

title: Ezra 2:8
text: The sons of Zattu, nine hundred and forty-five.

title: Ezra 2:9
text: The sons of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

title: Ezra 2:10
text: The sons of Bani, six hundred and forty-two.

title: Ezra 2:11
text: The sons of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:12
text: The sons of Azgad, a thousand two hundred and twenty-two.

title: Ezra 2:13
text: The sons of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-six.

title: Ezra 2:14
text: The sons of Bigvai, two thousand and fifty-six.

title: Ezra 2:15
text: The sons of Adin, four hundred and fifty-four.

title: Ezra 2:16
text: The sons of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

title: Ezra 2:17
text: The sons of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:18
text: The sons of Jorah, a hundred and twelve.

title: Ezra 2:19
text: The sons of Hashum, two hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:20
text: The sons of Gibbar, ninety-five.

title: Ezra 2:21
text: The sons of Bethlehem, a hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:22
text: The men of Netophah, fifty-six.

title: Ezra 2:23
text: The men of Anathoth, a hundred and twenty-eight.

title: Ezra 2:24
text: The sons of Azmaveth, forty-two.

title: Ezra 2:25
text: The sons of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth seven hundred and forty-three.

title: Ezra 2:26
text: The sons of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one.

title: Ezra 2:27
text: The men of Michmas, a hundred and twenty-two.

title: Ezra 2:28
text: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:29
text: The men of Nebo, fifty-two.

title: Ezra 2:30
text: The men of Magbish, a hundred and fifty-six.

title: Ezra 2:31
text: The sons of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

title: Ezra 2:32
text: The sons of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

title: Ezra 2:33
text: The sons of Lod, Hadid and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-five.

title: Ezra 2:34
text: The sons of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.

title: Ezra 2:35
text: The sons of Senaah, three thousand, six hundred and thirty.

title: Ezra 2:36
text: The priests: The sons of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three.

title: Ezra 2:37
text: The sons of Immer, a thousand and fifty-two.

title: Ezra 2:38
text: The sons of Pashur, a thousand two hundred and forty-seven.

title: Ezra 2:39
text: The sons of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

title: Ezra 2:40
text: The Levites: The sons of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the sons of Hodaviah seventy-four.

title: Ezra 2:41
text: The singers: The sons of Asaph, a hundred and twenty-eight.

title: Ezra 2:42
text: The sons of the gatekeepers: The sons of Shallum, the sons of Ater, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Akkub, the sons of Hatita, the sons of Shobai, a hundred and thirty-nine.

title: Ezra 2:43
text: The temple-slaves: The sons of Ziha, the sons of Hasupha, the sons of Tabbaoth,

title: Ezra 2:44
text: the sons of Keros, the sons of Siaha, the sons of Padon,

title: Ezra 2:45
text: the sons of Lebanah, the sons of Hagabah, the sons of Akkub,

title: Ezra 2:46
text: the sons of Hagab, the sons of Shalmai, the sons of Hanan,

title: Ezra 2:47
text: the sons of Giddel, the sons of Gahar, the sons of Reaiah,

title: Ezra 2:48
text: the sons of Rezin, the sons of Nekoda, the sons of Gazzam,

title: Ezra 2:49
text: the sons of Uzza, the sons of Paseah, the sons of Besai,

title: Ezra 2:50
text: the sons of Asnah, the sons of Mehunim, the sons of Nephusim,

title: Ezra 2:51
text: the sons of Bakbuk, the sons of Hakupha, the sons of Harhur,

title: Ezra 2:52
text: the sons of Bazluth, the sons of Mehida, the sons of Harsha,

title: Ezra 2:53
text: the sons of Barkos, the sons of Sisera, the sons of Thamah,

title: Ezra 2:54
text: the sons of Neziah, the sons of Hatipha.

title: Ezra 2:55
text: The sons of Solomon's servants: The sons of Sotai, the sons of Sophereth, the sons of Peruda,

title: Ezra 2:56
text: the sons of Jaalah, the sons of Darkon, the sons of Giddel,

title: Ezra 2:57
text: the sons of Shephatiah, the sons of Hattil, the sons of Pochereth of Zebaim, the sons of Ami.

title: Ezra 2:58
text: All the temple-slaves, and the sons of Solomon's servants three hundred and ninety-two.

title: Ezra 2:59
text: And these [were] they who went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, [and] Immer, but they could not show their father's house and their seed, whether they [were] of Israel:

title: Ezra 2:60
text: the sons of Delaiah, the sons of Tobiah, the sons of Nekoda, six hundred and fifty-two.

title: Ezra 2:61
text: And of the sons of the priests, the sons of Habaiah, the sons of Koz, the sons of Barzillai (who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name).

title: Ezra 2:62
text: These looked for their register [among] those who were counted by genealogy, but they were not found. Therefore they were polluted from the priesthood.

title: Ezra 2:63
text: And the governor said to them that they should not eat of the most holy things until there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

title: Ezra 2:64
text: The whole congregation together [was] forty-two thousand, three hundred and sixty,

title: Ezra 2:65
text: besides their servants and their maids, seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven. And among them [were] two hundred singing men and singing women.

title: Ezra 2:66
text: Their horses [were] seven hundred and thirty-six, their mules, two hundred and forty-five,

title: Ezra 2:67
text: their camels, four hundred and thirty-five, their asses six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

title: Ezra 2:68
text: And [some] of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in its place.

title: Ezra 2:69
text: They gave according to their ability to the treasure of the work, sixty one thousand drachmas of gold, and five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priest's garments.

title: Ezra 2:70
text: And the priests, and the Levites, and [many] of the people, and the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the temple slaves, lived in their cities. And all Israel in their cities.

title: Ezra 3:1
text: And when the seventh month had come, and the sons of Israel [were] in the cities, the people gathered themselves as one man to Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 3:2
text: And Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up, and his brothers the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brothers. And they built the altar of the God of Israel in order to offer burnt offerings on it, as [it is] written in the law of Moses the man of God.

title: Ezra 3:3
text: And they set the altar on its bases, for fear [was] on them because of the people of those countries. And they offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD, burnt offerings both morning and evening.

title: Ezra 3:4
text: And they kept the feast of tabernacles, as [it is] written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required.

title: Ezra 3:5
text: And afterward they [offered] the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were set apart, and of everyone who willingly offered a freewill offering to the LORD.

title: Ezra 3:6
text: From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not laid.

title: Ezra 3:7
text: They gave silver also to the masons and to the carpenters. And they gave meat and drink and oil to the people of Sidon and to the people of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant which they had from Cyrus king of Persia.

title: Ezra 3:8
text: And in the second year of their coming to the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all they who had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem, began. And they chose the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.

title: Ezra 3:9
text: And Jeshua stood up together [with] his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, to set forward the workmen in the house of God the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brothers the Levites.

title: Ezra 3:10
text: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their robes with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, according to David king of Israel.

title: Ezra 3:11
text: And they sang, praising and giving thanks to the LORD, because [He is] good, for His mercy [endures] forever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

title: Ezra 3:12
text: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, ancient men who had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice. And many shouted aloud for joy

title: Ezra 3:13
text: so that the people could not tell the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people. For the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

title: Ezra 4:1
text: And when the enemies of Judah and Benjamin heard that the sons of the captivity built the temple to the LORD God of Israel,

title: Ezra 4:2
text: then they came to Zerubbabel and to the chief of the fathers, and said to them, Let us build with you, for we seek your God, even as you. And we have sacrificed to him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.

title: Ezra 4:3
text: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said to them, You have nothing to do with us to build a house to our God. But we ourselves together will build to the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.

title: Ezra 4:4
text: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.

title: Ezra 4:5
text: And they hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

title: Ezra 4:6
text: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 4:7
text: And in the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel and the rest of their companions, wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia. And the letter [was] written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.

title: Ezra 4:8
text: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this way.

title: Ezra 4:9
text: Then Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the judges, and the emissaries, the consuls, the officials, the Erechites, the Babylonians, the men of Susa, that is, the Elamites,

title: Ezra 4:10
text: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest of [the province] Beyond the River, and now,

title: Ezra 4:11
text: this [is] the copy of the letter which they sent to him, to Artaxerxes the king. Your servants the men of the province Beyond the River, and so now,

title: Ezra 4:12
text: let it be known to the king that the Jews who came up from you to us have come to Jerusalem, and are building the rebellious and the evil city, and have set up [its] walls, and have joined the foundations.

title: Ezra 4:13
text: And let it be known to the king that if this city is built and the walls set up, then they will not pay toll, taxes, or custom, and you shall endanger the revenue of the kings.

title: Ezra 4:14
text: And because we have eaten the salt of the palace, and it was not right for us to see the king's dishonor, therefore we have sent and notified the king,

title: Ezra 4:15
text: so that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers, and you shall find in the book of the records, and shall know that [this] city [is] a rebellious city, hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have rebelled in it in the past, for which cause that city was destroyed.

title: Ezra 4:16
text: We notify the king that if this city is built and the walls of it set up, then you shall have no portion Beyond the River.

title: Ezra 4:17
text: The message the king sent to Rehum the chancellor, and [to] Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who dwell in Samaria, and to the rest Beyond the River, Peace! And now,

title: Ezra 4:18
text: the letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.

title: Ezra 4:19
text: And I commanded, and search has been made, and it is found that this city has lifted up itself against kings in the past, and rebellion and revolt have been made in it.

title: Ezra 4:20
text: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all Beyond the River. And toll, taxes, and custom was paid to them.

title: Ezra 4:21
text: Now make a decree to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not built until the decree shall be given from me.

title: Ezra 4:22
text: And take heed that you do not fail to do this. Why should damage grow to the hurt of [the] kings?

title: Ezra 4:23
text: And when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter [was] read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they hurried to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them stop by force and power.

title: Ezra 4:24
text: Then the work of the house of God at Jerusalem ceased. So it ceased to the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

title: Ezra 5:1
text: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, [who was] over them.

title: Ezra 5:2
text: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build the house of God at Jerusalem. And with them [were] the prophets of God helping them.

title: Ezra 5:3
text: At the same time Tatnai, governor of the province Beyond the River, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, came to them and said this to them Who has commanded you to build this house and to make this wall?

title: Ezra 5:4
text: So then we said to them: What [are] the names of the men who are building this building?

title: Ezra 5:5
text: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, so that they could not cause them to stop until the matter came to Darius, and answer by letter concerning this had been returned.

title: Ezra 5:6
text: The copy of the letter which Tatnai, governor of [the province] Beyond the River, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions, the officials Beyond the River, sent to Darius the king:

title: Ezra 5:7
text: They sent a letter to him, in which this was written, To Darius the king, all peace:

title: Ezra 5:8
text: Let it be known to the king that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is being built [with] great stones, and timber is being laid in the walls, and this work goes on fast and is blessed in their hands.

title: Ezra 5:9
text: Then we asked those elders [and] said this to them, Who commanded you to build this house and to make these walls?

title: Ezra 5:10
text: We also asked their names in order to notify you so that we might write the names of the men who are the chief of them.

title: Ezra 5:11
text: and they returned this answer to us, saying, We are the servants of the God of Heaven and earth. And we build the house that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and set up.

title: Ezra 5:12
text: But after our fathers had provoked the God of Heaven to wrath, He gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away to Babylon.

title: Ezra 5:13
text: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon, king Cyrus gave an order to build this house of God.

title: Ezra 5:14
text: And also the vessels of gold and silver from the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king took out of the temple of Babylon, and they [were]  delivered to one whose name [was] Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

title: Ezra 5:15
text: And he said to him, Take these vessels and go. Carry them into the temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be built in His place.

title: Ezra 5:16
text: Then the same Sheshbazzar came [and] laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem. And since that time even until now it has been building, but is not finished.

title: Ezra 5:17
text: And therefore, if [it seems] good to the king, let there be search made in the king's treasure house there at Babylon, whether it is so that a decree was given from Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem. And let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.

title: Ezra 6:1
text: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the scrolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.

title: Ezra 6:2
text: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that [was] in the province of the Medes, a scroll. And in it [was] a record written thus:

title: Ezra 6:3
text: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem. Let the house be built, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations of it be strongly laid. The height of it [ shall be] sixty cubits, and the breadth of it shall be sixty cubits,

title: Ezra 6:4
text: [with] three rows of great stones and a row of new timber. And let the expenses be given out of the king's house.

title: Ezra 6:5
text: And also let the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple at Jerusalem, and brought to Babylon, be given back and brought again to the temple which [is] at Jerusalem, to their place, and place them in the house of God.

title: Ezra 6:6
text: And Tatnai, governor of the province Beyond the River, Shethar-boznai, and your companions, the officials Beyond the River, keep away from there.

title: Ezra 6:7
text: Let the work of this house of God alone. Let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

title: Ezra 6:8
text: Also I make a decree as to what you shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God, that at once expense be given to these men from the king's goods, from the tax Beyond the River, so that they may not have to stop.

title: Ezra 6:9
text: And that which they have need of, both young bulls and rams and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of Heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the choice of the priests at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail,

title: Ezra 6:10
text: so that they may offer sacrifices of sweet savors to the God of Heaven, and pray for the life of the king and of his sons.

title: Ezra 6:11
text: Also I have made a decree that whoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house and be set up, and let him be hanged on it. And let his house be made a dunghill for this.

title: Ezra 6:12
text: And may the God who has caused His name to dwell there destroy all kings and people who shall put their hand to alter [or] to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I, Darius, have made a decree. Let it be done with speed.

title: Ezra 6:13
text: Then Tatnai, governor of [the province] Beyond the River, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.

title: Ezra 6:14
text: And the elders of the Jews built, and they were blessed through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they built and finished [it] according to the command of the God of Israel, and according to the command of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

title: Ezra 6:15
text: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

title: Ezra 6:16
text: And the sons of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the sons of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.

title: Ezra 6:17
text: And they offered at the dedication of this house of God a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs. And for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he-goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

title: Ezra 6:18
text: And they set the priests in their sections, and the Levites in their divisions, for the service of God which [is] at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.

title: Ezra 6:19
text: And the sons of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth of the first month.

title: Ezra 6:20
text: For the priests and the Levites [were] purified together, all of them pure. And they slaughtered the passover [lamb] for all the sons of the captivity, and for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.

title: Ezra 6:21
text: And the sons of Israel ate, all who had come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves to them from the uncleanness of the nations of the land, in order to seek the LORD God of Israel.

title: Ezra 6:22
text: And [they] kept the Feast of Unleavened [Bread] seven days with joy. For the LORD had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to make their hands strong in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

title: Ezra 7:1
text: And after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

title: Ezra 7:2
text: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

title: Ezra 7:3
text: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

title: Ezra 7:4
text: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

title: Ezra 7:5
text: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest,

title: Ezra 7:6
text: this Ezra went up from Babylon. And he [was] a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given. And the king granted him all he asked, according to the hand of the LORD his God on him.

title: Ezra 7:7
text: And there went up [some] of the sons of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the temple slaves, to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

title: Ezra 7:8
text: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, in the seventh year of the king.

title: Ezra 7:9
text: For on the first of the first month he began to go up from Babylon, and on the first of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God on him.

title: Ezra 7:10
text: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do [it], and to teach statutes and judgments in Israel.

title: Ezra 7:11
text: And this [is] the copy of the letter which king Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the scribe, a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of His statutes to Israel.

title: Ezra 7:12
text: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of Heaven, perfect [peace], and now:

title: Ezra 7:13
text: From me was made a decree that everyone of the people of Israel, and their priests and Levites in my kingdom, who desire of their own free will to go up to Jerusalem, go with you;

title: Ezra 7:14
text: since you have been sent by the king, and by his seven counselors to ask about Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God in your hand;

title: Ezra 7:15
text: and to carry the silver and gold which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose house [is] in Jerusalem,

title: Ezra 7:16
text: and all the silver and gold which you can find in all the province of Babylon, with the free will offering of the people and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 7:17
text: Before all of this, you shall diligently buy with this money, bulls, rams, lambs, with their food offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them on the altar of the house of your God in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 7:18
text: And whatever shall seem good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that after the will of your God.

title: Ezra 7:19
text: Also the vessels which are given you for the service of the house of your God, deliver them before the God of Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 7:20
text: And whatever more shall be needful for the house of God, which you shall have need to give, give [it] out of the king's treasure house.

title: Ezra 7:21
text: And I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers who [are] Beyond the River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of Heaven, shall ask of you, it shall be done exactly,

title: Ezra 7:22
text: to a hundred talents of silver, and to a hundred measures of wheat, and to a hundred baths of wine, and to a hundred baths of oil, and salt without saying.

title: Ezra 7:23
text: Whatever is commanded by the God of Heaven, let it be carefully done for the house of the God of Heaven for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

title: Ezra 7:24
text: Also, we notify you, that in regard to any of the priests and the Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple slaves, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, taxes, or custom on them.

title: Ezra 7:25
text: And now, Ezra, after the wisdom of your God that [is] in your hand, set officers and judges who may judge all the people who [are] Beyond the River, all who know the laws of your God; and teach them who do not know.

title: Ezra 7:26
text: And whoever will not do the law of your God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily on him, whether [it is] to death, or to exile, or to confiscation of goods, or imprisonment.

title: Ezra 7:27
text: Blessed [be] the LORD God of our fathers, who has put this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD in Jerusalem,

title: Ezra 7:28
text: and has extended mercy before the king and his counselors and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was made strong as the hand of the LORD my God [was] on me, and I gathered out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

title: Ezra 8:1
text: These [are] now the chief of their fathers, and the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

title: Ezra 8:2
text: From the sons of Phinehas; Gershom. From the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. From the sons of David, Hattush.

title: Ezra 8:3
text: From the sons of Shechaniah, from the sons of Parosh, Zechariah. And with him were counted by genealogy of the males a hundred and fifty.

title: Ezra 8:4
text: From the sons of Pahath-moab, Eli-hoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.

title: Ezra 8:5
text: From the sons of Shechaniah, the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

title: Ezra 8:6
text: From the sons also of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

title: Ezra 8:7
text: And from the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

title: Ezra 8:8
text: And from the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him eighty males.

title: Ezra 8:9
text: From the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

title: Ezra 8:10
text: And from the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah, and with him a hundred and sixty males.

title: Ezra 8:11
text: And from the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty eight males.

title: Ezra 8:12
text: And from the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him a hundred and ten males.

title: Ezra 8:13
text: And from the last sons of Adonikam, these: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them sixty males.

title: Ezra 8:14
text: From the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

title: Ezra 8:15
text: And I gathered them to the river which runs to Ahava. And we stayed there in tents three days. And I looked over the people and the priests, and did not find there any of the sons of Levi.

title: Ezra 8:16
text: Then I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

title: Ezra 8:17
text: And I sent them with command to Iddo the chief of the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say to Iddo, to his brothers the temple slaves, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

title: Ezra 8:18
text: And by the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of understanding, from the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;

title: Ezra 8:19
text: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah from the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

title: Ezra 8:20
text: also of the temple slaves whom David and the rulers had chosen for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty temple slaves. All of them were called by name.

title: Ezra 8:21
text: Then I called a fast there at the river Ahava, so that we might humble ourselves before our God, in order to seek from Him a right way for us and for our little ones, and for all our goods.

title: Ezra 8:22
text: For I was ashamed to ask of the king troops and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God [is] on all those who seek Him for good, but His power and His wrath [ are] against all those who forsake Him.

title: Ezra 8:23
text: So we fasted and prayed to our God for good. And He was pleased to hear us.

title: Ezra 8:24
text: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them.

title: Ezra 8:25
text: And I weighed to them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, the offering of the house of our God, which the king and his counselors and his lords, and all Israel who were there, had offered.

title: Ezra 8:26
text: And I weighed into their hands six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels of a hundred talents, of gold a hundred talents

title: Ezra 8:27
text: and twenty basins of gold of a thousand drams, and two vessels of fine copper as desirable as gold.

title: Ezra 8:28
text: And I said to them, You [are] holy to the LORD, and the vessels [are] holy. And the silver and the gold [are] a free-will offering to the LORD God of your fathers.

title: Ezra 8:29
text: Watch and keep [them] until you weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and the chief of the fathers of Israel at Jerusalem [in] the rooms of the house of the LORD.

title: Ezra 8:30
text: So the priests and the Levites took the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring [them] to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

title: Ezra 8:31
text: And we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth of the first month, to go [to] Jerusalem. And the hand of our God was on us, and He delivered us from the hand of [the] enemy, and from ambushers by the way.

title: Ezra 8:32
text: And we came to Jerusalem and stayed there three days.

title: Ezra 8:33
text: And on the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest. And with him [was] Eleazar the son of Phinehas, and with them [was] Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites.

title: Ezra 8:34
text: They were weighed by number [and] by weight of every one. And all the weight was written at that time.

title: Ezra 8:35
text: The sons of those who had been exiled, who had come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve young bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, twelve he-goats [for] a sin offering. All this [was] a burnt offering to the LORD.

title: Ezra 8:36
text: And they delivered the king's orders to the king's lieutenants and to the governors of [the province] Beyond the River. And they helped the people and the house of God.

title: Ezra 9:1
text: And at the end of these things, the rulers came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands. But [they are doing] according to their abominations, those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

title: Ezra 9:2
text: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons. So the holy seed has mixed themselves with the people of [those] lands. Yes, the hand of the leaders and overseers has been chief in this sin.

title: Ezra 9:3
text: And when I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down stricken dumb.

title: Ezra 9:4
text: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel was gathered to me, because of the sin of those who had been exiled. And I remained dumb until the evening sacrifice.

title: Ezra 9:5
text: And at the evening sacrifice I rose up from my affliction. And tearing my garment and my mantle, I fell on my knees and spread out my hands to the LORD my God.

title: Ezra 9:6
text: And I said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to You, my God. For our iniquities have increased over [our] heads, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.

title: Ezra 9:7
text: Since the days of our fathers [we have been] in a great sin until this day. And for our iniquities we, our kings, our priests, have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to shame of face, as it is this day.

title: Ezra 9:8
text: And now for a little time grace has been [shown] from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape and to give us a nail in His holy place, so that our God may enlighten our eyes and give us a little life in our bondage.

title: Ezra 9:9
text: For we [were] slaves, yet our God has not left us in our bondage, but has given mercy to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us some life, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its waste, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 9:10
text: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken Your commandments

title: Ezra 9:11
text: which You commanded by Your servants the prophets, saying, The land into which you go to possess it, [is] an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations which have filled it from one end to the other with their uncleanness.

title: Ezra 9:12
text: And now do not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth forever, so that you may be strong and eat the good of the land and leave [it] for an inheritance to your sons forever.

title: Ezra 9:13
text: And after all that has come on us for our evil deeds and for our great sin, since You our God have punished us less than our iniquities [deserve], and have given us such an escape as this,

title: Ezra 9:14
text: should we again break Your commandments and join hands with the people of these abominations? Would You not be angry with us until You had crushed [us], until there is no remnant nor survivor?

title: Ezra 9:15
text: O LORD God of Israel, You [are] righteous. For we are left a remnant that has escaped, as today. Behold, we [are] before You in our sins, for we cannot stand before You because of this.

title: Ezra 10:1
text: And when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there gathered to him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children, for the people wept [with] a great weeping.

title: Ezra 10:2
text: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, of the sons of Elam, answered and said to Ezra, We have sinned against our God and have taken strange women from the people of the land. Yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.

title: Ezra 10:3
text: And now let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the women, and such as have been born of them, according to the counsel of the Lord, and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. And let it be done according to the Law.

title: Ezra 10:4
text: Arise, for [this] matter [belongs] to you. We also [will be] with you. Be of good courage and act.

title: Ezra 10:5
text: Then Ezra arose and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they should do according to this word. And they swore.

title: Ezra 10:6
text: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God and went into the room of Johanan the son of Eliashib. And he went there, and he ate no bread nor drank water. For he mourned because of the sin of those who had been exiled.

title: Ezra 10:7
text: And they made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the sons of the captivity, to gather themselves to Jerusalem,

title: Ezra 10:8
text: and that who ever would not come within three days, according to the advice of the rulers and the elders, all he owned would be lost, and he himself separated from the congregation of the exiles.

title: Ezra 10:9
text: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves to Jerusalem within three days. It [was] the ninth month, on the twentieth of the month. And all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of [this]  matter, and for the great rain.

title: Ezra 10:10
text: And Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, You have sinned, and have taken strange women to increase the sin of Israel.

title: Ezra 10:11
text: And now confess to the LORD God of your fathers, and do His pleasure. And separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange women.

title: Ezra 10:12
text: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As you have said, so we must do.

title: Ezra 10:13
text: But the people [are] many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. And the work is not of one or two days. For we who have sinned in this thing are many.

title: Ezra 10:14
text: And let our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all those who have taken strange women in our cities, come at a set time, and with them the elders of every city and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter has turned from us.

title: Ezra 10:15
text: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah made a stand against this. And Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supported them.

title: Ezra 10:16
text: And the sons of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, [with] certain heads of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by names, were separated. And they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

title: Ezra 10:17
text: And they made an end with all the men who had taken strange women by the first day of the first month.

title: Ezra 10:18
text: And among the sons of the priests, these were found who had taken strange women: From the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak and his brothers were Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

title: Ezra 10:19
text: And they gave their hands that they would put away their women. And [being] guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their sin.

title: Ezra 10:20
text: And from the sons of Immer [were] Hanani and Zebadiah.

title: Ezra 10:21
text: And from the sons of Harim [were] Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.

title: Ezra 10:22
text: And from the sons of Pashur [were] Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

title: Ezra 10:23
text: And from the Levites: Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah (the same [is] Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

title: Ezra 10:24
text: And from the singers: Eliashib; and from the gatekeepers, Shallum and Telem and Uri.

title: Ezra 10:25
text: And from Israel: From the sons of Parosh, Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah and Benaiah.

title: Ezra 10:26
text: And from the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.

title: Ezra 10:27
text: And from the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.

title: Ezra 10:28
text: And from the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.

title: Ezra 10:29
text: And from the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

title: Ezra 10:30
text: And from the sons of Pahath-moab: Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel. and Binnui, and Manasseh.

title: Ezra 10:31
text: And from the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

title: Ezra 10:32
text: Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.

title: Ezra 10:33
text: From the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.

title: Ezra 10:34
text: From the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

title: Ezra 10:35
text: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,

title: Ezra 10:36
text: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

title: Ezra 10:37
text: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,

title: Ezra 10:38
text: and Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,

title: Ezra 10:39
text: and Shelemiah, Nathan, and Adaiah,

title: Ezra 10:40
text: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

title: Ezra 10:41
